original: pṛthivyādi tattadabhimānijīvā eva vā tattadantaryāmītyanyaḥ | tānprati pṛthivyādeḥ sthūlaśarīratvāt‌ | evaṃ ca prakṛtyādirevātrāmṛto'nya iti prācīnāmṛtatvaṃ nākṣisthasya viṣṇutvasādhakamiti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: pṛthivī ādi tad tad abhimāni jīvāḥ eva vā tat tad antaryāmī iti anyaḥ tān prati pṛthivī ādeḥ sthūlaśarīra tvāt evam ca prakṛti ādiḥ eva atra amṛtaḥ nyaḥ iti prācīna amṛta tvam na akṣi sthasya viṣṇu tva sādhakam iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: yaṃ pṛthivī na veda yaḥ pṛthivīmantaro yamayatītyādinoktasya kārtsyena pṛthivyādidevāviditatvasya bāhyāpekṣāṃ vinā ramamāṇatvarūpāntaratvasya ca liṅgasya "na te viṣṇo jāyamānaḥ' "sa yo'to'śruto'gato'mato'dṛṣyaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmantarapuruṣaḥ' ityādiśrutyā viṣṇvekadharmatvāt‌ pṛthivyādeḥ jaḍatve aprasaktanirāsaprasaṅgāt‌ yamityasya vaiyarthyācca |
analyzed: yam pṛthivī na veda yaḥ pṛthivīm antaraḥ yamayati ityādinā uktasya kārtsyena pṛthivī ādi deva a vidita tvasya bāhya apekṣām vinā ramamāṇa tva rūpa antara tvasya ca liṅgasya na te viṣṇo jāyamānaḥ sa sarveṣām bhūtānām antara puruṣaḥ ityādi śrutyā viṣṇu eka dharma tvāt pṛthivī ādeḥ jaḍa tve aprasakta nirāsa prasaṅgāt yam ityasya vaiyarthyāt ca

original: śarīratvasya śīryata iti śarīramiti yogena vā śarīravadīśaniyamyatvena gauṇyā vṛttyā vā yuktatvena yaḥ pṛthivyāmityādeḥ kleśenāneyatvāt‌ | prakṛtijīvayoḥ triguṇatvasaṃsāritvādyasādhāraṇadharmābhāvāt‌ "ya ātmano'ntaro vijñānādantaro viviktaḥ' iti jīvādantaryāmiṇo bhedavyapadeśācca antaryāmī viṣṇurevetyamṛtatvamapi tasyaiveti |
analyzed: śarīra tvasya śīryate iti śarīram iti yogena vā śarīra vat īśa niyamya tvena gauṇyā vṛttyā vā yukta tvena yaḥ pṛthivyām ityādeḥ kleśena aneya tvāt prakṛti jīvayoḥ triguṇa tva saṃsāri tva ādi asādhāraṇa dharma abhāvāt yaḥ ātmanaḥ ntaraḥ vijñānāt antaraḥ viviktaḥ iti jīvāt antaryāmiṇaḥ bheda vyapadeśāt ca antaryāmī viṣṇuḥ eva iti amṛta tvam api tasya eva iti

original: atra "yaṃ pṛthivī na veda' ityuktādṛśyatvākhyaprācīnahetvākṣepātsaṅgatiḥ | ātharvaṇe "dve vidye veditavye' ityupakramya "atha parā yayā tadakṣaramadhigamyate' "yattadadreśyamagrāhyamagotramavarṇam‌' ityādinoktādṛśyatvādiguṇakaṃ akṣarātsambhavatīha viśvamiti viśvakāraṇatayā śrutamakṣaraṃ kiṃ cidacitprakṛtiviriñcirudrā uta viṣṇuriti sandehaḥ |
analyzed: atra yam pṛthivī na veda iti ukta adṛśya tva ākhya prācīna hetu ākṣepāt saṅgatiḥ ātharvaṇe dve vidye veditavye iti upakramya atha parā yayā tat akṣaram adhigamyate yat tat adreśyam agrāhyam agotram avarṇam ityādinā ukta adṛśya tva ādi guṇakam akṣarāt sambhavati iha viśvam iti viśva kāraṇatayā śrutam akṣaram kim cit acit prakṛti viriñci rudrāḥ uta viṣṇuḥ iti sandehaḥ

original: "yatha pṛthivyāmoṣadhayaḥ' ityupādanādṛṣyāntabalenābādhe antaraṅgatyāgāyogena ca akṣarāditiśrutopādānatvarūpāraṇatvaliṅgāt‌ jaḍaprakṛtirityekaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | "kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate' iti smṛtāvakṣarapadasya śrītattve prayogādupādanābhimānitvena upādānatvasyāpi sambhavāccitprakṛtirityanyaḥ |
analyzed: pṛthivyām oṣadhayaḥ iti upādanāt ṛṣyānta balena ābādhe antaraṅga tyāga ayogena ca akṣarāt iti śruta upādāna tva rūpa araṇa tva liṅgāt jaḍa prakṛtiḥ iti ekaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ kūṭastha ukṣaraḥ ucyate iti smṛtau akṣara padasya śrī tattve prayogāt upādana abhimāni tvena upādāna tvasya api sambhavāt cit prakṛtiḥ iti anyaḥ

original: "sa brahmavidyām‌' ityupakrame brahmaśabdāccaturmukho vā katarāramīśamityuttaratreśapadaśravaṇādrudrovetyaparau | nacākṣarādiśabdā viṣṇau sāvakāśāḥ | akṣarātparataḥ para ityutkarṣāvadhitayā nirdeśenoktākṣarasya nikṛṣyatvena viṣṇutvāyogāt‌ | ata eva ca kāraṇatvamātre akṣarātsambhavatīti pañcamīti
analyzed: sa brahma vidyām iti upakrame brahma śabdāt caturmukhaḥ vā katarāram īśam iti uttaratra īśa pada śravaṇāt rudraḥ vā iti aparau na ca akṣara ādi śabdāḥ viṣṇau sa avakāśāḥ akṣarāt paratas paraḥ iti utkarṣa avadhi tayā nirdeśena ukta akṣarasya nikṛṣya tvena viṣṇu tva ayogāt atas eva ca kāraṇa tva mātre akṣarāt sambhavati iti pañcamī iti

original: pratyuktam‌ | citprakṛtipakṣe akṣarātparata iti pañcamyoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena pakṣāntareṣu vaiyyadhikaraṇyenopapatteriti | siddhāntastu | "atha parā yayā sa harirveditavyaḥ' "sā vidyā tanmatiryayā' ityādiśrutismṛtibhiḥ viṣṇvekaniṣṭhaṛgādiparavidyāviṣayatvarūpataddharmāt‌ | "yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rugmavarṇam‌' iti rūpopanyāsāt‌ |
analyzed: pratyuktam cit prakṛti pakṣe akṣarāt paratas iti pañcamyoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena pakṣa antareṣu vaiyyadhikaraṇyena upapatteḥ iti siddhāntaḥ tu atha parā yayā sa hariḥ veditavyaḥ sā vidyā tad matiḥ yayā ityādi śruti smṛtibhiḥ viṣṇu eka niṣṭha ṛk ādi para vidyā viṣaya tva rūpa tad dharmāt yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rugma varṇam iti rūpa upanyāsāt

original: "anyeṣāṃ vimiśrāṇi vyamiśrayad‌' ityādiśrutyā miśrarūpatvena śuddharūpasya tadekaniṣṭhatvāt‌ | akṣaratrayamīritamitismṛtyā parāvadhitvenoktākṣarasyānyatvenāviṣṇutayā parāvadhitvena nirdeśasyābādhakatvāt‌ | pṛthivyādidṛṣyāntasya kāraṇatvamātre tātparyasambhavāt‌ | brahmeśādiśabdasya viṣṇāveva mukhyatvāt‌ |
analyzed: anyeṣām vimiśrāṇi vyamiśrayat ityādi śrutyā miśra rūpa tvena śuddha rūpasya tad eka niṣṭhatvāt akṣaratrayam īritam iti smṛtyā para avadhi tvena ukta akṣarasya anya tvena a viṣṇu tayā para avadhi tvena nirdeśasya ābādhaka tvāt pṛthivī ādi dṛṣya antasya kāraṇa tva mātre tātparya sambhavāt brahma īśa ādi śabdasya viṣṇau eva mukhya tvāt

original: jaḍapakṣe yaḥ sarvajña ityuktasārvajñarūpaviśeṣaṇāyogāt‌ | "tasmādetadbrahma nāmarūpamannaṃ ca jāyate' iti "juṣyaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśam‌' iti brahmarudrayorakṣarādbhedavyapadeśācca | adṛśyatvādiguṇakaṃ parataḥ paratvena śrutamakṣaraṃ viṣṇureveti | phale tu adṛśyatvādiguṇayuktānandamayākṣepa tatsamādhī || 6 ||

original: "yatkaṭhiṇaṃ sā pṛthivī taddravaṃ tadāpaḥ yaduṣṇaṃ tattejaḥ' iti śruteranekabhūtopādānaka eva deha iti || 13 ||

analyzed: iti śrī rāghavendrayati kṛtāyām nyāyamuktāvalyām dvitīya adhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ

original: evaṃ samanvayāvirodhābhyāṃ jijñāsāsūtrasthabrahmaśabdārthaḥ siddharūpaḥ nirūpitaḥ pūvarādhyāye | tatsthāvaśiṣyātojijñāsāpadānāmarthaḥ sādhyarūpo nirūpyate anantarādhyāyadvaye iti pūrvottarādhyāyadvikadvayasya siddhasādhyavicārarūpatvāt‌ paurvāparyam‌ |
analyzed: evam samanvaya avirodhābhyām jijñāsā sūtra stha brahma śabda arthaḥ siddha rūpaḥ nirūpitaḥ pūvara adhyāye tad stha avaśiṣya atas jijñāsā padānām arthaḥ sādhya rūpaḥ nirūpyate anantara adhyāya dvaye iti pūrva uttara adhyāya dvika dvayasya siddha sādhya vicāra rūpa tvāt paurvāparyam

original: tatrāpyataḥpadoktaphalaṃ prati athajijñāsāpadābhyāṃ uktavairāgyabhaktyupāsanāparokṣajñānānāṃ hetutvena tṛtīye'trādhyāye sādhanavicāra ityadhyāyasaṅgatiḥ | pādānāmapyuttarottaraṃ prati pūrvapūrvasya hetutvāt‌ kramo dhyeyaḥ |
analyzed: tatra api atas pada ukta phalam prati atha jijñāsā padābhyām ukta vairāgya bhakti upāsana parokṣa jñānānām hetu tvena tṛtīye itra adhyāye sādhana vicāraḥ iti adhyāya saṅgatiḥ pādānām api uttarottaram prati pūrva pūrvasya hetu tvāt kramaḥ dhyeyaḥ

original: || oṃ tadantarapratipattau raṃhati sampariṣvaktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyām‌ oṃ || 1 ||
analyzed: om tad antara pratipattau raṃhati sampariṣvaktaḥ praśna nirūpaṇābhyām om

original: pūrvatra candrikākārairuktā cintāparamparā | ato noktā mayā sā'tra tūcyate sanmude sphuṭam‌ | atha jijñāsāsūtrasthāthādipadoktavairāgyādimokṣasādhanamananuṣṭheyamutānuṣṭheyamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ jīvasya mṛtau niḥśeṣabhūtaviyogo'sita uta neti | tadarthaṃ bhūtāviyoge pramāṇaprayojane nasta uta sta iti |
analyzed: pūrvatra candrikā kāraiḥ uktā cintā paramparā atas na uktā mayā sā atra tu ucyate sat mude sphuṭam atha jijñāsā sūtra stha atha ādi pada ukta vairāgya ādi mokṣa sādhanam ananuṣṭheyam uta anuṣṭheyam iti cintā tad artham jīvasya mṛtau niḥśeṣa bhūta viyoga usite uta na iti tad artham bhūta aviyoge pramāṇa prayojane naste uta staḥ iti

original: yadyādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tarhi niḥśeṣabhūtaviyogasyaiva mokṣatayā svābhāvikamṛtyaiva anāyāsena mokṣasiddheḥ nānuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanamiti | yadyantastadā bhūtaviyogasyaiva muktitve'pi mṛtau tadabhāvāt‌ anuṣṭheyameva mokṣārthaṃ sādhanamiti phalaphalībhāvaḥ | pūrvapakṣastu | nānuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanam‌ |
analyzed: yadi ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tarhi niḥśeṣa bhūta viyogasya eva mokṣa tayā svābhāvika mṛtyā eva anāyāsena mokṣa siddheḥ na anuṣṭheyam sādhanam iti yadi antaḥ tadā bhūta viyogasya eva mukti tve pi mṛtau tad abhāvāt anuṣṭheyam eva mokṣa artham sādhanam iti phala phalībhāvaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ tu na anuṣṭheyam sādhanam

original: tena vināpi "bhūtānāṃ vinivṛttistu maraṇam‌' iti smṛtyā sarvabhūtavinivṛttirūpamaraṇenaiva "muktistebhyo vimocanam‌' iti smṛtyā bhūtavimocanarūpamokṣasiddheḥ | naca bhūtānāṃ mṛtajīvena saha gamane pramāṇamasti śarīrabhogān‌ pradāya caritārthānāṃ prayojanaṃ nāstīti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: tena vinā api bhūtānām vinivṛttiḥ tu maraṇam iti smṛtyā sarva bhūta vinivṛtti rūpa maraṇena eva muktiḥ tebhyaḥ vimocanam iti smṛtyā bhūta vimocana rūpa mokṣa siddheḥ na ca bhūtānām mṛta jīvena saha gamane pramāṇam asti śarīra bhogān pradāya caritārthānām prayojanam nā asti iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "vettha yathā pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavanti' iti praśnaprativacanayoḥ abupalakṣitajīvasyoktibalāt‌ "bhūtayuktaḥ paraṃ lokamimaṃ lokaṃ ca gacchati' ityādipramāṇabalāt‌ śarīrāntasampādanārthatayā prayojanavattvāt‌ bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gatyavagamena mṛtau niḥśeṣabhūtaviyogābhāvāt‌ "bhūtānāṃ vinivṛttiḥ' sati smṛteḥ "mṛtikāle jahātyenam‌'
analyzed: vettha yathā pañcamyām āhutau āpaḥ puruṣa vacasaḥ bhavanti iti praśna prativacanayoḥ ap upalakṣita jīvasya ukti balāt bhūta yuktaḥ param lokam imam lokam ca gacchati ityādi pramāṇa balāt śarīra anta sampādana artha tayā prayojanavat tvāt bhūtānām jīvena saha gati avagamena mṛtau niḥśeṣa bhūta viyoga abhāvāt bhūtānām vinivṛttiḥ sati smṛteḥ mṛti kāle jahāti enam

original: iti smṛtyā bhāgaviṣayatvāttadrūpamokṣārthaṃ anuṣṭheyameva sādhanamiti | phale tu jijñāsāsūtroktasādhanākṣepasamādhī || 1 ||
analyzed: iti smṛtyā bhāga viṣaya tvāt tad rūpa mokṣa artham anuṣṭheyam eva sādhanam iti phale tu jijñāsā sūtra ukta sādhana ākṣepa samādhī

original: || oṃ tyātmakatvāttu bhūyastvāt‌ oṃ || 2 ||
analyzed: om tya ātmaka tvāt tu bhūyaḥ tvāt om

original: pūrvoktapraśnādibalāt‌ ekābākhyabhūtagatisiddhāvapi ekasya dehānārambhakatayā'prayojakatvāt‌ mṛtireva muktiriti kiṃ sādhanānuṣṭhāneneti ākṣepātsaṅgatiḥ | mṛtaṃ jīvaṃ pariṣvajya kiṃ āpa eva gacchanti uta sarvāṇi bhūtānīti cintā | tadarthaṃ praśnādisthāpūśabdaḥ kimekabhūtaparaḥ utānekapara iti |
analyzed: pūrva ukta praśna ādi balāt eka ap ākhya bhūta gati siddhau api ekasya deha anārambhaka tayā aprayojaka tvāt mṛtiḥ eva muktiḥ iti kim sādhana anuṣṭhānena iti ākṣepāt saṅgatiḥ mṛtam jīvam pariṣvajya kim āpaḥ eva gacchanti uta sarvāṇi bhūtāni iti cintā tad artham praśna ādi sthāpū śabdaḥ kim eka bhūta paraḥ uta aneka paraḥ iti

original: tadarthamanekabhūtaparatve heturnāsti āp‌śabdaśca na yuktaḥ uta viparīta iti | pūrvapakṣastu | āpaḥ puruṣavacasa iti praśnādau ap‌ śabdenāpāmeva gatiśravaṇāt‌ ap‌ śabdasyānekabhūtaparatve hetvabhāvena "bhūtāni puruṣavacāṃsi bhavanti' iti nirdeśāpattyā ca viśiṣyāp‌śabdaśravaṇāyogāt‌ āpa eva gacchanti netarabhūtānīti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: tad artham aneka bhūta paratve hetuḥ na asti āp śabdaḥ ca na yuktaḥ uta viparītaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu āpaḥ puruṣa vacasaḥ iti praśna ādau ap śabdena apām eva gati śravaṇāt ap śabdasya aneka bhūta paratve hetu abhāvena bhūtāni puruṣa vacāṃsi bhavanti iti nirdeśa āpattyā ca viśiṣya ap śabda śravaṇa ayogāt āpaḥ eva gacchanti na itara bhūtāni iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: miśrāṇi hi bhūtānītyādi śrutyā bhūtānāṃ miśratvena śrutau tyātmakāp‌śabdenaiva bhūtāni puruṣavacāṃsītyarthalābhāt‌ sarvabhūtānāṃ miśratve'pi śrutāp‌śabdasya pārthivādisarvadeheṣu sambhūyāpāmeva bhūtejopekṣayā bhūyastvena vaiśeṣyāttadvāda iti uktanyāyenopapatteḥ sarvāṇi bhūtānyapi gacchantīti | phalaṃ tu sādhanānuṣṭhānākṣepasamādhī eveti || 2 ||
analyzed: miśrāṇi hi bhūtāni ityādi śrutyāḥ bhūtānām miśra tvena śrutau tya ātmaka ap śabdena eva bhūtāni puruṣa vacāṃsi iti artha lābhāt sarva bhūtānām miśra tve api śruta ap śabdasya pārthiva ādi sarva deheṣu sambhūya apām eva bhū teja upekṣayā bhūyastvena vaiśeṣyāt tad vādaḥ iti ukta nyāyena upapatteḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni api gacchanti iti phalam tu sādhana anuṣṭhāna ākṣepa samādhī eva iti

original: || oṃ prāṇagateśca oṃ || 3 ||
analyzed: om prāṇa gateḥ ca om

original: pūrvatra tyātmakāpāṃ gatyuktyā arthātsiddhā bhūtānāṃ gatiḥ iha viśiṣyānumānarūpamānena sādhyata iti saṅgatiḥ | athādipadoktaṃ vairāgyādisādhanaṃ anāvaśyakaṃ utāvaśyakamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ prakṛtabhūtāni jīvena saha na gacchanti uta gacchantīti | tadarthaṃ viśiṣya mānaṃ nāsti utāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: pūrvatra gati uktyā arthāt siddhā bhūtānām gatiḥ iha viśiṣya anumāna rūpa mānena sādhyate iti saṅgatiḥ atha ādi pada uktam vairāgya ādi sādhanam anāvaśyakam uta āvaśyakam iti cintā tad artham prakṛta bhūtāni jīvena saha na gacchanti uta gacchanti iti tad artham viśiṣya mānam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: pūrvoktadiśā tyātmakāpāṃ gatyarthāt‌ bhūtagatiriti nirṇayasya
analyzed: pūrva ukta diśā gati arthāt bhūtagatiḥ iti nirṇayasya

original: viśeṣamānādhīnatvāt‌ tasya cehānupalambhāt‌ na gacchantīti nāvaśyakaṃ sādhanamiti | siddhāntastu | bhūtāni jīvena saha gacchantyeva sahagantṛpāṇāvinābhūtatvāt‌ |
analyzed: viśeṣa māna adhīna tvāt tasya ca iha anupalambhāt na gacchanti iti na āvaśyakam sādhanam iti siddhāntaḥ tu bhūtāni jīvena saha gacchanti eva sahagantṛ pāṇa avinābhūta tvāt

original: yadyatsahagantravinābhūtaṃ tattatsahagantṛ yathā rājasahagantramātayāvinābhūtaṃ vastu rājasahagantraṃ ityanumānarūpaviśeṣapramāṇasadbhāvāt‌ bhūtāni jīvena saha gatimantyeva kāraṇairvāva na viyujyata iti śrutyā hetau viśeṣaṇasya "yatra vāva bhūtāni tatra karaṇāni' iti śrutau "na caitāni kadācidviyujyante' ityuktyā viśeṣasiddheḥ āvaśyakaṃ
analyzed: yat yat sahagantra vinābhūtam tat tat sahagantṛ yathā rāja sahagantra mātayā vinābhūtam vastu rāja sahagantram iti anumāna rūpa viśeṣa pramāṇa sadbhāvāt bhūtāni jīvena saha gatimanti eva kāraṇaiḥ vāva na viyujyate iti śrutyā hetau viśeṣaṇasya yatra vāva bhūtāni tatra karaṇāni iti śrutau na ca etāni kadācid viyujyante iti uktyā viśeṣa siddheḥ āvaśyakam

original: sādhanamiti || 3 ||
analyzed: sādhanam iti

original: || oṃ agnyādigatiśruteriti cenna bhāktatvāt‌ oṃ || 4 ||
analyzed: om agni ādi gati śruteḥ iti ced na bhākta tvāt om

original: prāguktahetorasiddhirnirasyate'treti saṅgatiḥ | athādipadoktaṃ sādhanaṃ nānuṣṭheyamutānuṣṭheyamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ prakṛtāḥ prāṇāḥ kiṃ jīvena saha na gacchantyuta gacchantīti | tadarthaṃ prāṇānāṃ agnyādigatiśrutiḥ kiṃ savarātmanā prāṇagatiparā atha bhāgaśaḥ tadgatipareti | tadarthaṃ bhāgaparatve kalpakaṃ nāsti bādhakaṃ cāsti uta viparītamiti |
analyzed: prāk ukta hetoḥ asiddhiḥ nirasyate itra iti saṅgatiḥ atha ādi pada uktam sādhanam na anuṣṭheyam uta anuṣṭheyam iti cintā tad artham prakṛtāḥ prāṇāḥ kim jīvena saha na gacchanti uta gacchanti iti tad artham prāṇānām agni ādi gati śrutiḥ kim savara ātmanā prāṇa gati parā atha bhāgaśas tad gati parā iti tad artham bhāga para tve kalpakam na asti bādhakam ca asti uta viparītam iti

original: pūrvapakṣastu | "yatrāsya puruṣasya mṛtasyāgniṃ vāgapyeti vātaṃ prāṇaścakṣurādityam‌' ityādinā vāgādiprāṇānāmagnyādyadhidaivaṃ prati gatiśravaṇena jīvena sahagatyābhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ tu yatra asya puruṣasya mṛtasya agnim vāc apyeti vātam prāṇaḥ cakṣuḥ ādityam ityādinā vāc ādi prāṇānām agni ādi adhidaivam prati gati śravaṇena jīvena saha gatyā abhāvāt

original: bhāgaśo jīvena saha gacchantīti bhāgāntareṇādhidaivamityasya ca kalpakābhāvena pratimaraṇameva bhāgāpagame kālataḥ sarvāpagamāpātena ca prāṇānāmadhidaivagatau bhūtānāmapi taissaha tatra gatau jīvena saha gatyabhāvena jīvena saha gatau tatra gatyabhāva iti sarvathā'pi bhūtānāṃ prāṇavinābhāvābhāvāpātena cāyogāt‌ |
analyzed: bhāgaśas jīvena saha gacchanti iti bhāga antareṇa adhidaivam iti asya ca kalpaka abhāvena pratimaraṇam eva bhāga apagame kālataḥ sarva apagama āpātena ca prāṇānām adhidaiva gatau bhūtānām api taiḥ saha tatra gatau jīvena saha gati abhāvena jīvena saha gatau tatra gati abhāvaḥ iti sarvathā api bhūtānām prāṇa vinābhāva abhāva āpātena ca ayogāt

original: na prāṇāḥ jīvena saha gantāraḥ iti nānuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanamiti | siddhāntastu | "puruṣasya mṛtau brahman‌' iti smṛtau prāṇānāṃ bhāgaśa eva ubhayatra gamanasya "mṛtikāle jahātyenam‌' iti smṛtisiddhatvena bhūtānāṃ prāṇavinābhāvābhāvāt‌ | prāṇā bhūtāni ca jīvena saha gacchantyevetyanuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanamiti || 4 ||
analyzed: na prāṇāḥ jīvena saha gantāraḥ iti na anuṣṭheyam sādhanam iti siddhāntaḥ tu puruṣasya mṛtau brahman iti smṛtau prāṇānām bhāgaśas eva ubhayatra gamanasya mṛti kāle jahāti enam iti smṛti siddha tvena bhūtānām prāṇa vinābhāva abhāvāt prāṇāḥ bhūtāni ca jīvena saha gacchanti eva iti anuṣṭheyam sādhanam iti

original: || oṃ prathame'śravaṇāditi cenna tā eva hyupapatteḥ oṃ || 5 ||
analyzed: om prathame śravaṇāt iti ced na tāḥ eva hi upapatteḥ om

original: pūrvatrāgnyādiśruteḥ bhāktatvoktiprasaṅgādatra śraddhāśruteḥ bhāktatvoktiriti saṅgatiḥ | athādipadoktaṃ sādhanaṃ nānuṣṭheyamutānuṣṭheyamiti cintā |
analyzed: pūrvatra agni ādi śruteḥ bhāktatva ukti prasaṅgāt atra śraddhā śruteḥ bhāktatva uktiḥ iti saṅgatiḥ atha ādi pada uktam sādhanam na anuṣṭheyam uta anuṣṭheyam iti cintā

original: tadarthaṃ bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gatirnāsti utāstīti tadarthaṃ tasminnetasminnagnau devāḥ śraddhāṃ juhvatīti upakrame śrutaśraddhāśabdaḥ kiṃ śraddhāmātrayuktaparaḥ uta śraddhayādbhiśca yuktajīvaparaḥ itisa| tadarthaṃ kiṃ upakramānurodhena "iti pañcamyāmāhutāvāpaḥ puruṣavacasaḥ' ityupasaṃhāro neya uta viparīta iti |
analyzed: tad artham bhūtānām jīvena saha gatiḥ na asti uta asti iti tad artham tasmin etasmin agnau devāḥ śraddhām juhvati iti upakrame śruta śraddhā śabdaḥ kim śraddhā mātra yukta paraḥ uta śraddhayā adbhiḥ ca yukta jīva paraḥ iti sa tad artham kim upakrama anurodhena iti pañcamyām āhutaḥ avāpaḥ puruṣa vacasaḥ iti upasaṃhāraḥ neyaḥ uta viparītaḥ iti

original: tadarthaṃ kimupakramaḥ prabala uta upasaṃhāra iti | ādye upakramasya yathāśrutārthatayā tadanurodhena upasaṃhārasya neyatvena bhūtagatau praśnottarasyāmānatvāt‌ bhūtānāṃ na sahagatiriti nānuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanamiti pūrvapakṣe phalam‌ |
analyzed: tad artham kim upakramaḥ prabalaḥ uta upasaṃhāraḥ iti ādye upakramasya yathāśruta artha tayā tad anurodhena upasaṃhārasya neyatvena bhūta gatau praśna uttarasya amāna tvāt bhūtānām na sahagatiḥ iti na anuṣṭheyam sādhanam iti pūrvapakṣe phalam

original: antye tu upasaṃhārasya tyātmakāp‌śabdānurodhena upakramasthaśraddhāśabdasya neyatvena praśnottarabalena bhūtānāṃ sahagatirityanuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanamiti siddhānte phalam‌ | pūrvapakṣastu | na bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gatiḥ |

original: asato'pi śaśaviṣāṇāderasatyatvena īśādhīnatvasya etena sarve vyākhyātā ityatroktāvapi ghaṭāditaulyena yogakṣemādirūpatadadhīnatvasya asato'nupapatteḥ | na cāsiddho hetuḥ | satyatve sādhakābhāvādbādhakabāhulyācca sva nārthānāṃ satyatve nityatvamanityatvaṃ vā vācyam‌ | ubhayathāpi prāgūrdhvamupalambhaprasaṅgāt |

original: "ya eṣu supteṣu' iti śrutau "etasmāddhayeva putro jāyate' iti śrutau ca sva nārthānāṃ īśakartṛtvasyoktyā kartrabhāvacodyasya tathā bāhyārthaghaṭādivat‌ sphuṭamanabhivyaktatvayuktyā "manogatāṃstu saṃskārān‌' iti smṛtyā ca bāhyopādānavilakṣaṇamānasavāsanopādānakatvāvagamena nirupādānakatvacodyasya cānavakāśāt‌ | sva nānāṃ

original: atra "sarvavedānta' naye trividhādhikāriṇāṃ yathāśaktiyatsarvaparijñānamuktaṃ tadayuktamuta yuktamiti cintā | tadatharṃ teṣāṃ svasvayogyaguṇānāmupāsanasya itastato nopasaṃhāryā utopasaṃhāryā iti | tadarthaṃ svasvayogyaguṇā ekaikatra vidyāyāmā nāyante atha neti | tadarthamekaikatra tattadyogyaguṇānāmanuktijñāpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu |

analyzed: eka ekatra tad tad yogya guṇāḥ na ucyante iti atra jñāpaka abhāvena eka ekatra eva tad tad apekṣita guṇa ukti sambhavena tad mātra parijñānena api sva sva yogya dhyāna viṣaya guṇānām buddhayā ārūḍha sambhavena kṛtyā abhāvāt na itas tatas dhyeya puṃguṇāḥ upasaṃhāryāḥ iti trayāṇām yathāśakti sarva parijñānam yuktam iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: vyāvartanāt‌ jñāpakāt‌ praśnaprativacanayoradhyāhāreṇa prakaraṇavicchedāt‌ "uttamatvaṃ hi devānām‌' iti smṛteśca satyanāmā viṣṇuḥ prāṇāduttama iti tuśabdo nādhyāhārakalpakaḥ "vijñānaṃ tveva' "matistveva' ityādau vakṣyamāṇadiśā bhedahīne'pi vastuni śravaṇena vyabhicārāditi codyantu "bhūmaḥ' naye nirastam‌ | nirāsakaprakāraśca candrikāyāṃ vyaktaḥ |
analyzed: vyāvartanāt jñāpakāt praśna prativacanayoḥ adhyāhāreṇa prakaraṇa vicchedāt uttama tvam hi devānām iti smṛteḥ ca satyanāmā viṣṇuḥ prāṇāt uttamaḥ iti tuśabdaḥ na adhyāhāra kalpakaḥ vijñānam tu eva matiḥ tu eva ityādau vakṣyamāṇa diśā bheda hīne api vastuni śravaṇena vyabhicārāt iti codyantu bhūmaḥ naye nirastam nirāsaka prakāraḥ ca candrikāyām vyaktaḥ

original: phalaṃ tvānandādaya ityatrokta ātmatvopāsanasamarthanam‌ ||
analyzed: phalam tu ānanda ādayaḥ iti atra uktaḥ ātma tva upāsana samarthanam

original: || oṃ saiva hi satyādaya oṃ || 23 ||
analyzed: om sā eva hi satya ādayaḥ om

original: atra prāgukte viṣṇoḥ prāṇāduttamatve viśeṣacintanātsaṅgatiḥ | prakṛtātprāṇāt‌ satyapadokto viṣṇurevottamaḥ atha bahavo'pyuttamāḥ santīti cintā | tadarthaṃ satyasyopari paṭhitānāṃ vijñānamatiśraddhāniṣṭhakṛtisukhabhūmāhaṃkārātmanāṃ navānāṃ kiṃ satyāt‌ parasparaṃ ca bheda utābheda iti | tadarthaṃ abhede jñāpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: atra prāgukte viṣṇoḥ prāṇāt uttama tve viśeṣa cintanāt saṅgatiḥ prakṛtāt prāṇāt satya pada uktaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva uttamaḥ atha bahavaḥ api uttamāḥ santi iti cintā tad artham satyasya upari paṭhitānām vijñāna mati śraddhā niṣṭha kṛti sukha bhūma ahaṃkāra ātmanām navānām kim satyāt parasparam ca bhedaḥ uta abhedaḥ iti tad artham abhede jñāpakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: satyādīnāmātmāntānāṃ abhede jñāpakābhāvāt‌ śabdāntaranyāyena bhedasyaiva nyāyyatvāt‌ prāṇātsatyādayo bahava uttamā iti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: satya ādīnām ātma antānām abhede jñāpaka abhāvāt śabda antara nyāyena bhedasya eva nyāyya tvāt prāṇāt satya ādayaḥ bahavaḥ uttamāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: vijñānādeḥ satyāditonyatve "satyaṃ bhagavo vijijñāsya' ityādi praśne vijñānāderukterasāṃgatyāpatteḥ tadanyathānupapattibalena "satyaṃ bhagavo vijijñāsya' ityasya satyaguṇajijñāsāparatve sati satyāvinābhūtavijñānoktiḥ |
analyzed: vijñāna ādeḥ satya āditaḥ nya tve satyam bhagavaḥ vijijñāsye ityādi praśne vijñāna ādeḥ ukteḥ asāṃgatya āpatteḥ tad anyathā anupapatti balena satyam bhagavaḥ vijijñāsye iti asya satya guṇa jijñāsā paratve sati satya avinābhūta vijñāna uktiḥ

original: evaṃ "vijñānaṃ bhagavo vijijñāsya' ityatrāpi vijñānaguṇajijñāsāyāṃ tadavinābhūtaguṇoktiparatvena sarveṣāmabhedasya nyāyaprāptatvāt‌ "satyādyā ahamantā yadguṇāḥ' ityādi smṛteśca teṣāmabhedāt‌ viṣṇureva prāṇāduttama iti || 23 ||
analyzed: evam vijñānam bhagavaḥ vijijñāsyaḥ iti atra api vijñāna guṇa jijñāsāyām tad avinābhūta guṇa ukti paratvena sarveṣām abhedasya nyāya prāpta tvāt satya ādyāḥ aham antāḥ yat guṇāḥ ityādi smṛteḥ ca teṣām abhedāt viṣṇuḥ eva prāṇāt uttamaḥ iti

original: || oṃ kāmāditaratra tatra cāyatanādibhyaḥ oṃ || 24 ||
analyzed: om kāmāt itaratra tatra ca āyatana ādibhyaḥ om

original: || oṃ ādarādalopaḥ oṃ || oṃ upasthitestadvacanāt‌ oṃ ||
analyzed: om ādarāt alopaḥ om om upasthiteḥ tad vacanāt om

original: evaṃ satyādeḥ sarvasya viṣṇutvoktau śriyopyadhikāritvāt‌ prāṇādūrdhvaṃ śriyo'pyadhyāhāraḥ syāt‌ | tathāca prāṇāvadhitvamadhikārivargasyoktamayuktamiti śaṅkanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra prāṇaviṣṇusannidhāpitā śrīḥ kimupāsanāyāmadhikārirī atha neti cintā | tadarthaṃ sā baddhā uta neti |
analyzed: evam satya ādeḥ sarvasya viṣṇu tva uktau śriyā api adhikāri tvāt prāṇāt ūrdhvam śriyā api adhyāhāraḥ syāt tathā ca prāṇa avadhi tvam adhikāri vargasya uktam ayuktam iti śaṅkanāt saṅgatiḥ atra prāṇa viṣṇu sannidhāpitā śrīḥ kim upāsanāyām adhikāri rī atha na iti cintā tad artham sā baddhā uta na iti

original: tadarthaṃ sītādirūpeṇa bhūmau bhavanādikaṃ jīvavaddehayogādirūpajanmādyeva uta prādurbhāvādirūpamiti | tadarthaṃ śriyo bhagavadarcanaṃ janmādihetukarmādibandhamocananimittaṃ uta muktavannirupādhikabhaktyatiśayanimittamiti | tadarthaṃ bhaktinimittatvakalpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: tad artham sītā ādi rūpeṇa bhūmau bhavana ādikam jīva vat deha yoga ādi rūpa janma ādi eva uta prādurbhāva ādi rūpam iti tad artham śriyaḥ bhagavat arcanam janma ādi hetu karma ādi bandha mocana nimittam uta mukta vat nirupādhika bhakti atiśaya nimittam iti tad artham bhakti nimitta tva kalpakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: "yadarcitaṃ brahmabhavādibhissuraiḥ śriyā ca devyā munibhiśca sātvataiḥ' ityādau śriyo'pi bhagavadupāsanā śrūyate | sā cetareṣāmiva bhagavatprītidvārā bandhamocanārthā | tasyāḥ kṛtakṛtyatve tadayogāt‌ | bhaktyatiśayanimittatve kalpakābhāvāt‌ | anyathā sāttvataprabhṛtīnāmapi sā tadarthā na syāt‌ |
analyzed: yat arcitam brahma bhava ādibhiḥ suraiḥ śriyā ca devyā munibhiḥ ca sātvataiḥ ityādau śriyāḥ api bhagavat upāsanā śrūyate sā ca itareṣām iva bhagavat prīti dvārā bandha mocana arthā tasyāḥ kṛtakṛtya tve tad ayogāt bhakti atiśaya nimitta tve kalpaka abhāvāt anyathā sāttvata prabhṛtīnām api sā tad arthā na syāt

original: evaṃ ca tadbalātsītārukmiṇyādirūpeṇa bhavanatirodhānādeḥ karmādhīnadehopādānatyāgarūpatvena itarajīvavat‌ baddhatvāvagamāt‌ baddhatve sati sādhutvācca adhikāriṇī evopāsanāyāṃ śrīriti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: evam ca tad balāt sītā rukmiṇī ādi rūpeṇa bhavana tirodhāna ādeḥ karma adhīna deha upādāna tyāga rūpatvena itara jīva vat baddha tva avagamāt baddha tve sati sādhu tvāt ca adhikāriṇī eva upāsanāyām śrīḥ iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: sarvāyatanetyādibhāṣyoktaśrutyādibalena nityaṃ bhagavatsambandhitvena atiśayitatatprasādāt‌ nityamuktatvāvagamāt‌ tadbalena bhūmau bhavanādeḥ īśecchādhīnasvecchāmātrahetukatayā prādurbhāvarūpatvena kamarādhīnadehayogādirūpatvābhāvāvagamena "yathāśrīrnityamuktāpi' iti smṛtyā cārcanasya bhaktyatiśayanimittatvakalpanānnādhikāriṇī śrīriti |
analyzed: sarva āyatana ityādi bhāṣya ukta śruti ādi balena nityam bhagavat sambandhi tvena atiśayita tad prasādāt nitya mukta tva avagamāt tad balena bhūmau bhavana ādeḥ īśa icchā adhīna sva icchā mātra hetuka tayā prādurbhāva rūpatvena kamara adhīna deha yoga ādi rūpatva abhāva avagamena yathā śrīḥ nitya muktā api iti smṛtyā ca arcanasya bhakti atiśaya nimitta tva kalpanāt na adhikāriṇī śrīḥ iti

original: phalaṃ tu upāsakānāṃ prāṇāvadhitvasamarthanam‌ || 24 ||
analyzed: phalam tu upāsakānām prāṇa avadhi tva samarthanam

original: || oṃ tannirdhāraṇārthaniyamastaddṛṣyeḥ pṛthagghyapratibandhaḥ phalam‌ oṃ || 25 ||
analyzed: om tad nirdhāraṇa artha niyamaḥ tat dṛṣyeḥ pṛthak hi apratibandhaḥ phalam om

original: pūrvatra śriyaḥ kṛtārthatā phalābhāve'pi ādarādupāsanā'lopoktau tarhyakṛtārthānāṃ phalābhāvāt‌ śravaṇādisamastopāsanasya lopa eva syāditi śaṅkanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra śravaṇamananadhyānarūpatrividhamupāsanaṃ vyastaṃ kāryamuta samastamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ trividhasyāpi phalaṃ nāstyutāstīti |
analyzed: pūrvatra śriyaḥ kṛtārtha tā phala abhāve pi ādarāt upāsana alopa uktau tarhi akṛtārthānām phala abhāvāt śravaṇa ādi samasta upāsanasya lopaḥ eva syāt iti śaṅkanāt saṅgatiḥ atra śravaṇa manana dhyāna rūpa trividham upāsanam vyastam kāryam uta samastam iti cintā tad artham trividhasya api phalam na asti uta asti iti

original: tadarthaṃ tritayasyāpi tatsādhanatve manopayogau na sta uta sta iti | pūrvapakṣastu | upāsanaṃ hi bhagavaddarśanārthaṃ "draṣyavyaḥ' śruteḥ | tasya ca śravaṇamananābhyāṃ vā dhyānenaiva vopapattau na tritayasādhyatve pramāṇamasti | "draṣyavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ' iti śrutistu vaikalpikasādhanavidhānenāpyupapannā |
analyzed: tad artham tritayasya api tad sādhana tve manaḥ upayogau na staḥ uta staḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu upāsanam hi bhagavat darśana artham draṣyavyaḥ śruteḥ tasya ca śravaṇa mananābhyām vā dhyānena eva vā upapattau na tritaya sādhya tve pramāṇam asti draṣyavyaḥ śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ nididhyāsitavyaḥ iti śrutiḥ tu vaikalpika sādhana vidhānena api upapannā

original: kiṃ ca na tritayasyopayogo'sti | na cājñātajñāpanena śravaṇasya, tanniyamajananena manasya, dṛśijananena dhyānasyopayoga iti yuktam‌ | tathāca tritayasyāpi pṛthaktvaphalatvena darśanoddeśena tritayavidhānānupapatteḥ | evaṃ ca pramāṇopayegayorabhāve darśanasya
analyzed: kim ca na tritayasya upayogaḥ usti na ca ajñāta jñāpanena śravaṇasya tad niyama jananena manasya dṛśi jananena dhyānasya upayogaḥ iti yuktam tathā ca tritayasya api pṛthaktva phala tvena darśana uddeśena tritaya vidhāna anupapatteḥ evam ca pramāṇa upayegayoḥ abhāve darśanasya

original: tritayasādhyatvābhāvena phalābhāvānna samastopāsanaṃ kāryamiti | siddhāntastu | "draṣyavya' iti śrutau darśanoddeśena tritayasyāpi vidhānādvikalpadyotakaśabdābhāvena samuccayasādhanatāvagamāt‌ samuccitānāmeva dṛśirūpaphalahetutritayaṃ kāryameva | nacopayogābhāvaḥ śaṅkayaḥ |
analyzed: tritaya sādhya tva abhāvena phala abhāvāt na samasta upāsanam kāryam iti siddhāntaḥ tu draṣyavyaḥ iti śrutau darśana uddeśena tritayasya api vidhānāt vikalpa dyotaka śabda abhāvena samuccaya sādhanatā avagamāt samuccitānām eva dṛśi rūpa phala hetu tritayam kāryam eva na ca upayoga abhāvaḥ śaṅkayaḥ

original: darśanaṃ prati dhyānasyaiva hetutve'pi dhyānasya dṛśijanane'pekṣitāyāḥ pratibandhakājñānasaṃśayaviparyayanivṛtteḥ sampādanena śravaṇamananayorupayogitvāditi | phalaṃ tu jijñāsāsūtroktatritayasamarthanam‌ || 25 ||
analyzed: darśanam prati dhyānasya eva hetu tve pi dhyānasya dṛśi janana apekṣitāyāḥ pratibandhaka ajñāna saṃśaya viparyaya nivṛtteḥ sampādanena śravaṇa mananayoḥ upayogi tvāt iti phalam tu jijñāsā sūtra ukta tritaya samarthanam

original: || oṃ pradānavadeva hi taduktam‌ oṃ || 26 ||
analyzed: om pradāna vat eva hi tat uktam om

original: pradhānakartavyatvasiddhau tadaṅgamihanirūpyata iti vā pūrvaṃ śravaṇāditrayasyāpi phalamuktaṃ ihāṃgamucyata iti vā dṛśi hetordhyānasya śravaṇamananākhyamaṅgamuktaṃ iha tritayasyāpyaṃgamucyata iti vā saṅgatiḥ | atra prakṛtaśravaṇāditrayaṃ yathākathaṃcidanuṣṭhitaṃ jñānaheturuta prītipūrvakagurūpadeśayuktamiti cintā |
analyzed: pradhāna kartavya tva siddhau tat aṅgam iha nirūpyate iti vā pūrvam śravaṇa ādi trayasya api phalam uktam iha aṃgam ucyate iti vā dṛśi hetoḥ dhyānasya śravaṇa manana ākhyam aṅgam uktam iha tritayasya api aṃgam ucyate iti vā saṅgatiḥ atra prakṛta śravaṇa ādi trayam yathā kathaṃcid anuṣṭhitam jñāna hetuḥ uta prīti pūrvaka guru upadeśa yuktam iti cintā

original: tadarthaṃ tasya tādṛśagurūpadeśayuktatvena phalahetutve sādhakaṃ nāsti śrutivirodhādibādhakaṃ cāstyuta viparītamiti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: tad artham tasya tādṛśa guru upadeśa yuktatvena phala hetutve sādhakam nā asti śruti virodha ādi bādhakam ca asti uta viparītam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: gurūpadeśayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ dṛśiheturityatra pramāṇābhāvāt‌ pratyuta draṣyavya iti śrutau dṛśyuddeśena śravaṇāditrayasyaiva vidhānena tadvirodharūpasya jñānasya guruprasādādhīnatve jñānino'pi mokṣasya tadadhīnatvaprasaṃgena kadācidgurukopena mokṣābhāvasyāpyāpattyā "aniyamassarveṣām‌' ityukta bhaṃgarūpasya bādhakasya ca sattvācca na
analyzed: guru upadeśa yuktam eva śravaṇa ādikam dṛśi hetuḥ iti atra pramāṇa abhāvāt pratyuta draṣyavyaḥ iti śrutau dṛśi uddeśena śravaṇa ādi trayasya eva vidhānena tad virodha rūpasya jñānasya guru prasāda adhīna tve jñāninaḥ api mokṣasya tad adhīna tva prasaṃgena kadācid guru kopena mokṣa abhāvasya api āpattyā aniyamaḥ sarveṣām iti ukta bhaṃga rūpasya bādhakasya ca sattvāt ca na anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra

original: gurupradānayuktaṃ jñānahetuḥ kiṃtu kevalameva śravaṇādikam‌ | naca gurukopo na mokṣapratibandhakaḥ | tathātve gurupradānamapi jñāne'kiṃcitkaramiti | siddhāntastu | prītipūrvakagurūpadeśarūpāṃgayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ jñānaheturna kevalam‌ |
analyzed: guru pradāna yuktam jñāna hetuḥ kiṃtu kevalam eva śravaṇa ādikam na ca guru kopaḥ na mokṣa pratibandhakaḥ tathātve guru pradānam api jñānekiṃcitkaram iti siddhāntaḥ tu prīti pūrvaka guru upadeśa rūpa aṃga yuktam eva śravaṇa ādikam jñāna hetuḥ na kevalam

original: "ācāryavān‌ puruṣo veda' iti śrutau jñānasya guruprasādādhīnatvāvagamena tena vinā śravaṇādimātreṇa jñānāsiddheḥ | "samyaglakṣaṇasampanno yaddadyātsuprasannadhīḥ | śiṣyāya satyaṃ bhavati tatsarvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ' iti "nātiprasannahṛdayo yaddadyādgururapyasau | na tatsatyaṃ bhavettasmādarcanīyo gurussadā' iti smṛteśca |
analyzed: ācāryavān puruṣaḥ vedaḥ iti śrutau jñānasya guru prasāda adhīna tva avagamena tena vinā śravaṇa ādi mātreṇa jñāna asiddheḥ samyak lakṣaṇa sampannaḥ yat dadyāt su prasanna dhīḥ śiṣyāya satyam bhavati tat sarvam na atra saṃśayaḥ iti na ati prasanna hṛdayaḥ yat dadyāt guruḥ api asau na tat satyam bhavet tasmāt arcanīyaḥ guruḥ sadā iti smṛteḥ ca

original: naca draṣyavya iti śrutivirodho bādhakaḥ | śravaṇādeḥ pradhānasādhanatvādgurudānasya tadaṅgatvāt‌ somarasādhyāyagasya dṛḍhamuṣyinipīḍanādhīnatve'pi tasya tadaṅgatvavat‌ jñānasya gurupradānādhīnatve'pi tasya jñānahetuśravaṇādyaṅgatvopapatteḥ |
analyzed: naca draṣyavyaḥ iti śruti virodhaḥ bādhakaḥ śravaṇa ādeḥ pradhāna sādhanatvāt guru dānasya tad aṅgatvāt somarasa adhyāya gasya dṛḍha muṣyi nipīḍana adhīna tve api tasya tad aṅgatva vat jñānasya guru pradāna adhīna tve api tasya jñāna hetu śravaṇa ādi aṅgatva upapatteḥ

original: aṅgasya ca pradhānasādhanena saha tulyakakṣyatayā vidhānābhāve'pi dṛḍhamuṣyinipīḍanāderiva atharādvacanāntarādvā prāptatvena pradānasya draṣyavyaśrutyanumatatvāt‌ | naca kadācitkopena jñānasya vā jñānino mokṣasya vā'bhāvāpāto bādhaka iti vācyam‌ | jñānamokṣayorīśvaraklaptatvena tadabhāvāyogāt‌ |
analyzed: aṅgasya ca pradhāna sādhanena saha tulya kakṣya tayā vidhāna abhāve pi dṛḍha muṣyi nipīḍana ādeḥ iva atharāt vacana antarāt vā prāptatvena pradānasya na ca kadācid kopena jñānasya vā jñāninaḥ mokṣasya vā abhāva āpātaḥ bādhakaḥ iti vācyam jñāna mokṣayoḥ īśvara klapta tvena tad abhāva ayogāt

original: guruśāpādeśca "jñānino guruśāpepi' ityādi smṛtyā jñānādihrāsahetutvena sāphalyopapatteriti | phalaṃ tu itaretvarthasāmānyāt‌' ityatrokta gurusāpekṣatvasya samarthanam‌ || 26 ||
analyzed: guru śāpa ādeḥ ca jñāninaḥ guru śāpe pi ityādi smṛtyā jñāna ādi hrāsa hetutvena sāphalya upapatteḥ iti phalam tu guru sāpekṣa tvasya samarthanam 26

original: || oṃ liṅgabhūyastvāttaddhi balīyastadapi oṃ || 27 ||
analyzed: om liṅga bhūyaḥ tvāt tat hi balīyaḥ tat api om

original: pūrvaprakṛtāṅgāṅginomardhye'trāṅgasya balavatvasādhanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra śravaṇādisādhanaṃ tadaṃgagurupradānaṃ ceti dvayaṃ samabalaṃ utānyataradbalavaditi cintā | tadarthaṃ puruṣatvasāmyaṃ guruśiṣyaprayatnayoḥ sāmyāpādakaṃ bhavatyuta neti | tathānyataradbalavadityatra śiṣyaprayatno balavānatha gurudānaṃ balavaditi cintā |
analyzed: pūrva prakṛta aṅga aṅginoḥ balavatva sādhanāt saṅgatiḥ atra śravaṇa ādi sādhanam tad aṃga guru pradānam ca iti dvayam sama balam uta anyatarat balavat iti cintā tad artham puruṣatva sāmyam guru śiṣya prayatnayoḥ sāmya āpādakam bhavati uta na iti tathā anyatarat balavat iti atra śiṣya prayatnaḥ balavān atha guru dānam balavat iti cintā

original: tadarthaṃ pradānasya balavattve sādhakaṃ nāsti bādhakaṃ cāstyathaviparītamiti | pūrvapakṣastu | pradānasya balavattve kvāpītikartavyatāyāḥ sādhanādapi prābalyādaśarnena itikartavyatvabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt‌ śravaṇādivaiyarthyaprasaṅgācca bādhakābhāvāt‌ sādhakābhāvācca na pradānaṃ balavat‌ kintu śravaṇādyeva pradhānasādhanatvāt‌ |
analyzed: tad artham pradānasya balavat tve sādhakam na asti bādhakam ca asti atha viparītam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu pradānasya balavat tve kvāpi itikartavya tāyāḥ sādhanāt api prābalyāt aśarnena itikartavya tva bhaṅga prasaṅgāt śravaṇa ādi vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt ca bādhaka abhāvāt sādhaka abhāvāt ca na pradānam balavat kintu śravaṇa ādi eva pradhāna sādhana tvāt

original: māstu vā balavat‌ guruśiṣyayoḥ puruṣatvāviśeṣāt‌ gurupradānaṃ śiṣyaprayatnaśca dvayaṃ samameva syāt‌ | nahi kaścinnyūnādhikabhāve'pi viśeṣo'stīti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: mā astu vā balavat guru śiṣyayoḥ puruṣa tva aviśeṣāt guru pradānam śiṣya prayatnaḥ ca dvayam samam eva syāt nahi kaścid nyūna adhika bhāve pi viśeṣaḥ usti iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: na tāvatsāmyaṃ yuktaṃ puruṣatve gurutvaśiṣyatvavat‌ tatprayatnayorapi nyūnādhikabhāvasambhavena puruṣatvamātrasyāprayojakatvāt‌ nyūnādhikabhāve pradānasyaivādhikyamuktam‌ liṅgabāhulyarūpasādhakabhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: na tāvat sāmyam yuktam puruṣa tve guru tva śiṣya tva vat tad prayatnayoḥ api nyūna adhika bhāva sambhavena puruṣa tva mātrasya aprayojaka tvāt nyūna adhika bhāve pradānasya eva ādhikyam uktam liṅga bāhulya rūpa sādhaka bhāvāt

original: hiṃsāyāḥ pāpajananaśaktāyā api yāgīyahiṃsāyāḥ prokṣaṇāṃjanaparyagnikaraṇādītikartavyatābalena puṇyajanakatvadarśanena tatretikartavyatāyāḥ prābalyavat‌ atra pradānasya prābalye aṅgatvabhaṅgaprasaṅgābhāvāt‌ | śrotavya ityādi śrutyā "guruprasādo balavān‌' ityādi smṛtyā ca śravaṇāderapyāvaśyakatvena tadvaiyarthyābhāvācca bādhakābhāvācceti |
analyzed: hiṃsāyāḥ pāpa janana śaktāyāḥ api yāgīya hiṃsāyāḥ prokṣaṇa aṃjana paryagnikaraṇa ādi itikartavya tā balena puṇya janaka tva darśanena tatra itikartavya tāyāḥ prābalya vat atra pradānasya prābalye aṅga tva bhaṅga prasaṅga abhāvāt śrotavyaḥ ityādi śrutyā guru prasādaḥ balavān ityādi smṛtyā ca śravaṇa ādeḥ api āvaśyaka tvena tad vaiyarthya abhāvāt ca bādhaka abhāvāt ca iti

original: liṅgabāhulyaṃ ca ṭīkādau vyaktam‌ | phalaṃ tu setikartavyatvasyaiva śravaṇāderjñānahetutvarūpaprāguktaprameyasamarthanam‌ | anyathā kvacidguroranapekṣitatvaprasaṅgena prāguktamayuktaṃ syāditi || 27 ||
analyzed: liṅga bāhulyam ca ṭīkā ādau vyaktam phalam tu sa itikartavyatvasya eva śravaṇa ādeḥ jñāna hetutva rūpa prāgukta prameya samarthanam anyathā kvacid guroḥ anapekṣitatva prasaṅgena prāguktam ayuktam syāt iti

original: || oṃ pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇātsyātkriyāmānasavat‌ oṃ || 28 ||
analyzed: om pūrva vikalpaḥ prakaraṇāt syāt kriyā mānasa vat om

original: || oṃ atideśācca oṃ ||
analyzed: om atideśāt ca om

original: yatprasādo balavānityuktaṃ sa gururatra cintyata iti saṅgatiḥ | atra prakṛto guruḥ kiṃ pūrvaprāpta eveti niyamo'thānyo'pi gṛhītuṃ śakya iti cintā | tadarthaṃ pūrvatyāge kāraṇaṃ nāsti bādhakaṃ cāsti uta viparītamiti | tathā anyo'pi grāhya iti pakṣe sa kiṃ yaḥ kaściduta pūrvasmādanapakṛṣyaḥ samagrānugrahakartaiveti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: yat prasādaḥ balavān iti uktam sa guruḥ atra cintyate iti saṅgatiḥ atra prakṛtaḥ guruḥ kim pūrva prāptaḥ eva iti gṛhītum śakyaḥ iti cintā tad artham pūrva tyāge kāraṇam na asti bādhakam ca asti uta viparītam iti tathā anyaḥ api grāhyaḥ iti pakṣe sa kim yaḥ kaścid uta pūrvasmāt anapakṛṣyaḥ samagra anugraha kartā eva iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: śubhalābhārthaṃ hi gurusvīkāro bhavati | sa ca pūrvaprāptaguruṇaiva bhaviṣyatīti tattyāge kāraṇābhāvāt‌ | " gurumantraparityāgī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet‌' iti doṣaśravaṇarūpabādhakācca pūvarprāpta eva guruḥ natvanyo'pi grāhya iti | anyo'pi grāhya iti pakṣe ca niyāmakābhāvādyaḥ kaścideveti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: śubha lābha artham hi guru svīkāraḥ bhavati sa ca pūrva prāpta guruṇā eva bhaviṣyati iti tad tyāge kāraṇa abhāvāt guru mantra parityāgī rauravam narakam vrajet iti doṣa śravaṇa rūpa bādhakāt ca eva guruḥ na tu anyaḥ api grāhyaḥ iti anyaḥ api grāhyaḥ iti pakṣe ca niyāmaka abhāvāt yaḥ kaścid eva iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: guruparigraho hi na kevalaṃ kiṃcicchubhalābhārthaṃ kintu yāvadapekṣitasvayogyaśubhalābhārtham‌ | tasya yadi pūrvagṛhīto na samarthaḥ tarhi svāpekṣitālābhaprasaṅgena samagrānugrahārthatvarūpakāṇasattvādanyo'pi guruḥ svīkāryaḥ | so'pi na yādṛśatādṛśaḥ kintu svasmādanapakṛṣyaḥ samagrānugrahakartaiva |
analyzed: guru parigrahaḥ hi na kevalam kiṃcid śubha lābha artham kintu yāvat apekṣita sva yogya śubha lābha artham tasya yadi pūrva gṛhītaḥ na samarthaḥ tarhi sva apekṣita alābha prasaṅgena samagra anugraha artha tva rūpa kāṇa sattvāt anyaḥ api guruḥ svīkāryaḥ saḥ api na yādṛśa tādṛśaḥ kintu svasmāt anapakṛṣyaḥ samagra anugraha kartā eva

original: sa ca samaścet‌ pūrvānujñayā svīkāryo na veti vikalpaḥ samaphalayordhyānayoriva na tu svīkārya eveti niyamaḥ | uttamaścetpūrvānujñāṃ vinaiva svīkāryaḥ syāt‌ | sarvasyoktārthasya "pūrvasmāduttamo labdhaḥ' iti smṛtyā "samagrānugrahaṃ kaścit‌' iti smṛtyā ca siddhatvāt‌ "brahmopāsva' iti śrutau pūrvaguruṇaiva svasamottamasvīkārāyātidiśyamānatvācca |
analyzed: sa ca samaḥ ced pūrva anujñayā svīkāryaḥ na vā iti vikalpaḥ sama phalayoḥ dhyānayoḥ iva na tu svīkāryaḥ eva iti niyamaḥ uttamaḥ ced pūrva anujñām vinā eva svīkāryaḥ syāt sarvasya ukta arthasya pūrvasmāt uttamaḥ labdhaḥ iti smṛtyā samagra anugraham kaścid iti smṛtyā ca siddha tvāt brahma upāsva iti śrutau pūrva guruṇā eva sva sama uttama svīkārāya atidiśyamāna tvāt ca

original: naca doṣavacanavirodhaḥ | tasyādhamasvīkāraviṣayakatvena vyarthasvīkāraviṣayakatvena pūrvānujñābhāvaviṣayakatvena sāvakāśatvāditi | phalaṃ tu itaretvityatroktārthasya sarvajñagurūktaprakāreṇa guṇādidhyānaṃ kāryamityasya samarthanam‌ || 28 ||
analyzed: naca doṣa vacana virodhaḥ tasya adhama svīkāra viṣayaka tvena vyartha svīkāra viṣayaka tvena pūrva anujñā bhāva viṣayaka tvena sāvakāśa tvāt iti phalam tu itare tu iti atra ukta arthasya sarvajña guru ukta prakāreṇa guṇa ādi dhyānam kāryam iti asya samarthanam

original: || oṃ vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇāt‌ oṃ || 29 ||
analyzed: om vidyā eva tu nirdhāraṇāt om

original: || oṃ darśanācca oṃ ||
analyzed: om darśanāt ca om

original: yasyopāsanasya gurupradānarūpetikartavyatāphalabhedādhikāridhyeyādikaṃ tasya laghūpāyakarmahetutāvākyena muktihetutvānirṇayāt‌ sarvaṃ prāguktaṃ abhitticitrāyitamiti śaṅkanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra prakṛtaṃ śravaṇādyupāsanaṃ na kāryamuta kāryamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ tasya jñānadvārā muktihetunirṇayo na sambhavatyatha sambhavatīti |
analyzed: yasya upāsanasya guru pradāna rūpa itikartavyatā phala bheda adhikāri dhyeya ādikam tasya laghu upāya karma hetutā vākyena mukti hetutva anirṇayāt sarvam prāk uktam abhitticitrāyitam iti śaṅkanāt saṅgatiḥ atra prakṛtam śravaṇa ādi upāsanam na kāryam uta kāryam iti cintā tad artham tasya jñāna dvārā mukti hetu nirṇayaḥ na sambhavati atha sambhavati iti

original: tadarthaṃ karmahetutvavākyānāṃ "bhāktaṃ vā' ityatra paramparayā muktihetutvādirūpabhāktatvavarṇanaṃ ayuktamuta yuktamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ karmaṇaiveti tṛtīyayā tasya sākṣānmuktihetutvabodhanasyāpavādakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | tathā jñānadvārā muktihetutvanirṇayapakṣe kiṃ parokṣajñānadvāramātreṇa uta aparokṣajñānadvāramātreṇāpīti | pūvarpakṣastu |
analyzed: tad artham karma hetu tva vākyānām bhāktam vā iti atra paramparayā mukti hetu tva ādi rūpa bhākta tva varṇanam ayuktam uta yuktam iti cintā tad artham karmaṇā eva iti tṛtīyayā tasya sākṣāt mukti hetu tva bodhanasya apavādakam na asti uta asti iti tathā jñāna dvārā mukti hetu tva nirṇaya pakṣe kim parokṣa jñāna dvāra mātreṇa uta aparokṣa jñāna dvāra mātreṇa api iti pūvarpakṣaḥ tu

original: "karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ' ityādau avadhāraṇasya vakṣyamāṇadiśā sāvakāśatve'pi tṛtīyāvibhaktyā karmaṇaḥ saṃsiddhiśabditamuktiṃ prati sākṣāddhetutvāvagamasyāpavādakasya pramāṇasya kasyacidabhāvāt‌ "tarati śokamātmavit‌' ityādeḥ jñānasya muktihetutāmātraprāpakatayā karmaṇo muktihetutvānapavādakatvāt‌ |
analyzed: karmaṇā eva hi saṃsiddhim āsthitāḥ janaka ādayaḥ ityādau avadhāraṇasya vakṣyamāṇa diśā sāvakāśa tve pi tṛtīyā vibhaktyā karmaṇaḥ saṃsiddhi śabdita muktim prati sākṣāt hetutva avagamasya apavādakasya pramāṇasya kasyacid abhāvāt tarati śokam ātma vid ityādeḥ jñānasya mukti hetutā mātra prāpakatayā karmaṇaḥ mukti hetutva anapavādaka tvāt

original: evaṃ ca nirapavādakasākṣānmuktihetubodhakavākyabalena karmaṇo'pi sākṣānmuktihetutvāvagamena "bhāktaṃ vā'nātmavittvāt‌' iti tṛtīyādyapāde karmaṇo muktihetutvaṃ gauṇamiti varṇanasyāyuktatvāt‌ jñānadvārā śravaṇādyupāsanameva muktiheturiti nirṇayāsambhavāt‌ laghūpāye sati gurūpāyasya niśśaṅkamanuṣṭhānāyogācca na kāryamupāsanamiti |
analyzed: evam ca nirapavādaka sākṣāt mukti hetu bodhaka vākya balena karmaṇaḥ api sākṣāt mukti hetutva avagamena bhāktam vā anātma vid tvāt iti tṛtīya ādya pāde karmaṇaḥ mukti hetutvam gauṇam iti varṇanasya ayukta tvāt jñāna dvārā śravaṇa ādi upāsanam eva mukti hetuḥ iti nirṇaya asambhavāt laghu upāye sati guru upāyasya niśśaṅkam anuṣṭhāna ayogāt ca na kāryam upāsanam iti

original: māstu vā jñānadvāropāsanaṃ muktihetuḥ tathā'pi "tamevaṃ vidvān‌' iti śrutyā aparokṣasyaiva muktihetutvāvagamāt‌ tasya ca śravaṇādinaiva siddhe dhyānaṃ na sarvathā kāryameveti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: mā astu vā jñāna dvāra upāsanam mukti hetuḥ tathā api tam evam vidvān iti śrutyā aparokṣasya eva mukti hetutva avagamāt tasya ca śravaṇa ādinā eva siddhe dhyānam na sarvathā kāryam eva iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "nānyaḥ panthāḥ' iti sāvadhāraṇahetutvavacanasya karmavacanādapi balavattvena tena sākṣātkarmahetutvasyāpoditatayā karmaṇaivetyāderapi paramparayā kathaṃcinmuktihetutvasya prāguktarītyā varṇanīyatvāt‌ jñānadvārā muktihetutvasyopāsane nirṇayasambhavāt‌ kāryamevopāsanam‌ |
analyzed: na anyaḥ panthāḥ iti sāvadhāraṇa hetutva vacanasya karma vacanāt api balavat tvena tena sākṣāt karma hetutvasya apodita tayā karmaṇā eva ityādeḥ api paramparayā kathaṃcid mukti hetutvasya prāgukta rītyā varṇanīya tvāt jñāna dvārā mukti hetutvasya upāsane nirṇaya sambhavāt kāryam eva upāsanam

original: dvārabhūtaṃ jñānamapi na parokṣamātraṃ kintu "dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ mucyate' ityādi śrutibalena vidvāniti śruterapi aparokṣaparatvādaparokṣajñānamapīti śravaṇāditritayamapi kāryameveti | smṛtirapi sāvadhāraṇetyetadagre nirasiṣyate | phalaṃ tu prāguktasamarthanam‌ || 29 ||
analyzed: dvāra bhūtam jñānam api na parokṣa mātram kintu dṛṣṭvā eva tam mucyate ityādi śruti balena vidvān iti śruteḥ api aparokṣa paratvāt aparokṣa jñānam api iti śravaṇa ādi tritayam api kāryam eva iti smṛtiḥ api sāvadhāraṇā iti etat agre nirasiṣyate phalam tu prāc ukta samarthanam

original: || oṃ śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādhaḥ oṃ || 30 ||
analyzed: om śruti ādi balīyaḥ tvāt ca na bādhaḥ om

original: yadi śruteḥ sāvadhāraṇatvena balavattvaṃ tarhi smṛterapi tathātvāt‌ āptavākyatvācca balavattvamiti śaṅkanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra jñānaphalatvena pūrvatraprakṛto mokṣaḥ kiṃ karmasādhyo'tha jñānasādhya iti cintā | tadarthaṃ "karmaṇaiva' iti smṛtiḥ "nānyaḥ panthāḥ' iti śrutito'pi prabalā uta neti |
analyzed: yadi śruteḥ sāvadhāraṇa tvena balavat tvam tarhi smṛteḥ api tathātvāt āpta vākya tvāt ca balavat tvam iti śaṅkanāt saṅgatiḥ atra jñāna phala tvena pūrvatra prakṛtaḥ mokṣaḥ kim karma sādhyaḥ utha jñāna sādhyaḥ iti cintā tad artham karmaṇā eva iti smṛtiḥ na anyaḥ panthāḥ iti śrutitaḥ api prabalā uta na iti

original: tadarthaṃ karmaṇaivetyavadhāraṇaṃ niravakāśamuta sāvakāśamiti | tadarthaṃ sāvakāśakalpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu | karmasādhyo mokṣaḥ karmaṇaiti smṛteḥ | naca sāvadhāraṇaśrutibādhitā satī smṛtiḥ durbaleti vācyam‌ | smṛterapi sāvadhāraṇatvāt‌ | naca tadayogavyavacchedakatayā sāvakāśaṃ kalpakābhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: tad artham karmaṇā eva iti avadhāraṇam niravakāśam uta sa avakāśam iti tad artham sa avakāśa kalpakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu karma sādhyaḥ mokṣaḥ karmaṇā eti smṛteḥ na ca sāvadhāraṇa śruti bādhitā satī smṛtiḥ durbalā iti vācyam smṛteḥ api sāvadhāraṇa tvāt na ca tad ayoga vyavacchedaka tayā sa avakāśam kalpaka abhāvāt

original: naca śrutivirodhe daurbalyaṃ smṛteḥ śrutereva ca prābalyamiti "virodhetvanapekṣaṃ syāt‌' iti pūrvatantre siddhamiti vācyam‌ | smṛteḥ śrutimūlatvena prāmāṇyapakṣa eva hi tat‌ | karmaṇaiveti smṛteśca bhagavadvākyatvenaiva prāmāṇyopagamenāptavākyatayā sāvadhāraṇatayā ca prābalyena vidyāśruterbādhāditi | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: na ca śruti virodhe daurbalyam smṛteḥ śruteḥ eva ca prābalyam iti virodhe tu anapekṣam syāt iti pūrva tantre siddham iti vācyam smṛteḥ śruti mūla tvena prāmāṇya pakṣe eva hi tat karmaṇā eva iti smṛteḥ ca bhagavat vākya tvena eva prāmāṇya upagamena āpta vākya tayā sāvadhāraṇa tayā ca prābalyena vidyā śruteḥ bādhāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: jñānasādhya eva mokṣaḥ na karmasādhyaḥ | jñānasādhyatve balavacchatiliṅgopapattismṛtīnāṃ bhāvāt‌ niravakāśāvadhāraṇayuktatvena śrutebarlavattvāt‌ | tathā bahukarmakṛtopīndrasya duḥkhāsambhinnasukharūpamokṣārthaṃ tattvajñānaprārthanaliṅgasya "indro'śvamedhān‌' iti śrutiprasiddhasya balavattvāt‌ |
analyzed: jñāna sādhyaḥ eva mokṣaḥ na karma sādhyaḥ jñāna sādhya tve balavat śati liṅga upapatti smṛtīnām bhāvāt niravakāśa avadhāraṇa yuktatvena tathā bahu karma kṛta upi indrasya duḥkha asambhinna sukha rūpa mokṣa artham tattva jñāna prārthana liṅgasya indra uśvamedhān iti śruti prasiddhasya balavat tvāt

original: tathā'pi utpattināśavatphalatvenāvadhṛtakarmaṇā nityapumartho na bhavatītyupapatteśca | "nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena' iti śrutisiddhatayā nirdoṣatayā ca prabalatvāt‌ | "karmaṇā badhyate' iti smṛteśca bhagavadvākyatayā yuktimattayā ca balavattvāt‌ |
analyzed: tathā api utpatti nāśa vat phalatvena avadhṛta karmaṇā nitya pumarthaḥ na bhavati iti upapatteḥ ca na asti akṛtaḥ kṛtena iti śruti siddha tayā nirdoṣa tayā ca prabala tvāt karmaṇā badhyate iti smṛteḥ ca bhagavat vākyatayā yuktimat tayā ca balavat tvāt

original: evaṃ balavatāṃ mokṣasya jñānasādhyatvanirṇāyakānāṃ anekasādhakānāṃ bhāvādeva karmaṇaivetyavadhāraṇasya karmaṇā saṃsiddhimāsthitā evetyayogavyavacchedakatayā sāvakāśatvāt‌ smṛteḥ na karmasādhyatvāpādane prāmāṇyamiti | phalaṃ tūpāsanākartavyatvasamarthanam‌ || 30 ||
analyzed: evam balavatām mokṣasya jñāna sādhya tva nirṇāyakānām aneka sādhakānām bhāvāt eva karmaṇā evā iti avadhāraṇasya karmaṇā saṃsiddhim āsthitāḥ eva iti ayoga vyavacchedaka tayā sāvakāśa tvāt smṛteḥ na karma sādhya tva āpādane prāmāṇyam iti phalam tu upāsanā kartavya tva samarthanam

original: || oṃ anubandhādibhyaḥ oṃ || 31 ||
analyzed: om anubandha ādibhyaḥ om

original: "darśanācca' iti pūvartra darśanasya muktihetutayā pūrvanaye nirṇītatvena prakṛtatvāt‌ tasya bhaktyādisādhyatvamatrocyata iti saṅgatiḥ | prakṛtaṃ darśanaṃ kiṃ bhaktyādinā vinā pradānopetaśravaṇādimātrāt‌ bhavati uta neti cintā | tadarthaṃ darśanahetūpāsanaṃ bhaktyādinā vināpi bhavadapi phalaparyavasāyi uta neti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: darśanāt ca iti darśanasya mukti hetutayā pūrva naye nirṇīta tvena prakṛta tvāt tasya bhakti ādi sādhya tvam atra ucyate iti saṅgatiḥ prakṛtam darśanam kim bhakti ādinā vinā pradāna upeta śravaṇa ādi mātrāt bhavati uta na iti cintā tad artham darśana hetu upāsanam bhakti ādinā vinā api bhavat api phala paryavasāyi uta na iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: bhaktyādinā vinā pradānayuktaśravaṇādimātrādeva darśanaṃ bhaviṣyati | "samyaglakṣaṇasampannaḥ' ityādi smṛtyā guruprasādāsādhyasya kasyāpyabhāvāt‌ | na copāsanameva bhaktyādihīnasya neti yuktam‌ | dveṣeṇāpi tatsambhavāt‌ | naca dveṣayutopāsanaṃ na phalaparyavasāyīti yuktam‌ |
analyzed: bhakti ādinā vinā pradāna yukta śravaṇa ādi mātrāt eva darśanam bhaviṣyati samyak lakṣaṇa sampannaḥ ityādi smṛtyā guru prasāda asādhyasya kasya api abhāvāt na ca upāsanam eva bhakti ādi hīnasya na iti yuktam dveṣeṇa api tad sambhavāt na ca dveṣa yuta upāsanam na phala paryavasāyi iti yuktam

original: "dveṣāccaidyādayo nṛpāḥ' iti saptamaskandhe dveṣeṇa dhyāyatāmapi muktismaraṇāditi | siddhāntastu | darśanaṃ na bhaktyādihīnātpradānayutopāsanādbhavati | kintu bhaktyādyupetādeva |
analyzed: dveṣāt caidya ādayaḥ nṛpāḥ iti saptama skandhe dveṣeṇa dhyāyatām api mukti smaraṇāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu darśanam na bhakti ādi hīnāt pradāna yuta upāsanāt bhavati kintu bhakti ādi upetāt eva

original: bhaktyādinā vinā bhagavato'pyupāsanāya pumarthāhetutvasya pratyutānarthahetutvena "dveṣādyanmuktikathanaṃ śrutivākyavirodhi tat‌' ityupakramyānuvyākhyānoktānekamānasiddhatvena phalaparyavasāyyupāsanasya tu guruprasādasya ca bhaktyādinaiva siddherityasya "tathāpyanādisaṃsiddhabhaktyādiguṇapūrṇataḥ | labhedguruprasādam‌' ityādi siddhatvāt‌ |
analyzed: bhakti ādinā vinā bhagavatā api upāsanāya pumartha ahetutvasya pratyuta anartha hetutvena dveṣāt yat mukti kathanam śruti vākya virodhi tat iti upakramya anuvyākhyāna ukta aneka māna siddhatvena phala paryavasāyi upāsanasya tu guru prasādasya ca bhakti ādinā eva siddheḥ iti asya tathā api anādi saṃsiddha bhakti ādi guṇa pūrṇataḥ labhet guru prasādam ityādi siddhatvāt

original: "dveṣāccaidyādayaḥ' ityādestu svābhāvikabhaktaviṣayatayopapatteriti | phalaṃ tu bhaktyarthakapūrvapādīyamāhātmyoktisāphalyasamarthanam‌ || 31 ||
analyzed: dveṣāt caidya ādayaḥ ityādeḥ tu svābhāvika bhakta viṣaya tayā upapatteḥ iti phalam tu bhakti arthaka pūrva pādīya māhātmya ukti sāphalya samarthanam

original: || oṃ prajñāntarapṛthaktvavaddṛṣyiśca taduktam‌ oṃ || 32 ||
analyzed: om prajñā antara pṛthaktva vat dṛṣyiḥ ca tat uktam om

original: yaddarśane bhaktyādikamāvaśyakamityuktaṃ tasmindarśane tāratamyamatra nirūpyate iti saṅgatiḥ | prakṛtaṃ muktihetubhagavaddarśanaṃ kimekaprakāramutānekaprakāramiti cintā | tadarthaṃ "dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ mucyate' "bhaktyā māmabhijānāti' ityādivacanaṃ sarveṣāmekarūpajñānasya hetutāparamuta neti |
analyzed: yad darśane bhakti ādikam āvaśyakam iti uktam tasmin darśane tāratamyam atra nirūpyate iti saṅgatiḥ prakṛtam mukti hetu bhagavat darśanam kim eka prakāram uta aneka prakāram iti cintā tad artham dṛṣṭvā eva tam mucyate bhaktyā mām abhijānāti iti ādi vacanam sarveṣām eka rūpa jñānasya hetutā param uta na iti

original: tadarthaṃ sarveṣāmekarūpajñānasya hetutāparaṃ netyatra kalpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu | sarveṣāṃ muktihetujñānaṃ ekarūpameva "dṛṣṭvaiva tam‌' iti śrutau sarveṣāmaviśeṣitajñānena mokṣaśravaṇāt‌ | "bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ | tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram‌' iti sarveṣāṃ bhaktyādinā pūrṇajñānotpatteḥ |
analyzed: tad artham sarveṣām eka rūpa jñānasya hetutā param na iti atra kalpakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu sarveṣām mukti hetu jñānam eka rūpam eva dṛṣṭvā eva tam iti śrutau sarveṣām aviśeṣita jñānena mokṣa śravaṇāt bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaḥ ca asmi tattvataḥ tatas mām tattvataḥ jñātvā viśate tad anantaram iti sarveṣām bhakti ādinā pūrṇa jñāna utpatteḥ

original: sampūrṇajñānenaiva mokṣasya gītāyāṃ smaraṇāt‌ | naca śrutyādikaṃ viśeṣaparaṃ kalpakābhāvāt‌ | naca jñānahetūpāsanatāratamyameva kalpakam‌ | anekavidhasādhanavatāmapi kadācitkarṣakāṇāmiva sādhyasāmyopapattyā tasyāprayojakatvāt‌ |
analyzed: sampūrṇa jñānena eva mokṣasya gītāyām smaraṇāt na ca śruti ādikam viśeṣa param kalpaka abhāvāt na ca jñāna hetu upāsana tāratamyam eva kalpakam anekavidha sādhanavatām api kadācid karṣakāṇām iva sādhya sāmya upapattyā tasya aprayojaka tvāt

original: jñānasya nyūnādhikarūpaviśeṣavattve "bhaktyā' iti smṛtau sampūrṇajñānenaiva muktyukteḥ taddhīnānāṃ muktyabhāvāpātena "aniyamassarveṣām‌' ityuktabhaṅgaprasaṅgācceti | siddhāntastu | anekarūpamevādhikāriṇāṃ bhagavaddarśanam‌ | tatsādhanopāsanasya vicitratayā tajjanyajñāne'pi vaicityasyāvaśyakatvāt‌ sādhanānusāritvāt‌ phalasya |
analyzed: jñānasya nyūnādhika rūpa viśeṣa vat tve bhaktyāḥ iti smṛtau sampūrṇa jñānena eva mukti ukteḥ tad hīnānām mukti abhāva āpātena aniyamaḥ sarveṣām iti ukta bhaṅga prasaṅgāt ca iti siddhāntaḥ tu aneka rūpam eva adhikāriṇām bhagavat darśanam tad sādhana upāsanasya vicitra tayā tad janya jñāne api vaicityasya āvaśyaka tvāt sādhana anusāri tvāt phalasya

original: naca tadanyathopapattyā'prayojakam‌ | "antardṛṣyayo bahirdṛṣyayaḥ' ityādi śrutau jñānavaicityasya pramitatvena sarveṣāṃ ekarūpasya bādhitatayā tenopāsanavaicityasyānyathopapatteḥ | kādācitkakarṣakadṛṣyāntamātreṇa kalpayitumanucitatvāt‌ | naca sarveṣāṃ muktyabhāvāpātadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: naca tad anyathā upapattyā aprayojakam antar dṛṣyayaḥ bahis dṛṣyayaḥ ityādi śrutau jñāna vaicityasya pramita tvena sarveṣām eka rūpasya bādhita tayā tena upāsana vaicityasya anyathā upapatteḥ kādācitka karṣaka dṛṣya anta mātreṇa kalpayitum anucita tvāt na ca sarveṣām mukti abhāva āpāta doṣaḥ

original: "dṛṣṭvaiva hyavatārāṇām‌' iti smṛtyā taratamabhāvāpannajñānenaiva adhikāriṇāṃ mokṣāvagamena "bhaktyā' iti smṛteḥ sāmānyataḥ sarvaviṣayakajñānasya muktihetuparatvena vā hiraṇyagarbharūpādhikāriviśeṣaparatvenavā upapatteriti | phalaṃ tu yāvadityatroktamokṣatāratamyasamarthanam‌ || 32 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā eva hi avatārāṇām iti smṛtyā taratama bhāva āpanna jñānena eva adhikāriṇām mokṣa avagamena bhaktyā iti smṛteḥ sāmānyatas sarva viṣayaka jñānasya mukti hetu paratvena vā hiraṇyagarbha rūpa adhikāri viśeṣa paratvena vā upapatteḥ iti phalam tu yāvat iti atra ukta mokṣa tāratamya samarthanam 32

original: || oṃ na sāmānyādapyupalabdhermṛtyuvannahi lokāpattiḥ oṃ || 33 ||
analyzed: om na sāmānyāt api upalabdheḥ mṛtyu vat na hi loka āpattiḥ om

original: yadbhagavaddarśane vaicityaṃ taddarśanaṃ bimbaviṣayameva muktiheturiti nirūpaṇātsaṅgatiḥ | atra prakṛtaṃ bhagavaddarśanaṃ kiṃ yatkiñcidrūpaviṣayaṃ muktiheturuta bimbarūpaviṣayamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ rūpaviṣayakasyaiva muktihetutve na sthānato'pītyatra nirṇītabhagavadrūpāṇāṃ sāmyabhaṅgaḥ prasajyate'tha neti |
analyzed: yat bhagavat darśane vaicityam tat darśanam bimba viṣayam eva mukti hetuḥ iti nirūpaṇāt saṅgatiḥ atra prakṛtam bhagavat darśanam kim yat kiñcid rūpa viṣayam mukti hetuḥ uta bimba rūpa viṣayam iti cintā tad artham rūpa viṣayakasya eva mukti hetu tve na sthānatā api iti atra nirṇīta bhagavat rūpāṇām sāmya bhaṅgaḥ prasajyate tha na iti

original: tathā yatkiṃcidrūpadṛṣyeḥ muktihetutve vaiphalyaṃ tasyāḥ prasajyate na veti | pūrvapakṣastu | kasyacidrūpasya mokṣadānaśaktiranyasya netyaṅgīkāre "na sthānato'pi parasyobhayaliṅgaṃ sarvatra hi' ityukta sarvarūpasāmyasya bhaṃgāpattyā yatkiṃcidrūpajñānamapi muktihetureva |
analyzed: tathā yat kiṃcid rūpa dṛṣyeḥ mukti hetutve vaiphalyam tasyāḥ prasajyate na vā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu kasyacid rūpasya mokṣa dāna śaktiḥ anyasya na iti aṅgīkāre na sthānataḥ api parasya ubhaya liṅgam sarvatra hi sarva rūpa sāmyasya bhaṃga āpattyā yat kiṃcid rūpa jñānam api mukti hetuḥ eva

original: kiṃ ca sāmānyadṛśermuktihetutve taddarśanasya vaiphalyaprasaṅgānna ca tadyuktam‌ | ato muktireva tatphalamiti sāmānyadṛṣyirapi muktihetureva | api ca yadi kiṃcidrūpajñānaṃ muktiheturanyanneti vikalpaḥ tarhi biṃbajñānamapi kiṃcinmuktihetuḥ kiṃcinnetyaniyama ityuktabhaṅgaprasaṅga iti | siddhāntastu | yathā
analyzed: kim ca sāmānya dṛśeḥ mukti hetu tve tad darśanasya vaiphalya prasaṅgāt na ca tat yuktam atas muktiḥ eva tad phalam iti sāmānya dṛṣyiḥ api mukti hetuḥ eva api ca yadi kiṃcid rūpa jñānam mukti hetuḥ anyat na iti vikalpaḥ tarhi biṃba jñānam api kiṃcid mukti hetuḥ kiṃcid na iti aniyamaḥ iti ukta bhaṅga prasaṅgaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ tu yathā

original: mṛtīnāṃ mṛtitvāviśeṣe'pi mṛtiviśeṣānantarameva muktiḥ evaṃ bhagavadrūpāṇāṃ samatve'pi bhagavatsaṅkalpānusāreṇa bimbarūpaviśeṣajñānameva muktihetuḥ na yatkiñcidrūpajñānam‌ | samo'pi bhagavān‌ svabimbadarśane evainaṃ mocayatīti śruteḥ | nacaivaṃ sāmānyadṛśervaiphalyam‌ |
analyzed: mṛtīnām mṛti tva aviśeṣe pi mṛti viśeṣa anantaram eva muktiḥ evam bhagavat rūpāṇām samatve pi bhagavat saṅkalpa anusāreṇa bimba rūpa viśeṣa jñānam eva mukti hetuḥ na yat kiñcid rūpa jñānam samaḥ api bhagavān sva bimba darśane eva enam mocayati iti śruteḥ na ca evam sāmānya dṛśeḥ vaiphalyam

original: "sāmānyadarśanāllokāḥ' iti smṛtyā darśane vikalpavat‌ bimbadarśane tadanāpatteriti | phalaṃ tu bimbopāsananaiyatyasamarthanam‌ || 33 ||
analyzed: sāmānya darśanāt lokāḥ iti smṛtyā darśane vikalpa vat bimba darśane tad anāpatteḥ iti phalam tu bimba upāsana naiyatya samarthanam

original: || oṃ pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāttvanubandhaḥ oṃ || 34 ||
analyzed: om pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyam bhūyaḥ tvāt tu anubandhaḥ om

original: dṛśihetutvena prāguktabhakteratra svātantyanirāsātsaṅgatiḥ | prakṛtadarśanaṃ kiṃ bhaktisāmarthyena bhavati uta īśvaraśaktyeti cintā | tadarthaṃ "bhaktirevainaṃ darśayati' iti śrutiḥ kiṃ bhakteḥ svātantyaparā atha karturīśvarasya dṛśidāne karaṇatvapareti |
analyzed: dṛśi hetu tvena prāk ukta bhakteḥ atra svātantya nirāsāt saṅgatiḥ prakṛta darśanam kim bhakti sāmarthyena bhavati uta īśvara śaktyā iti cintā tad artham bhaktiḥ eva enam darśayati iti śrutiḥ kim bhakteḥ svātantya parā atha kartuḥ īśvarasya dṛśi dāne karaṇatva parā iti

original: tadarthaṃ bhakteḥ karaṇatvaparatve kalpakaṃ nāsti bhaktireveti viśiṣyoktiśca yuktota viparītamiti | pūrvapakṣastu | "bhaktirevainaṃ darśayati' iti bhakteḥ kartṛtvaśravaṇasya karaṇatvaparatvakalpane kalpakābhāvāt‌ sādhanāntareṣu satsu viśiṣya bhakterevātrokteḥ bījābhāvenāyuktatvācca bhaktireveśvaraprasādamanapekṣya svaśaktyaiva bhagavadāparokṣyaṃ
analyzed: tad artham bhakteḥ karaṇatva paratve kalpakam nā asti bhaktiḥ evā iti viśiṣya uktiḥ ca yuktā uta viparītam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu bhaktiḥ eva enam darśayati iti bhakteḥ kartṛ tva śravaṇasya karaṇatva paratva kalpane kalpaka abhāvāt sādhana antareṣu satsu viśiṣya bhakteḥ eva atra ukteḥ bīja abhāvena ayukta tvāt ca bhaktiḥ evā īśvara prasādam an apekṣya sva śaktyā eva bhagavat āparokṣyam anuprāpya anuprāpya anuprāpya anuprāpya anuprāpya anuprāpya a

original: dadātīti | siddhāntastu | bhaktereva dṛśikartṛtve "etairupāyairyatate yastu vidvāṃstasyaiṣa ātmā viśate brahmadhāma ityathavarṇaśrutau etaiḥ pravacanādyupāyaiḥ yo darśanārthaṃ yatate tasyārthe prasannaḥ paramātmā brahmadhāma vāyuṃ viśati tasyāvibharvati iti bhaktyādyupāyaiḥ prasanneśvarasyaiva svāparokṣadātṛtvagrahaṇena virodhāpattyā
analyzed: dadāti iti siddhāntaḥ tu bhakteḥ eva dṛśikartṛ tve etaiḥ upāyaiḥ yatate yaḥ tu vidvān tasya eṣa ātmā viśate brahma dhāma iti atha varṇa śrutau etaiḥ pravacana ādi upāyaiḥ yaḥ darśana artham yatate tasya arthe prasannaḥ paramātmā brahma dhāma vāyum viśati iti bhakti ādi upāyaiḥ prasanna īśvarasya eva sva aparokṣa dātṛ tva grahaṇena virodha āpattyā

original: "bhaktirevainam‌' iti śruteḥ bhakteḥ kartṛparatvāyogena karaṇaparatvāt‌ sādhaneṣu bhakteḥ prādhānyena bhaktireveti viśiṣya bhakteruktyupapatteḥ | bhaktyādisarvaśabdānāṃ prathame'dhyāye bhagavati samanvayasyoktatvena prakṛtinayanyāyena strīliṅgabhaktiśabdasyāpi viṣṇau mukhyatayā śruterviṣṇuparatayopapatteḥ |
analyzed: bhaktiḥ eva enam iti śruteḥ bhakteḥ kartṛ paratva ayogena karaṇa paratvāt sādhaneṣu bhakteḥ prādhānyena bhaktiḥ eva iti viśiṣya bhakteḥ ukti upapatteḥ bhakti ādi sarva śabdānām prathame dhyāye bhagavati samanvayasya ukta tvena prakṛti naya nyāyena strī liṅga bhakti śabdasya api viṣṇau mukhya tayā śruteḥ viṣṇu para tayā upapatteḥ

original: "bhaktisthaḥ paramo viṣṇuḥ' ityādi smṛtibalāt‌, anādibhaktiprasanneśvarasāmathyarena tadaparokṣajñānamiti | phalaṃ tu "tadavyaktamāhahi' ityukta avyaktatvasamarthanam‌ || 34 ||
analyzed: bhakti sthaḥ paramaḥ viṣṇuḥ ityādi smṛti balāt tad aparokṣa jñānam iti phalam tu tat avyaktam āha hi iti ukta avyakta tva samarthanam

original: || oṃ eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt‌ oṃ || 35 ||
analyzed: oṃ eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt oṃ

original: anādibhakterdṛṣyikāraṇatvoktirayuktā | "sthānaviśeṣāt‌' ityatra bhāṣyādyuktidiśā anādibhaktyādisampattirūpayogyatāsāpekṣatvasyaivāyogāditi bhāvena śaṅkanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra prakṛtopāsanādau anādiyogyatāpekṣā nāstyutāstīti cintā | tadarthaṃ yogyatāyāḥ anāditvaṃ na sambhavatyuta sambhavatīti |

analyzed: sarva madhye tad ukta rītyā sva icchā ācāra vidhi paratvam iti artha traya paratvasya api vidhi niyatāḥ manuṣyāḥ aniyatāḥ hi devāḥ brahmā eva sva icchā niyataḥ iti gaupavana śrutau sva icchayā eva pravṛttiḥ tu brahmaṇaḥ vidhi coditaḥ ityādi smṛtau ca mānuṣa deva a viriṃca rūpa adhikāri bhedena vyavasthā uktyā virodha abhāvena

original: jñānimātrasya svecchācārasya vākyasya prāmāṇyābhāvāt‌ | jñānino'satpravṛttyā mokṣāpratibandhasya

original: "kāmacārāḥ kāmabhakṣāḥ' iti śrutyā jñānino nivartyatayā prāptasyārabdhakarmaṇo'pi kiṃcidupabhuktasya jñānenopamardasya "ātmānamabhipaśyopamṛdya puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca' iti śrutisiddhatayā kaimutyanyāyena ca siddhatvena aniyama ityuktaniyamabhaṃgarūpasya "ya imaṃ paramaṃ guhyamūrdhvaretassu bhāṣayet‌' iti ūrdhvaretastvādiguṇayukteṣvevopadeśavidhānena
analyzed: kāmacārāḥ kāmabhakṣāḥ iti śrutyā jñāninaḥ nivartya tayā prāptasya ārabdha karmaṇaḥ api kiṃcid upabhuktasya jñānena upamardasya ātmānam abhipaśya upamṛdya puṇyam ca pāpam ca iti śruti siddhatayā kaimutya nyāyena ca siddhatvena aniyamaḥ iti ukta niyama bhaṃga rūpasya yaḥ imam paramam guhyam ūrdhvaretassu bhāṣayet iti ūrdhvaretaḥ tva ādi guṇa yukteṣu eva upadeśa vidhānena

original: jñāne'satpravṛttyā pratibandhasya pramitatvena atiprasaṃgarūpasya kevalasya jñānasyaiva mokṣasvarūpaniṣpādakatve'pi "paśyannapīmamātmānaṃ kuryātkarmāvicārayan‌ |

original: yadātmanassuniyatamānandotkarṣamā nuyāt‌' ityādi vākyabalena mokṣe sukhātiśayārthe sahakāritvena satpravṛttyasatpravṛttivarjanayoḥ apekṣāyāmapi jñānakarmasamuccayavādāpattirūpasya ca bādhakasyābhāvāt‌ sarvānnānumatiśruteśca bhāṣyādyuktaliṃgena prāṇatyāgaviṣayatvena sāvakāśatvāt‌ |

original: kiṃ ca jñānino niṣiddhasyākaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt‌ svecchācāra ucyate, karaṇaṣa pramāṇābhāvādvā, niṣedhakapramāṇābhāvādvā, karaṇe bādhakābhāvādvā | nādyadvitīyau | asiddheḥ | na tṛtīyaḥ | "evaṃ paśyanna kāmacaritaṃ caret‌' iti "atītānāgatajñānī trailokyoddharaṇakṣamaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca jñāninaḥ niṣiddhasya akaraṇe bādhaka abhāvāt svecchā ācāraḥ ucyate pramāṇa abhāvāt vā niṣedhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt vā karaṇe bādhaka abhāvāt vā na ādya dvitīyau asiddheḥ na tṛtīyaḥ evam paśyan na kāma caritam caret iti atīta anāgata jñānī trailokya uddharaṇa kṣamaḥ

original: etādṛśo'pi nācāraṃ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ parityajet‌' iti ca niṣedhakaśrutismṛtibhāvāt‌ | na caturthaḥ | "ānando hrasate'kāryāt‌' iti smṛtyā ānandahrāsarūpabādhakasya bhāvāt‌ | tasmādastyeva jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ maktivānandahrāsarūpo viśeṣa iti | phalaṃ tu asadācāre'pi muktisaṃpādanarūpajñānamahimasamarthanam‌ || 4 ||
analyzed: etādṛśaḥ api na ācāram śrautam smārtam parityajet iti ca niṣedhaka śruti smṛti bhāvāt na caturthaḥ ānandaḥ hrasate kāryāt iti smṛtyā ānanda hrāsa rūpa bādhakasya bhāvāt tasmāt asti eva jñāninaḥ sat asat pravṛttibhyām makti vā ānanda hrāsa rūpaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti phalam tu asat ācāre api mukti saṃpādana rūpa jñāna mahima samarthanam

original: || oṃ sarvathā'pi tu ta evobhayaliṃgāt‌ oṃ || 5 ||

original: || oṃ anabhibhavaṃ ca daśaryati oṃ || oṃ antarā cāpi tu taddṛṣyeḥ oṃ || oṃ api smaryate oṃ || oṃ viśeṣānugrahaṃ ca oṃ || oṃ atastvitarajjyāyo liṃgācca oṃ || oṃ tadbhūtasya tu tadbhāvo jaiminerapi niyamātadrūpābhāvebhyaḥ oṃ ||
analyzed: om anabhibhavam ca daśaryati om om antarā ca api tu om om api smaryate om om viśeṣa anugraham ca om om atas tu itarat jyāyaḥ liṃgāt ca om om tad bhūtasya tu tad bhāvaḥ jaimineḥ api niyamāt tad rūpa abhāvebhyaḥ om

original: pūrvatra viśeṣitatvādityatra prakṛtaiḥ mandamadhyottamarūpādhikāribhireva jñānaṃ prāpya nānyairityatrocyata iti saṃgatiḥ | atra jñānaṃ kimayogyairapyāpyaṃ uta prakṛtayogyaireveti cintā | tadarthaṃ yogyairevāpyamityatra kalpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti |
analyzed: pūrvatra viśeṣita tvāt iti atra prakṛtaiḥ manda madhya uttama rūpa adhikāribhiḥ eva jñānam prāpya na anyaiḥ iti atra ucyate iti saṃgatiḥ atra jñānam kim ayogyaiḥ api āpyam uta prakṛta yogyaiḥ eva iti cintā tad artham yogyaiḥ eva āpyam iti atra kalpakam na asti uta asti iti

original: tathā yogyaprāpyatvapakṣe'pi kimayogyatāyāḥ mahāprayatnenābhibhavena teṣāmapi yogyatotpattirastyuta neti | tadarthamayogyatā kiṃ teṣāmasvabhāvaḥ uta svabhāva iti | tadarthaṃ tasyāḥ svabhāvatvena anabhibhave jñāpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: tathā yogya prāpya tva pakṣe pi kim ayogyatāyāḥ mahā prayatnena abhibhavena teṣām api yogyatā utpattiḥ asti uta na iti tad artham ayogyatā kim teṣām asvabhāvaḥ uta svabhāvaḥ iti tad artham tasyāḥ svabhāva tvena anabhibhave jñāpakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: yogyānāmevetyatra pramāṇābhāvāt‌ vedāyogyasya prayatnena vedaprāptidarśanenāyogyānāmapi yatnena jñānaprāptirastyeva | jñānasya yogyamātraprāpyatvapakṣe'pi ayogyānāmayogyatābhibhavena vipratvadarśanāt‌ | na kṣatriyatvamasvābhāvikaṃ ayogyatvaṃ svābhāvikaṃ na prayatnenāpyanivartyamiti śaṃkyam‌ | svābhāvikatve mānābhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: yogyānām eva iti atra pramāṇa abhāvāt veda ayogyasya prayatnena veda prāpti darśanena ayogyānām api yatnena jñāna prāptiḥ asti eva jñānasya yogya mātra prāpya tva pakṣe pi ayogyānām ayogyatā abhibhavena vipra tva darśanāt na kṣatriya tvam asvābhāvikam ayogya tvam svābhāvikam na prayatnena api anivartyam iti śaṃkyam svābhāvika tve māna abhāvāt

original: svābhāvikatve yavakalamabījāderiva svabhāvānusāriphalatvaprasaṃgācceti | siddhāntastu | deśakālagurūpasattyādimahotsāhe'pi ayogyānāṃ na jñānaprāptiḥ | kiṃ tu yogyānāmeva |
analyzed: svābhāvika tve yava kalama bīja ādeḥ iva svabhāva anusāri phalatva prasaṃgāt ca iti siddhāntaḥ tu deśa kāla guru upasatti ādi mahā utsāhe pi ayogyānām na jñāna prāptiḥ kim tu yogyānām eva

original: indravirocanayoścaturmukhopadeśe samāne'pi na samyak‌ jñānaprāptiḥ pratyuta viparītajñānaprāptirityasya chānyogye'ṣyame spaṣyatvenendrāderjñāprāptyādiliṅgena tathājñānahetuprasādasya muktiyogyeṣveva "ṛṇve vīra ugram‌' ityādi siddhatvena tadanyathānupapattyā ca tathāvagamāt‌ |
analyzed: indra virocanayoḥ caturmukha upadeśe samāne api na samyak jñāna prāptiḥ pratyuta viparīta jñāna prāptiḥ iti asya spaṣya tvena indra ādeḥ jñā prāpti ādi liṅgena tathā jñāna hetu prasādasya mukti yogyeṣu eva ṛṇve vīraḥ ugram ityādi siddhatvena tad anyathā anupapattyā ca tathā avagamāt

original: na cāyogyānāmapi mahāprayatnenāyogyatābhibhavena yogyatotpattirastviti yuktam‌ | ayogyatāyāḥ svabhāvatvāt‌ | naca jñāpakābhāvaḥ | "daivīmeva sampattiṃ devāḥ' iti śrutau "asurā āsureṇaiva svabhāvena' iti smṛtau ca anabhibhavasya svabhāvatvasya ca spaṣyaṃ śravaṇāt‌ |
analyzed: na ca ayogyānām api mahā prayatnena ayogyatā abhibhavena yogyatā utpattiḥ astu iti yuktam ayogyatāyāḥ svabhāva tvāt na ca jñāpaka abhāvaḥ daivīm eva sampattim devāḥ iti śrutau asurāḥ āsureṇa eva svabhāvena iti smṛtau ca anabhibhavasya svabhāva tvasya ca spaṣyam śravaṇāt

original: tathā "nāsurā daivīṃ na devā āsurīm‌' ityādi niyamaśrutyā "nāsurāṇāṃ daivaṃ rūpam‌' ityatadrūpavattvaśrutyā "taṃ bhūtiriti devā upāsāṃcakrire' iti devāsurayoranyonyaviparītopāsanena samyak‌phalaviparītaphalaśrutyā ca devāsuramānuṣāṇāṃ devatvādisvabhāvatvapratipādakajaiminyācāryamatena ca "kanīyasā eva devāḥ jyāyasā asurāḥ' iti śrutyā "na jānāmi'
analyzed: tathā na asurāḥ daivīm na devāḥ āsurīm ityādi niyama śrutyā na asurāṇām daivam rūpam iti a tad rūpavat tva śrutyā tam bhūtiḥ iti devāḥ upāsāṃcakrire iti deva asurayoḥ anyonya viparīta upāsanena samyak phala viparīta phala śrutyā ca deva asura mānuṣāṇām deva tva ādi svabhāva tva pratipādaka jaimini ācārya matena ca kanīyasā eva devāḥ jyāyasā asurāḥ iti śrutyā na jānāmi

original: iti janasamūhapraveśaniṣedhānyathānupapattirūpaliṃgena cāyogyatādeḥ svabhāvatvānabhibhavayoḥ tattatsvabhāvānusāriphalasattvāvagamāditi | phalaṃ tu mokṣasya yogyatāmātraprāpyatvasamarthanam‌ || 5 ||
analyzed: iti jana samūha praveśa niṣedha anyathā anupapatti rūpa liṃgena ca ayogyatā ādeḥ svabhāva tva anabhibhavayoḥ tad tad svabhāva anusāri phala sattva avagamāt iti phalam tu mokṣasya yogyatā mātra prāpyatva samarthanam 5

original: || oṃ na cādhikārikamapi patanānumānāttadayogāt‌ oṃ || 6 ||

original: || oṃ upapūrvamapītyeke bhāvaśamanavattaduktam‌ oṃ || oṃ bahistūbhayathāpi smṛterācārācca oṃ ||
analyzed: om upa pūrvam api iti eke bhāva śamana vat tat uktam om om bahis tu ubhayathā api smṛteḥ ācārāt ca om

original: pūrvaṃ jñānasyāyogyaprāpyatvamuktamatra tu yogyeṣvapi devādipadākāṃkṣāśūnyaireva prāpyate na sarvairityucyate iti vā prāguktadevatvādeḥ svābhāvikatvamayuktam‌ | prayatnasādhyatāśravaṇena devatvasyāsvābhāvikatvāditi śaṃkanādvānaṃtarasaṃgatiḥ | pūrvatra devānāṃ prakṛtatvāt‌ saṃgataṃ devapadaṃ devetaraiḥ prāptuṃ yogyamuta devaireveti cintā |
analyzed: pūrvam jñānasya ayogya prāpya tvam uktam atra tu yogyeṣu api deva ādi pada ākāṃkṣā śūnyaiḥ eva prāpyate na sarvaiḥ iti ucyate iti vā prāgukta deva tva ādeḥ svābhāvika tvam ayuktam prayatna sādhya tā śravaṇena deva tvasya asvābhāvika tvāt iti śaṃkanāt vā anantara saṃgatiḥ pūrvatra devānām prakṛta tvāt saṃgatam deva padam deva itaraiḥ prāptum yogyam uta devaiḥ eva iti cintā

original: tadarthaṃ tatpadaprāptyarthaṃ icchāprayatnakṛtau bādhakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu | "svadharmaniṣṭhaḥ śatajanmabhiḥ pumān‌ viriṃcatāmeti' "vayā viṣṇoreṣasya prabhṛthe havirbhiḥ videhi rudro rudriyaṃ mahitvam‌' ityādi vākyabalena viriṃcatvādeḥ yatnasādhyatāvagamena cetanatvādivat‌ devatvādeḥ svābhāvikatvābhāvena yatnaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāptuṃ
analyzed: tad artham tad pada prāpti artham icchā prayatna kṛtau bādhakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu svadharma niṣṭhaḥ śata janmabhiḥ pumān viriṃca tām eti vayāḥ viṣṇoḥ eṣasya prabhṛthe havirbhiḥ videhi rudraḥ rudriyam mahitvam ityādi vākya balena viriṃca tva ādeḥ yatna sādhyatā avagamena cetana tva ādi vat deva tva ādeḥ svābhāvika tva abhāvena yatnaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāptum arthaḥ

original: śakyatvāccetanatvasya svābhāvikatvasya sarvasaṃmatatvāt‌ devatvādiprāptau icchāprayatnakṛtau bādhakābhāvāt‌ | anyathā jñānabhaktyādīcchaprayatnāvapi na syātāmiti | devādanyairdevādipadaṃ prāpyameva kiṃ bahunā bhagavadaiśvaryamapi yatnena prāpyamiti | siddhāntastu | devatāpadaṃ bhagavadaiśvaryaṃ vā na prāpyaṃ tadicchāprayatnayorevāyogāt‌ |
analyzed: śakya tvāt cetana tvasya svābhāvika tvasya sarva saṃmata tvāt deva tva ādi prāptau icchā prayatna kṛtau bādhaka abhāvāt anyathā jñāna bhakti ādi iccha prayatnau api na syātām iti devāt anyaiḥ deva ādi padam prāpyam eva kim bahunā bhagavat aiśvaryam api yatnena prāpyam iti siddhāntaḥ tu devatā padam bhagavat aiśvaryam vā na prāpyam tad icchā prayatnayoḥ eva ayogāt

original: brahmādipadecchāvān‌ devādibhiḥ pātyate aśakyatatpadecchutvāt‌ rājapadecchuvat‌ | devādipadaprayatnavān‌ patati ayogyārohaprayatnavatvāt‌ ayogyavṛkṣārohaprayatnayuktavadityanumānena anarthāvagamāt‌ | naca cetanatvavaddehatvādikaṃ na svābhāvikaṃ iti ayogyatvādiviśeṣaṇamasiddham‌ |
analyzed: brahma ādi pada icchāvān deva ādibhiḥ pātyate aśakya tad pada icchu tvāt rāja pada icchu vat deva ādi pada prayatnavān patati ayogya āroha prayatnavatvāt ayogya vṛkṣa āroha prayatna yukta vat iti anumānena anartha avagamāt na ca cetana tva vat deha tva ādikam na svābhāvikam iti ayogya tva ādi viśeṣaṇam asiddham

original: "devāsuranaratvādyā jīvānāṃ tu nisargataḥ' iti vacanena svabhāvatvāvagamāt‌ "anyatra śubhamākāṃkṣannapatedavirodhataḥ' iti vacanena jñānādyākāṃkṣāyāmanarthābhāvasyaivāvagame'tiprasaṃgābhāvāditi | phalaṃ tu devatāpadavat‌ jñānamapi yogyaprāpyameveti prāguktasamarthanam‌ || 6 ||
analyzed: deva asura nara tva ādyāḥ jīvānām tu nisargataḥ iti vacanena svabhāva tva avagamāt anyatra śubham ākāṃkṣan apatet avirodhataḥ iti vacanena jñāna ādi ākāṃkṣāyām anartha abhāvasya eva avagama iti prasaṃga abhāvāt iti phalam tu devatā pada vat jñānam api yogya prāpyam eva iti prāc ukta samarthanam

original: || oṃ svāminaḥ phalaśruterityātreyaḥ oṃ || 7 ||
analyzed: om svāminaḥ phala śruteḥ iti ātreyaḥ om

original: || oṃ ārtvijyamityauḍulomistasmai hi parikriyate oṃ || oṃ sahakāryantaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat‌ oṃ ||
analyzed: om ārtvijyam iti auḍulomiḥ tasmai hi parikriyate om om sahakāri antara vidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyam tadvataḥ vidhi ādi vat om

original: pūrvatra jñānasyetthambhāva uktaḥ atra tu phalaniṣpādanaprakāraḥ ucyate iti saṃgatiḥ | prakṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tattvābhimānidevānāmeva phalaniṣpādakamuta prajānāmapīti cintā | tadarthaṃ kriyājanyaphalatve prayojakakartṛtvameva prayojakamuta kartṛtvamātramapīti | kartṛtvamapītyatra heturnāsti bādhakaṃ cāsti uta viparītamiti |
