original: atraihikamityatra prakṛtaṃ śravaṇādikaṃ sakṛdanuṣṭheyamuta āvartanīyamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ śravaṇādividheragniṣyomādividhivat‌ sakṛdanuṣṭhāna eva paryavasānamuta avaghātavidhivadāvartanameveti | tadarthaṃ jñānaṃ hi śravaṇādeḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhānena bhavati uta neti | tadarthaṃ jñānasya suśakatvaṃ guṇaḥ uta duḥśakatvameva guṇaḥ iti |
analyzed: atra aihikam iti atra prakṛtam śravaṇa ādikam sakṛt anuṣṭheyam uta āvartanīyam iti cintā tad artham śravaṇa ādi vidheḥ agniṣyoma ādi vidhi vat sakṛt anuṣṭhāne eva paryavasānam uta avaghāta vidhi vat āvartanam eva iti tad artham jñānam hi śravaṇa ādeḥ sakṛt anuṣṭhānena bhavati uta na iti tad artham jñānasya suśaka tvam guṇaḥ uta duḥśaka tvam eva guṇaḥ iti

original: tadarthaṃ duḥśakatvasya guṇatvakalpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu | śravaṇādisādhanaṃ agniṣyomādivatsakṛdevānuṣṭheyam‌ | tāvataiva jñānodayasaṃbhavena sakṛdanuṣṭhāna eva śravaṇādividheḥ paryavasānāt‌ | naca vrīhīnavahantītyādividheḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhānena tuṣavimokarūpaphalāsiddheḥ avaghātāvartane paryavasānavat‌ iha kiṃ na syāditi vācyam‌ |
analyzed: tad artham duḥśaka tvasya guṇa tva kalpakam na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu śravaṇa ādi sādhanam agniṣyoma ādi vat sakṛt eva anuṣṭheyam tāvatā eva jñāna udaya saṃbhavena sakṛt anuṣṭhāne eva śravaṇa ādi vidheḥ paryavasānāt na ca vrīhīn avahanti ityādi vidheḥ sakṛt anuṣṭhānena tuṣa vimoka rūpa phala asiddheḥ avaghāta āvartane paryavasāna vat iha kim na syāt iti vācyam

original: tathātve jñānasya sakṛtsādhanānuṣṭhānalabhyatvarūpasuśakatvaguṇābhāvaprasaṃgāt‌ | naca jñānasya duḥśakatvameva guṇaḥ kalpakābhāvāditi | siddhāntastu | avagādivacchravaṇādikamāvartanīyam‌ | avaghātasya sakṛdanuṣṭhānena tuṣavimokasyeveha śravaṇādeḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhānena jñānodayasyādarśanena tadvidheravaghātādividhivadāvartana eva paryavasānam‌ |
analyzed: tathātve jñānasya sakṛt sādhana anuṣṭhāna labhya tva rūpa suśaka tva guṇa abhāva prasaṃgāt na ca jñānasya duḥśaka tvam eva guṇaḥ kalpaka abhāvāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu avaga ādi vat śravaṇa ādikam āvartanīyam avaghātasya sakṛt anuṣṭhānena tuṣa vimokasya iva iha śravaṇa ādeḥ sakṛt anuṣṭhānena jñāna udayasya adarśanena tad vidheḥ avaghāta ādi vidhi vat āvartane eva paryavasānam

original: naca jñānasya śravaṇādyāvartanasādhyatvopagame suśakatvaguṇabhaṃgaḥ | mahāphalahetujñāne duḥśakatvasyaiva guṇatvāt‌ | naca jñānasya duḥśakatvaṃ guṇa ityupetya śravaṇādyāvartanasādhyatvopagame kalpakābhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: naca jñānasya śravaṇa ādi āvartana sādhya tva upagame suśaka tva guṇa bhaṃgaḥ mahā phala hetu jñāne duḥśaka tvasya eva guṇa tvāt naca jñānasya duḥśaka tvam guṇaḥ iti upetya śravaṇa ādi āvartana sādhya tva upagame kalpaka abhāvāt

original: uddālakena śvetaketuṃ prati "sa evo'ṇimā' ityāditattvasya navakṛtvaḥ chānyogye ṣaṣṭhe upadiṣyatvena tadanyathānupapatteḥ śravaṇāvṛttikalpakatvāt‌ | anyathā sakṛdevopadeśakaraṇāpātāt‌ |
analyzed: uddālakena śvetaketum prati saḥ eva uṇimā ityādi tattvasya nava kṛtvas chā anyogye ṣaṣṭhe upadiṣya tvena tad anyathā anupapatteḥ śravaṇa āvṛtti kalpaka tvāt anyathā sakṛt eva upadeśa karaṇa āpātāt

original: tathā taittirīye bhṛguvallayāṃ "tasmā etatprovāca annaṃ prāṇaḥ cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vācam‌' iti śrutyā annādirūpaviṣaya eva bhṛgoḥ "adhīhi bhagavo brahma' iti punaḥ śravaṇamananadhyānāni kurviti bhāvena "tadvijijñāsasva' iti varuṇasyoktiḥ |
analyzed: tathā taittirīye bhṛguvallayām tasmai etat provāca annam prāṇaḥ cakṣuḥ śrotram manaḥ vācam iti śrutyā anna ādi rūpa viṣayaḥ eva bhṛgoḥ adhīhi bhagavaḥ brahma iti punar śravaṇa manana dhyānāni kuru iti bhāvena tat vijijñāsasva iti varuṇasya uktiḥ

original: śrutasya punarālocanenāpekṣitatvamityevaṃ rūpaliṃgadarśanasya ca "nityaśaḥ śravaṇaṃ ca' iti smṛteḥ śravaṇamananadhyānāvṛttikalpakatvāditi | phalaṃ tu aihikamityādāvabhimatasya śravaṇāderjñānahetutvasamarthanam‌ || 1 ||
analyzed: śrutasya punar ālocanena apekṣita tvam iti evam rūpa liṃga darśanasya ca nityaśas śravaṇam ca iti smṛteḥ śravaṇa manana dhyāna āvṛtti kalpaka tvāt iti phalam tu aihikam ityādau abhimatasya śravaṇa ādeḥ jñāna hetutva samarthanam

original: || oṃ ātmeti tūpagacchanti grāhayanti ca oṃ || 2 ||
analyzed: om ātmā iti tu upagacchanti grāhayanti ca om

original: pūrvaṃ yajjñānārthaṃ śravaṇādyāvartyamityuktaṃ tasyātmatvasya svāmitvaśabditasyātra dhyānamāvaśyakamiti sādhanātsaṃgatiḥ | atra prakṛtātmatvopāsanopadeśau na nityaśaḥ kāryāvuta kāryau iti cintā | tadarthamātmatvarūpasvāmitvasyātiprasiddhatvaṃ tadupāsanādipratibandhakamuta neti | tadarthaṃ tasyāpratibandhakatvakalpakaṃ nāstyutāstīti |
analyzed: pūrvam yat jñāna artham śravaṇa ādi āvartyam iti uktam tasya ātmatvasya svāmitva śabditasya atra dhyānam āvaśyakam iti sādhanāt saṃgatiḥ atra prakṛta ātmatva upāsana upadeśau na nityaśas kāryau uta kāryau iti cintā tad artham ātmatva rūpa svāmitvasya ati prasiddha tvam tad upāsana ādi pratibandhakam uta na iti tad artham tasya apratibandhaka tva kalpakam na asti uta asti iti

original: pūrvapakṣastu | ātmatvadhyānopadeśau na nityaśaḥ kāryau tasya svāmitvarūpasya nityaprasiddhatvāt‌ | suprasiddhasya nityaṃ sarvamanasi viparivartanena dhyānopadeśavaiyathyarāt‌
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ tu ātmatva dhyāna upadeśau na nityaśas kāryau tasya svāmi tva rūpasya nitya prasiddha tvāt su prasiddhasya nityam sarva manasi viparivartanena dhyāna upadeśa vaiyathya rāt

original: | aprasiddhatvasyaiva upadeṣyavyatvādau prayojakatvāt‌ suprasiddhasyāpi avaśyaṃ dhyānopadeśau kāryāvityatra kalpakābhāvāditi | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: aprasiddha tvasya eva upadeṣya vya tva ādau prayojaka tvāt su prasiddhasya api avaśyam dhyāna upadeśau kāryau iti atra kalpaka abhāvāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "ātmetyupāsanaṃ kāryaṃ sarvathaiva mumukṣubhiḥ' ityādi vacanenānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ viṣṇurātmetyupāsanopadeśayoḥ mokṣahetutvāvagamena mokṣārthopāsanādeḥ prasiddhayaprasiddhibhyāṃ kartavyatvādyasiddheḥ nityaṃ sarvathātmatvopāsanopadeśau kāryāveveti | phalaṃ tu vedānāṃ svāmitve mahātātparyasya yuktatvasamarthanam‌ || 2 ||
analyzed: ātmā iti upāsanam kāryam sarvathā eva mumukṣubhiḥ ityādi vacanena anvaya vyatirekābhyām viṣṇuḥ ātmā iti upāsana upadeśayoḥ mokṣa hetutva avagamena mokṣa artha upāsana ādeḥ prasiddhaya prasiddhibhyām kartavya tva ādi asiddheḥ nityam sarvathā ātma tva upāsana upadeśau kāryau eva iti phalam tu vedānām svāmi tve mahā tātparyasya yuktatva samarthanam

original: || oṃ na pratīke na hi saḥ oṃ || 3 ||
analyzed: om na pratīke na hi saḥ om

original: pūrvoktasvāmitvopāsanākṣepeṇeha pūrvapakṣodayātsaṃgatiḥ | saptame "nāma brahmetyupāste' "vācaṃ brahmetyupāste' ityādirūpeṇa śrutanāmavāgādiśabditoṣāsvāhādikaṃ brahmābhedenopāsyaṃ uta tatrasthatveneti cintā | tadarthaṃ nāmabrahmetyādiśrutiḥ aikyābhiprāyota nā nibrahmetyevaṃrūpeṇa tatrasthatvābhiprāyeti |
analyzed: pūrva ukta svāmitva upāsana ākṣepeṇa iha pūrvapakṣa udayāt saṃgatiḥ saptame nāma brahma iti upāste vācam brahma iti upāste ityādi rūpeṇa śruta nāma vāc ādi śabdita uṣā svāhā ādikam brahma abhedena upāsyam uta tatrastha tvena iti cintā tad artham nāma brahma ityādi śrutiḥ aikya abhiprāyā uta nā nibrahma iti evaṃrūpeṇa tatrastha tva abhiprāyā iti

original: tadarthaṃ mithyopāsanamapi pumarthaheturuta satyopāsanamiti | pūrvapakṣastu | nāmavāgādikaṃ brahmatayopāsyaṃ "nāma brahma' iti sāmānādhikaraṇaśrutyā tayoraikyopāsanasya śrutatvāt‌ | naca "pṛthagupadeśāt‌' ityatra jīvabrahmabhedasya siddhatayā nāmabrahmaikyaṃ mithyaiveti cenna |
analyzed: tad artham mithyā upāsanam api pumartha hetuḥ uta satya upāsanam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu nāma vāc ādikam brahmatayā upāsyam nāma brahma iti sāmānādhikaraṇa śrutyā tayoḥ aikya upāsanasya śruta tvāt na ca pṛthak upadeśāt iti atra jīva brahma bhedasya siddhatayā nāma brahma aikyam mithyā eva iti ced na

original: pūvartra prasiddhayaprasiddhayoraprayojakatvena pumarthahetutvenaivātmatvopāsanavat‌ upāsyavastunaḥ satyamithyātvayoraprayojakatvena "yāvannā no gataṃ tatrāsya yathā kāmacāro bhavati' ityādivākyaśeṣaśrutaphalavattvena tathopāsanasambhavāditi | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: prasiddhaya prasiddhayoḥ aprayojaka tvena pumartha hetutvena eva ātmatva upāsana vat upāsya vastunaḥ satya mithyātvayoḥ aprayojaka tvena yāvat nā no gatam tatra asya yathā kāmacāraḥ bhavati ityādi vākya śeṣa śruta phalavat tvena tathā upāsana sambhavāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "acetanāsatyāyogyānyanupāsyānyaphalatvaviparyayābhyām‌' iti saṃkarṣaṇasūtreṇa anuvyākhyānoktavacanaiśca mithyopāsanāyāḥ aphalatvaviparītaphalatvayoruktyā mithyopāsteḥ pumarthāhetutayā tathopāsterakartavyatvāt‌ | "nāmādiprāṇaparyantam‌' ityādi smṛtibalācca nā ni brahmetyeva tatrasthatvenaivopāsanaṃ kāryaṃ na tvaikyeneti |
analyzed: acetana asatya ayogyāni anupāsyāni aphalatva viparyayābhyām iti saṃkarṣaṇa sūtreṇa anuvyākhyāna ukta vacanaiḥ ca mithyā upāsanāyāḥ aphalatva viparīta phalatvayoḥ uktyā mithyā upāsteḥ pumartha ahetutayā tathā upāsteḥ akartavya tvāt nāma ādi prāṇa paryantam ityādi smṛti balāt ca brahma iti eva tatrastha tvena eva upāsanam kāryam na tu aikyena iti

original: phalaṃ tu prāguktātmopāsanasamarthanam‌ || 3 ||
analyzed: phalam tu prāc ukta ātma upāsana samarthanam

original: || oṃ brahmadṛṣyirutkarṣāt‌ oṃ || 4 ||
analyzed: om brahma dṛṣyiḥ utkarṣāt om

original: pūrvatra nāmabrahmetiprakṛtabrahmatvopāsteratrāvaśyakatvasādhanātsaṅgatiḥ | atra prakṛtaṃ brahmatvaṃ kiṃ sadā sarvathopāsyaṃ na bhavati uta bhavatīti cintā | tadarthaṃ tasya tathopāsyatve heturnāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu | na brahmatvaśabditasyopāsanaṃ kāryaṃ sadā sarvatheti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: pūrvatra nāma brahma iti prakṛta brahmatva upāsteḥ atra āvaśyakatva sādhanāt saṅgatiḥ atra prakṛtam brahmatvam kim sadā sarvathā upāsyam na bhavati uta bhavati iti cintā tad artham tasya tathā upāsya tve hetuḥ na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu na brahmatva śabditasya upāsanam kāryam sadā sarvathā iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: brahmatve savarguṇāntarbhāvena tasya bhagavadutkṛṣyatvarūpatvena itaraguṇebhyo jyāyastvena tadupāsterbhagavatprītiviśeṣahetutvena ātmatvopāsteriva etadupāsterabhāve mokṣāsiddheśca mokṣahetubhagavatprītiviśeṣajanakatvātsarvadā sarvathaiva brahmatvamupāsyam‌ | tacca ātmabrahmetyātmatvaviśeṣaṇatayaiveti na caturguṇopāstiniyamabhaṃga iti dhyeyam‌ |
analyzed: brahmatve savarguṇa antarbhāvena tasya bhagavat utkṛṣya tva rūpatvena itara guṇebhyaḥ jyāyastvena tad upāsteḥ bhagavat prīti viśeṣa hetutvena ātmatva upāsteḥ iva etad upāsteḥ abhāve mokṣa asiddheḥ ca mokṣa hetu bhagavat prīti viśeṣa janaka tvāt sarvadā sarvathā eva brahmatvam upāsyam tat ca ātma brahma iti ātmatva viśeṣaṇatayā eva iti na caturguṇa upāsti niyama bhaṃgaḥ iti dhyeyam

original: phalaṃ tu bhū no jyāyastvamityuktasamarthanamiti || 4 ||
analyzed: phalam tu bhū naḥ jyāyaḥ tvam iti ukta samarthanam iti

original: || oṃ ādityādimatayaścāṃga upapatteḥ oṃ || 5 ||
analyzed: om āditya ādi matayaḥ ca aṃge upapatteḥ om

original: pūrvatra yadviśeṣaṇatayā brahmatvaṃ dhyeyamityuktaṃ tadātmatvameva aṃgāśritatvavanna dhyeyamiti śaṃkodayātsaṃgatiḥ | atra devānāṃ svasvotpattyaṃgāśritatvenopāsanaṃ devaiḥ kāryamiti yaduktaṃ "aṃgeṣu yathāśrayabhāvaḥ' ityatra tatkiṃ devānāṃ sadā sarvathā na kāyumuta kāryamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ tathā kāryatve viśeṣaheturnāstyutāstīti |
analyzed: pūrvatra yat viśeṣaṇatayā brahmatvam dhyeyam iti uktam tat ātmatvam eva aṃga āśrita tva vat na dhyeyam iti śaṃkā udayāt saṃgatiḥ atra devānām sva sva utpatti aṃga āśrita tvena upāsanam devaiḥ kāryam iti yat uktam aṃgeṣu yathā āśraya bhāvaḥ iti atra tat kim devānām sadā sarvathā na kāryam iti cintā tad artham tathā kārya tve viśeṣa hetuḥ na asti uta asti iti

original: pūrvapakṣastu | guṇāntareṣu satsvapi viśiṣya svasvāśrayāṃgattvarūpaguṇasyaiva nityamupāsane brahmatvopāsana iva viśeṣahetvabhāvāt‌ sūryādidevānāṃ jagatprakāśanādyarthaṃ vividhisthāneṣu saṃcaraṇena nityaṃ bhagavadaṃgeṣvavasthityabhāvena tathopāstermithyopāstitayā saṃcaraṇena nityaṃ bhagavadaṃgeṣvavasthityabhāvena tathopāstermithyopāstitayā
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ tu guṇa antareṣu satsu api viśiṣya sva sva āśraya aṃgattva rūpa guṇasya eva nityam upāsane brahmatva upāsane iva viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt sūrya ādi devānām jagat prakāśana ādi artham vividhi sthāneṣu saṃcaraṇena nityam bhagavat aṃgeṣu avasthiti abhāvena tathā upāsteḥ mithyā upāstitayā saṃcaraṇena nityam bhagavat aṃgeṣu avasthiti abhāvena tathā upāsteḥ mithyā upāstitayā

original: anatharphalatvācca na tathopāsanaṃ kāryamiti | siddhāntastu | "svotpattyagaṃ ca devānāṃ viṣṇościntyam‌' iti smṛtyā devānāṃ muktau bhagavadaṃgapraveśasyāvaśyakatayā tasya ca sadā tādṛśaguṇopāsanena vinā siddhayabhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: na tathā upāsanam kāryam iti siddhāntaḥ tu sva utpatti agam ca devānām viṣṇoḥ cintyam iti smṛtyā devānām muktau bhagavat aṃga praveśasya āvaśyaka tayā tasya ca sadā tādṛśa guṇa upāsanena vinā siddhayabhāvāt

original: bhagavadagapraveśarūpakāraṇasattvāt‌ nityaṃ rūpāntareṇa bhagavadaṃśeṣu sthitatvena mithyopāsanā'prasakteśca svāśrayacakṣuṣkatayā sūryeṇa, candrāśrayamanaskatayā candreṇa, brahmāśritamūrdhatayā brahmaṇā, ityevaṃrūpeṇa devaiḥ sadā sarvatra kāryamevopāsanamiti |
analyzed: bhagavat aga praveśa rūpa kāraṇa sattvāt nityam rūpa antareṇa bhagavat aṃśeṣu sthita tvena mithyā upāsana a prasakteḥ ca sva āśraya cakṣuṣkatayā sūryeṇa candra āśraya manaskatayā candreṇa brahma āśrita mūrdhatayā brahmaṇā iti evaṃrūpeṇa devaiḥ sadā sarvatra kāryam eva upāsanam iti

original: phalaṃ tu ātmatvopāsanasamarthanameva satyapyāśrayāśrayibhāve svasvāmisambandhasyāpi anupāsyatvāpātāditi śaṃkānirāsāt‌ || 5 ||
analyzed: phalam tu ātmatva upāsana samarthanam eva sati api āśraya āśrayi bhāve sva svāmi sambandhasya api anupāsya tva āpātāt iti śaṃkā nirāsāt

original: || oṃ āsīnaḥ saṃbhavāt‌ oṃ || 6 ||
analyzed: om āsīnaḥ saṃbhavāt om

original: || oṃ dhyānācca oṃ || oṃ acalatvaṃ cāpekṣya oṃ || oṃ smaranti ca oṃ || oṃ yatraikāgratā tatrāviśeṣāt‌ oṃ ||
analyzed: om dhyānāt ca om om acala tvam ca apekṣya om om smaranti ca om om yatra ekāgra tā tatra aviśeṣāt om

original: pūrvaṃ saṃmugdhatayoktopāsanasya dhyānasmaraṇabhedoktipūrvamitikartavyatākathanātsaṃgatiḥ | "upaviśyāsane yuṃjvāt‌' iti ṣaṣṭhe gītāyāṃ dhyānāṃgatvena uktamāsanādikaṃ kiṃ nāvaśyakamutāvaśyakamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ āsanena vinopāsanopayuktaḥ harau manoniveśaḥ yukta uta na yukta iti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: pūrvam saṃmugdha tayā ukta upāsanasya dhyāna smaraṇa bheda ukti pūrvam itikartavya tā kathanāt saṃgatiḥ upaviśya āsane iti ṣaṣṭhe gītāyām dhyāna aṃga tvena uktam āsana ādikam kim na āvaśyakam uta āvaśyakam iti cintā tad artham āsanena vinā upāsana upayuktaḥ harau manaḥ niveśaḥ yuktaḥ uta na yuktaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: bhagavaddṛṣyihetūpāsanasya harau manoniveśamātreṇopapatteḥ āsanaṃ nāvaśyakam‌ | na cāsanena vinā harau manoniveśa eva na yukta iti vācyam‌ | pratyāhārādināpi tatsaṃbhavāt‌ | anyathā "smartavyassatataṃ viṣṇuḥ' ityādividhīnāmanupapattiprasaṃgāt‌ |
analyzed: bhagavat dṛṣyi hetu upāsanasya harau manaḥ niveśa mātreṇa upapatteḥ āsanam nā āvaśyakam na ca āsanena vinā harau manaḥ niveśaḥ eva na yuktaḥ iti vācyam pratyāhāra ādinā api tad saṃbhavāt anyathā smartavyaḥ satatam viṣṇuḥ ityādi vidhīnām anupapatti prasaṃgāt

original: yadi cāsanādyupadeśānyathānupapattyā tadāvaśyakatve ca "parvatāgre nadī tīre' "brāhme muhūrte utthāya' ityādyuktyanyathānupapattyā deśādiniyamopyāvaśyakaḥ syāditi | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: yadi ca āsana ādi upadeśa anyathā anupapattyā tad āvaśyaka tve ca parvata agre nadī tīre brāhme muhūrte utthāya ityādi ukti anyathā anupapattyā deśa ādi niyamaḥ upi āvaśyakaḥ syāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: manaso vikṣepābhāvena harau niveśasya pratyāhārādinā saṃbhave'pi "acalaṃ ceccharīraṃ syānmanasaścāpyacālanam‌' iti smṛtyā śarīrācalatvenāpi manaso vikṣepābhāvasyāvagamāt‌ | śarīrācalatvasya ca āsana eva saṃbhavāt‌ | "samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvam‌' ityādi smṛtibalācca upāsanopayuktatayā samyagbhagavati manoniveśanārthaṃ āvaśyakamevāsanam‌ |
analyzed: manasaḥ vikṣepa abhāvena harau niveśasya pratyāhāra ādinā saṃbhave pi acalam ced śarīram syāt manasaḥ ca api acālanam iti smṛtyā śarīra acala tvena api manasaḥ vikṣepa abhāvasya avagamāt śarīra acala tvasya ca āsane eva saṃbhavāt samam kāya śiraḥ grīvam ityādi smṛti balāt ca upāsana upayukta tayā samyak bhagavati manaḥ niveśana artham āvaśyakam eva āsanam

original: naca nityopāsanasyāsanāvaśyakatvasya ca viruddhatvādāsanasyāvaśyakatve "smartavyassatatam‌' iti smṛtyā upāsanavidhivirodhaḥ | smaraṇadhyānarūpeṇopāsterdvaividhyena smaraṇopāsanasya nityaṃ kāryatvena tatrāsananiyame'pi kādācitkadhyānarūpeṇopāsane tadāvaśyakatve virodhābhāvāt‌ | ata eva nāsanādyupadeśavaiyarthyam‌ |
analyzed: naca nitya upāsanasya āsana āvaśyaka tvasya ca viruddha tvāt āsanasya āvaśyaka tve smartavyaḥ satatam iti smṛtyā upāsana vidhi virodhaḥ smaraṇa dhyāna rūpeṇa upāsteḥ dvaividhyena smaraṇa upāsanasya nityam kārya tvena tatra āsana niyame api kādācitka dhyāna rūpeṇa upāsane tad āvaśyaka tve virodha abhāvāt atas eva na āsana ādi upadeśa vaiyarthyam

original: nacaivaṃ deśaviśeṣāderapi āvaśyakatvaprasaṃgaḥ | āsanādivat‌ dhyānopayogitāyā vā śravaṇādivat‌ jñānopayogitāyā vā abhāvāt‌ | "tameva deśaṃ seveta' ityādi smṛteśca yatraikāgratā dhyānasya sa eva deśādirgrāhyo na parvatāgrādiniyama iti | phalaṃ tu āsanādyupadeśasārthakatvam‌ || 6 ||
analyzed: na ca evam deśa viśeṣa ādeḥ api āvaśyaka tva prasaṃgaḥ āsana ādi vat dhyāna upayogi tāyāḥ vā śravaṇa ādi vat jñāna upayogi tāyāḥ vā abhāvāt tam eva deśam seveta ityādi smṛteḥ ca yatra ekāgra tā dhyānasya saḥ eva deśa ādiḥ grāhyaḥ na parvata agra ādi niyamaḥ iti phalam tu āsana ādi upadeśa sārthakatvam

original: || oṃ āprāyaṇāttatrāpi hi dṛṣyam‌ oṃ || 7 ||
analyzed: om ā prāyaṇāt tatra api hi dṛṣyam om

original: pūrvatra viśeṣabhāvādāsanamāvaśyakaṃ deśaviśeṣādi tu viśeṣaṇābhāvānnāvaśyakamityuktam‌ | tadvadihāpi "dhyānācca' iti prakṛtaṃ dhyānaṃ jñānaparyantameva na tu tadanantaramapi muktiparyantaṃ muktau tatkṛtaviśeṣābhāvāditi śaṃkodayātsaṃgatiḥ | atra dhyānācceti prakṛtaṃ dhyānaṃ kiṃ jñānaparyantamevāvaśyakamuta muktiparyantamapīti cintā |
analyzed: pūrvatra viśeṣa bhāvāt āsanam āvaśyakam deśa viśeṣa ādi tu viśeṣaṇa abhāvāt na āvaśyakam iti uktam tadvat iha api dhyānāt ca iti prakṛtam dhyānam jñāna paryantam eva na tu tad anantaram api mukti paryantam muktau tad kṛta viśeṣa abhāvāt iti śaṃkā udayāt saṃgatiḥ atra dhyānāt ca iti prakṛtam dhyānam kim jñāna paryantam eva āvaśyakam uta mukti paryantam api iti cintā

original: tadarthaṃ jñānārthaṃ vihitasya muktipayarntamanuṣṭhāne heturnāstyutāstīti | tadarthaṃ muktāvānandātiśayo dhyānādanyenāpi bhavatyuta dhyānenaiveti | pūrvapakṣastu | muktāvānandavṛddheḥ dhyānādanyena śravaṇādisādhanāntareṇāpi saṃbhavāt‌ jñānārthaṃ vihitasya muktiparyantamanuṣṭhāne hetvabhāvānna muktiparyantaṃ dhyānamanuṣṭheyamiti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: tad artham jñāna artham vihitasya mukti paryantam anuṣṭhāne hetuḥ na asti uta asti iti tad artham muktau ānanda atiśayaḥ dhyānāt anyena api bhavati uta dhyānena eva iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu muktau ānanda vṛddheḥ dhyānāt anyena śravaṇa ādi sādhana antareṇa api saṃbhavāt jñāna artham vihitasya mukti paryantam anuṣṭhāne hetu abhāvāt na mukti paryantam dhyānam anuṣṭheyam iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "yogarūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate' iti gītāyāṃ yogārūḍhasyāparokṣajñāninaḥ śamaḥ dhyānaṃ paramasukhakāraṇamityuktyā prādhānyena dhyānasyānandavṛddhihetutvāvagamāt‌ | "prāyaṇāntamoṃkāramabhidhyāyīta' iti śruteḥ | "muktā api hyenamupāsate' iti śrutyuktakaimutyanyāyācca kāryameva muktiparyantaṃ dhyānamiti |
analyzed: yoga rūḍhasya tasya eva śamaḥ kāraṇam ucyate iti gītāyām yoga ārūḍhasya aparokṣa jñāninaḥ śamaḥ dhyānam parama sukha kāraṇam iti uktyā prādhānyena dhyānasya ānanda vṛddhi hetutva avagamāt prāyaṇa antam oṃkāram abhidhyāyīta iti śruteḥ muktāḥ api hi enam upāsate iti śruti ukta kaimutya nyāyāt ca kāryam eva mukti paryantam dhyānam iti

original: phalaṃ tu yāvadadhikāramityādau uktatāratamyasamarthanam‌ | anyathā muktau jñānināṃ dhyānaphalābhāvaprasaṃgena tāratamyābhāvāpātāditi || 7 ||
analyzed: phalam tu yāvadadhikāram ityādau ukta tāratamya samarthanam anyathā muktau jñāninām dhyāna phala abhāva prasaṃgena tāratamya abhāva āpātāt iti

original: || oṃ tadadhigama uttarapūvarāghayoraśleṣavināśau tadvayapadeśāt‌ oṃ || 8 ||
analyzed: om tad adhigamaḥ uttara pūvara aghayoḥ aśleṣa vināśau tad vayapadeśāt om

original: || oṃ itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tu oṃ || oṃ anārabdhakārye eva tu pūrve tadavadheḥ oṃ || oṃ agnihotrādi tu tatkāryāyaiva taddarśanāt‌ oṃ || oṃ ato'nyadapītyekeṣāmubhayoḥ oṃ || oṃ yadeva vidyayeti hi oṃ || oṃ bhogena tvitare kṣapayitvā'tha sampatsyate oṃ ||
analyzed: om itarasya api evam asaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tu om om anārabdha kārye eva tu pūrve tad avadheḥ om om agnihotra ādi tu tad kāryāya eva tad darśanāt om om atas nyat api iti ekeṣām ubhayoḥ om om yat eva vidyayā iti hi om om bhogena tu itare kṣapayitvā atha sampatsyate om

original: evaṃ prāsaṃgikaṃ samāpya karmakṣayākhyaṃ mokṣasvarūpamevātrocyata ityavasarasaṃgatiḥ | "evaṃ muktiphala' iti
analyzed: evam prāsaṃgikam samāpya karma kṣaya ākhyam mokṣa svarūpam eva atra ucyate iti avasara saṃgatiḥ evam mukti phale iti

original: pūvaroktajñānānmuktirayukteti cintā | tadarthaṃ muktipratibandhakānāṃ jñānapūrvāparabhāvikarmaṇāṃ jñānānnāśādikamayuktamuta yuktamiti cintā | tadarthaṃ nāśādyaṅgīkṛtau bādhakamastyuta neti | pūrvapakṣastu | "evaṃ muktiphalāniyamaḥ' ityatra karmakṛtapratibandhābhāve jñānānmuktirbhavatyevetyuktamayuktam‌ |
analyzed: pūvara ukta jñānāt muktiḥ ayuktā iti cintā tad artham mukti pratibandhakānām jñāna pūrva apara bhāvi karmaṇām jñānāt nāśa ādikam ayuktam uta yuktam iti cintā tad artham nāśa ādi aṅgīkṛtau bādhakam asti uta na iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu evam mukti phala aniyamaḥ iti atra karma kṛta pratibandha abhāve jñānāt muktiḥ bhavati eva iti uktam ayuktam

original: jñānātpūrvaṃ paścāccānuṣṭhitakarmaṇāṃ pratibandhakībhūtānāṃ nivṛttyayogāt‌ | tatkiṃ pūrvakarmaṇāṃ bhogena nivṛttiruta agninā tūlasyeva jñānena nāśaḥ uttareṣāmalepaḥ | ādye kiṃ tasminneva dehe teṣāṃ bhoga uta dehāntare | ante'pi kiṃ krameṇota ekasminneva janmani kāyavyūhena yugapadeva bhogaḥ | nādyaḥ | bahudehaphalakarmaṇāṃ bhāvāt‌ | na dvitīyaḥ |
analyzed: jñānāt pūrvam paścāt ca anuṣṭhita karmaṇām pratibandhakībhūtānām nivṛtti ayogāt tat kim pūrva karmaṇām bhogena nivṛttiḥ uta agninā tūlasya iva jñānena nāśaḥ uttareṣām alepaḥ ādye kim tasmin eva dehe teṣām bhogaḥ uta deha antare ante pi kim krameṇa uta ekasmin eva janmani kāya vyūhena yugapad eva bhogaḥ na ādyaḥ bahu deha phala karmaṇām bhāvāt na dvitīyaḥ

original: tathātve bahukālāntaritajñānasya jīrṇabījavanmokṣahetutvābhāvāpatteḥ | na tṛtīyaḥ | aniyatadeśakālavipākatvāt‌ tādṛśānāmapi yogaprabhāvenaikadeśakālayoreva bhoga ityaṅgīkāre ca yogasāmarthyādbhogābhāvaprasaṅgāt‌ | tadbhogakāleṣu punaḥ karmāntarasaṃbhavenāsamāpteśca |
analyzed: tathātve bahu kāla antarita jñānasya jīrṇa bīja vat mokṣa hetutva abhāva āpatteḥ na tṛtīyaḥ aniyata deśa kāla vipāka tvāt tādṛśānām api yoga prabhāvena eka deśa kālayoḥ eva bhogaḥ iti aṅgīkāre ca yoga sāmarthyāt bhoga abhāva prasaṅgāt tad bhoga kāleṣu punar karma antara saṃbhavena asamāpteḥ ca

original: naca na karoti jñānī "na hi kaścitkṣaṇamapi jātu tiṣṭhatyakarmakṛt‌' iti gītoktivirodhāt‌ | na caturthaḥ | "nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi' iti smṛtivirodhāt‌ | jñānenaiva karmakṣaye jñānotpattyuttarakālameva mokṣāpātāt‌ |
analyzed: na ca na karoti jñānī na hi kaścid kṣaṇam api jātu tiṣṭhati akarma kṛt iti gīta ukti virodhāt na caturthaḥ na abhuktam kṣīyate karma kalpa koṭi śataiḥ api iti smṛti virodhāt jñānena eva karma kṣaye jñāna utpatti uttara kālam eva mokṣa āpātāt

original: kiṃ ca jñāninaḥ prācīnapuṇyakarmaṇo'pi jñānena kṣaye "sarvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruteḥ' ityatra jñānopayogoktivirodhaḥ | uttarasyāśleṣe ca stuninayokta ānandātiśayahetutvavirodhaḥ syāditi | anenaiva nyāyena "aniṣyādikāriṇām‌' iti vairāgyapādīya ekādaśādhikaraṇe haridviṣāṃ tamaḥprāptyuktirayuktā |
analyzed: kim ca jñāninaḥ prācīna puṇya karmaṇaḥ api jñānena kṣaye sarva apekṣā ca yajña ādi śruteḥ iti atra jñāna upayoga ukti virodhaḥ uttarasya āśleṣe ca ānanda atiśaya hetutva virodhaḥ syāt iti anena eva nyāyena aniṣya ādi kāriṇām iti vairāgyapādīye ekādaśa adhikaraṇe haridviṣām tamaḥ prāpti uktiḥ ayuktā

original: dveṣapūrtitaḥ prāgūrdhvaṃ satāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhogena vā dveṣapūrtyā vā nāśasyāśleṣasya vā ayogāditi | siddhāntastu | bhogena karmaṇāṃ kṣayayoge'pi jñānodayānantaraṃ karmānuṣṭhānabhāve'pi jñānānmokṣo yukta eva | jñānena pūrvāparakarmanāśāśleṣābhyupagamānnoktadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: dveṣa pūrtitaḥ prāk ūrdhvam satām karmaṇām bhogena vā dveṣa pūrtyāḥ vā nāśasya āśleṣasya vā ayogāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu bhogena karmaṇām kṣaya yoge api jñāna udaya anantaram karma anuṣṭhāna bhāve api jñānāt mokṣaḥ yuktaḥ eva jñānena pūrva apara karma nāśa āśleṣa abhyupagamāt na ukta doṣaḥ

original: jñānena prācīnānāṃ aprārabdhāśeṣapāpakarmaṇāṃ puṇyamadhyepi aprārabdhānabhīṣyakāmyapuṇyakarmaṇāmeva nāśopagamena tadanyapuṇyapāpayorbhāvena "nābhuktam‌' itismṛtestadviṣayatayā tadvirodhasya jñānotpattyuttarakṣaṇa eva mokṣasya prācīnapuṇyajñānopayogoktyavirodhasya copapatteḥ |
analyzed: jñānena prācīnānām aprārabdha aśeṣa pāpa karmaṇām puṇya madhye api aprārabdha anabhīṣya kāmya puṇya karmaṇām eva nāśa upagamena tad anya puṇya pāpayoḥ bhāvena na abhuktam iti smṛteḥ tad viṣaya tayā tad virodhasya jñāna utpatti uttara kṣaṇe eva mokṣasya prācīna puṇya jñāna upayoga ukti avirodhasya ca upapatteḥ

original: tathottarasyāpi pāpasyāśucitvādyanāpādakatvarūpāśleṣasya akāmyapuṇyasya ca mokṣe sukhātiśayahetutvasya copagamena stutinayoktavirodhasyābhāvāt‌ | prārabdhapuṇyapāpānāṃ aprārabdhakāmyapūrvottarābhīṣyapuṇyakarmaṇāṃ ca bhogena kṣapaṇasambhavācca | ato bādhakābhāvāt‌ jñānātkarmanāśādikaṃ yuktameveti jñānānmokṣo yukta eva |
analyzed: tathā uttarasya api pāpasya aśuci tva ādi anāpādaka tva rūpa āśleṣasya akāmya puṇyasya ca mokṣe sukha atiśaya hetu tvasya ca upagamena stuti naya ukta virodhasya abhāvāt prārabdha puṇya pāpānām aprārabdha kāmya pūrva uttara abhīṣya puṇya karmaṇām ca bhogena kṣapaṇa sambhavāt ca atas bādhaka abhāvāt jñānāt karma nāśa ādikam yuktam eva iti jñānāt mokṣaḥ yuktaḥ eva

original: evaṃ dveṣiṇo'pi dveṣapūrtitaḥ prākkṛtāśeṣāprārabdhapuṇyānāṃ nāśasya udīcīnāṃ aśeṣapuṇyānāmaśleṣasya prārabdhapuṇyapāpānāṃ bhogena kṣapaṇasyopagamāt‌ dveṣiṇastamaḥprāptyuktirapyupapanneti | phalaṃ tu prāguktaprameyasamarthanaṃ vyaktam‌ || 8 ||
analyzed: evam dveṣiṇaḥ api dveṣa pūrtitaḥ prāk kṛta aśeṣa aprārabdha puṇyānām nāśasya udīcīnām aśeṣa puṇyānām aśleṣasya prārabdha puṇya pāpānām bhogena kṣapaṇasya upagamāt dveṣiṇaḥ tamaḥ prāpti uktiḥ api upapannā iti phalam tu prāc ukta prameya samarthanam vyaktam

original: || iti śrīmadrāghavendrayatikṛtāyāṃ nyāyamuktāvalyāṃ caturthādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat rāghavendrayati kṛtāyām nyāyamuktāvalyām caturtha adhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ

original: || atha dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: atha dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

original: jñānino'taḥpadoktamokṣaphalāya jñānabhogābhyāṃ karmakṣaya uktaḥ pūrvapāde | atra tu kamarkṣayasādhyadehakṣayakrama ucyate iti pūrvānantaryamasya pādasya dhyeyam‌ |
analyzed: jñāninā utas pada ukta mokṣa phalāya jñāna bhogābhyām karma kṣayaḥ uktaḥ pūrva pāde atra tu kama ṛc ṣaya sādhya deha kṣaya kramaḥ ucyate iti pūrva ānantaryam asya pādasya dhyeyam

original: || oṃ vāṅmanasi darśanācchabdācca oṃ || 1 ||
analyzed: om vāc manasi darśanāt śabdāt ca om

original: || oṃ ata eva ca sarvāṇyanu oṃ ||
analyzed: om atas eva ca sarvāṇi anu om

original: || oṃ jñānināṃ dehakṣayo dvividhaḥ | devānāṃ svottameṣu layo'nyeṣāṃ brahmanāḍyotkramaṇeneti | tatra devānāmadhikāryuttamatvādādau teṣāṃ "avibhāgo vacanāt‌' ityataḥ prāktanasaptabhiradhikaraṇaiḥ dehalayobhidhīyate | tatra vāgdevyā bhagavatprāptilakṣaṇamokṣāya manodeve layo'śakyanirṇayo'tha śakyanirṇaya iti cintā |
analyzed: om jñāninām deha kṣayaḥ dvividhaḥ devānām sva uttameṣu layaḥ nyeṣām brahmanāḍyā utkramaṇena iti tatra devānām adhikāri uttama tvāt ādau teṣām avibhāgaḥ vacanāt iti atas prāktana saptabhiḥ adhikaraṇaiḥ deha layaḥ abhidhīyate tatra vāgdevyāḥ bhagavat prāpti lakṣaṇa mokṣāya manodeve śakya nirṇayaḥ iti cintā

original: tadatharṃ manovedasya uttamatvaṃ nirṇetumaśakyamuta śakyamiti | tadarthaṃ "vākpūrvarūpaṃ mana uttararūpam‌' "manaḥ pūrvarūpaṃ vāguttararūpam‌' iti vyāmiśroktiḥ vāṅmanasayoranyajanmoktyā samaprādhānyāvagamena manasa uttamatvanirṇayāya "viparyayeṇa tu kramo'ta upapadyate ca' ityatra svasṛṣyatayā svottamadeva eva layasya vācyatvāt‌ vāco manolayaḥ
analyzed: tat atha ṛṃ manaḥ vedasya uttama tvam nirṇetum aśakyam uta śakyam iti tad artham vāc pūrva rūpam manaḥ uttara rūpam manaḥ pūrva rūpam vāc uttara rūpam iti vyāmiśra uktiḥ vāc manasayoḥ anya janma uktyā sama prādhānya avagamena manasaḥ uttama tva nirṇayāya viparyayeṇa tu krama ūtaḥ upapadyate ca iti atra sva sṛṣya tayā sva uttama devaḥ eva layasya vācya tvāt vācaḥ manaḥ layaḥ

original: aśakyanirṇaya iti | siddhāntastu | vāco manovaśyatvasya sarvapratyakṣasiddhatvāt‌ "manasā vāgre saṃkalpayatyatha vācā vyāharati' iti vākpravṛtteḥ
analyzed: aśakya nirṇayaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ tu vācaḥ manaḥ vaśya tvasya sarva pratyakṣa siddha tvāt manasā vā agre saṃkalpayati atha vācā vyāharati iti vāc pravṛtteḥ

original: manaḥpravṛttipūrvakatvayuktyupetatayā viśeṣaṇācca manasa uttamatvanirṇayasambhavāt‌ vāgdevyā manodeve layo'styeveti | naca vyāmiśroktivirodhaḥ | tasyāḥ saṃhitāyāḥ pūrvottaravarṇadevatātve guṇapradhānabhāve ca māṃḍūkeyatajjyeṣṭhaputrayorvivādaparatvāt‌ | vyaktametadaitareyabhāṣye |
analyzed: manaḥ pravṛtti pūrvakatva yukti upeta tayā viśeṣaṇāt ca manasaḥ uttama tva nirṇaya sambhavāt vāgdevyāḥ manodeve na ca vyāmiśra ukti virodhaḥ tasyāḥ saṃhitāyāḥ pūrva uttara varṇa devatā tve guṇa pradhāna bhāve ca māṃḍūkeya tad jyeṣṭha putrayoḥ vivāda paratvāt vyaktam etat aitareya bhāṣye

original: phalaṃ tu pūrvapakṣe vāgdevyāḥ mokṣābhāvenāniyamaḥ sarveṣāmityuktyākṣepaḥ | siddhānte tatsamādhiḥ | atra vāgdevī vāruṇī sauparṇī ca | manodevaḥ śeṣaḥ suparṇaśca jñeyāḥ | etena "agnau sarve devā vilīyante agnirindre' ityādiśrutibalātsarvadevānāmapi svasvottamadeveṣu layaḥ siddho bhavati | tatra vyāmiśroktyādirūpabādhakābhāvāditi |
analyzed: phalam tu pūrvapakṣe vāgdevyāḥ mokṣa abhāvena aniyamaḥ sarveṣām iti ukti ākṣepaḥ siddhānte tad samādhiḥ atra vāgdevī vāruṇī sauparṇī ca manaḥ devaḥ śeṣaḥ suparṇaḥ ca jñeyāḥ etena agnau sarve devāḥ vilīyante agniḥ indre ityādi śruti balāt sarva devānām api sva sva uttamadeveṣu layaḥ siddhaḥ bhavati tatra vyāmiśra ukti ādi rūpa bādhaka abhāvāt iti

original: atra ṭīkāyāṃ manasi līyate na veti saṃdehavākye ityanirṇayo'tha līyata eveti nirṇaya iti śeṣo vā nobhayathāpi sambhavatīti pūrvapakṣapravṛttiriti vā tasyābhiprāyo dhyeyaḥ | tena na pūrvapakṣānānuguṇyamitiśaṃkā kāryā || 1 ||
analyzed: atra ṭīkāyām manasi līyate na vā iti saṃdeha vākye līyate eva iti nirṇayaḥ iti śeṣaḥ vā na ubhayathā api sambhavati iti pūrvapakṣa pravṛttiḥ iti vā tasya abhiprāyaḥ dhyeyaḥ tena na pūrvapakṣa ānānuguṇyam iti śaṃkā kāryā

original: || oṃ tanmanaḥ prāṇa uttarāt‌ oṃ || 2 ||
analyzed: om tat manaḥ prāṇaḥ uttarāt om

original: atrādhikaraṇatraye vāṅmanasi līyata ityādiśrautakramātkramo dhyeyaḥ | atra manodevasya prāṇadevādutpattirnāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: atra adhikaraṇa traye vāc manasi līyate ityādi śrauta kramāt kramaḥ dhyeyaḥ atra manaḥ devasya prāṇa devāt utpattiḥ na asti uta asti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: prāṇadevasya caturmukhasya sarvatra pravṛttihetutvamiva manodevasyāpi śeṣādeḥ sarvatra pravṛttikāraṇatvena tattadanubhavasiddhānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ siddhatayā ceṣyakatvasāmye manodevasya prāṇādevādanūnabalavattvānna manodevaḥ prāṇe līyate | ato nāsti mokṣaḥ | "viparyayeṇa' ityatroktadiśā adhikabale eva nyūnabalo līyate iti vaktavyatvāt‌ |
analyzed: prāṇadevasya caturmukhasya sarvatra pravṛtti hetutvam iva manodevasya api śeṣa ādeḥ sarvatra pravṛtti kāraṇatvena tad tad anubhava siddha anvaya vyatirekābhyām siddhatayā ceṣyakatva sāmye manodevasya prāṇādevāt anūna balavat tvāt na manodevaḥ prāṇe līyate atas na asti mokṣaḥ viparyayeṇa iti atra ukta diśā adhika bale eva nyūna balaḥ līyate iti vaktavya tvāt

original: naca manasaḥ prāṇajatvāt‌ tatra layaḥ śaṃkyaḥ | "tatprāk‌śruteśca' iti sūtre bhagavadutpattyokteriti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: na ca manasaḥ prāṇa ja tvāt tatra layaḥ śaṃkyaḥ tad prāk śruteḥ ca iti sūtre bhagavat utpattyā ukteḥ iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "vāṅmanasi sampadyante' ityuktyā "manaḥ prāṇe' iti manodevasya prāṇadeve saṃpattiśabditalayaśravaṇāt‌ manodevo'pi prāṇadeve caturmukhe vacanāntarabalādvāṇīdvārā līyata "mana udakramāt‌' ityādyaitareyaśrutau brahmadehānmanodevasyotkramaṇapraveśayorapi taddehapātotthānayorabhāvasya prāṇadevotkramaṇapraveśayostadbhāvasya śravaṇena manodevādapi
analyzed: vāc manasi sampadyante iti uktyā manaḥ prāṇe iti manaḥ devasya prāṇadeve saṃpatti śabdita laya śravaṇāt manaḥ devaḥ api prāṇadeve caturmukhe vacana antara balāt vāṇī dvārā līyata manaḥ udakramāt iti ādi aitareya śrutau brahma dehāt manaḥ devasya utkramaṇa praveśayoḥ api tad dehapāta utthānayoḥ abhāvasya prāṇadeva utkramaṇa praveśayoḥ tad bhāvasya śravaṇena manaḥ devāt api

original: prāṇadevasyādhikyāvagamena ceṣyakatvasāmyābhāvādbhagavadutapannatvasya viyatpadīyanyāyena prāṇadevadvāropapattyā "vāyorvāva rudra udeti' iti śrutyā ca manasaḥ prāṇajatvācca asti manaso mokṣa iti | phalaṃ tu pūrvavat‌ || 2 ||
analyzed: prāṇadevasya ādhikya avagamena ceṣyaka tva sāmya abhāvāt bhagavat utapanna tvasya viyatpadīya nyāyena prāṇadeva dvāra upapattyā vāyoḥ vāva rudraḥ udeti iti śrutyā ca manasaḥ prāṇa ja tvāt ca asti manasaḥ mokṣaḥ iti phalam tu pūrvavat

original: || oṃ so'dhyakṣo tadupagamādibhyaḥ oṃ || 3 ||
analyzed: om tad upagama ādibhyaḥ om

original: atra śrautakramādvā pūrvanayadvayaphalākṣepādvā saṃgatiḥ | atra prāṇapadokto viriṃcaḥ bhagavatprāptirūpamokṣāya harau na līyate'tha līyata iti cintā | tadarthaṃ tasyeśādhīnatvaniścayo nāstyutāstīti | tadarthaṃ prāṇasvātantyaśrutibāhulyaṃ anadyamānatve satyattṛtvamāhātmyaṃ ca niravakāśamuta sāvakāśamiti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: atra śrauta kramāt vā pūrva naya dvaya phala ākṣepāt vā saṃgatiḥ atra prāṇa pada uktaḥ viriṃcaḥ bhagavat prāpti rūpa mokṣāya harau na līyate iti cintā tad artham tasya īśa adhīnatva niścayaḥ na asti uta asti iti tad artham prāṇa svātantya śruti bāhulyam anadyamāna tve sati attṛ tva māhātmyam ca niravakāśam uta sa avakāśam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: "na prāṇaḥ kiṃcidāśritaḥ' iti, "yasminnidaṃ sarvamadhyā not‌' iti, "prāṇasyaitadvaśe sarvaṃ tridive yatpratiṣṭhitam‌' iti, "vāyunā vai gautamasūtreṇa' ityādiśrutibāhulyena prāṇasya ananyādhīnatvāvagamena īśādhīnatvaniścayānna tatra viriṃcasya layaḥ |
analyzed: na prāṇaḥ kiṃcid āśritaḥ iti yasmin idam sarvam adhyā not iti prāṇasya etat vaśe sarvam tridive yat pratiṣṭhitam iti vāyunā vai gautamasūtreṇa ityādi śruti bāhulyena prāṇasya ananya adhīna tva avagamena īśa adhīna tva niścayāt na tatra viriṃcasya layaḥ

original: naca "ananyeśvaratā prāṇe tadanyeśvaravarjanam‌' ityuktadiśā viṣṇvanyeśvaravarjanaparatvena śrutīnāṃ sāvakāśatvaṃ śaṃkyam‌ | bahutvaprayuktaprābalyopetānāṃ śrutīnāṃ ananyetyādidurbalavacanena gatyantarakalpanāyogāt‌ | anadyamāna iti prāṇasya layābhāvokteśceti | siddhāntastu | astyeva prāṇapadoktaviriṃcasya harau layaḥ |
analyzed: na ca ananya īśvara tā prāṇe tad anya īśvara varjanam iti ukta diśā viṣṇu anya īśvara varjana paratvena śrutīnām sāvakāśa tvam śaṃkyam bahutva prayukta prābalya upetānām śrutīnām ananyā ityādi durbala vacanena gati antara kalpanā yogāt an adyamānaḥ iti prāṇasya laya abhāva ukteḥ ca iti siddhāntaḥ tu asti eva prāṇa pada ukta viriṃcasya harau layaḥ

original: prāṇasyāsvātante śrutibāhulyasyeśādhīnatve'pi "prāṇaḥ parasyāṃ devatāyām‌' iti, "prāṇaḥ paramupagacchati' iti, "prāṇaḥ paramanuprāṇiti' ityādiśrutibāhulyasya sattvāt‌ | naca sāmyeneśādhīnatvānirṇayaḥ |
analyzed: prāṇasya asvātante śruti bāhulyasya īśa adhīna tve pi prāṇaḥ parasyām devatāyām iti prāṇaḥ param upagacchati iti prāṇaḥ param anuprāṇiti ityādi śruti bāhulyasya sattvāt na ca sāmyena īśa adhīna tva anirṇayaḥ

original: svātantyaśrutīnāṃ "sarveprāṇamupagacchanti'iti, "prāṇaṃ devā anuprāṇanti' "ananyeśvaratā prāṇetadanyeśvaravarjanam‌' ityādi vacanabalena rudrādisarvopajīvyatvabhagavadanyeśvaravarjanaparatvena sāvakāśatvāt‌ | anadyamānatvasyeśādanyairanadyamānatvenopapatteriti |
analyzed: svātantya śrutīnām sarve prāṇam upagacchanti iti prāṇam devāḥ anuprāṇanti ananya īśvara tā ityādi vacana balena rudra ādi sarva upajīvya tva bhagavat anya īśvara varjana paratvena sāvakāśa tvāt anadyamāna tvasya īśāt anyaiḥ anadyamāna tvena upapatteḥ iti

original: prāṇastejasītiśrutau tejasi śrītattve prāṇasya layaśravaṇaṃ tu "prāṇasya tejasi layo mārgamātram‌' iti smṛtyā tatprāptimātraparaṃ na tatra layaparam‌ | viriṃcasya sākṣātparamātmanilayayogyatvāt‌ prāṇasyeva tatra laya iti jñeyam‌ |
analyzed: prāṇaḥ tejasi iti śrutau tejasi śrītattve prāṇasya laya śravaṇam tu prāṇasya tejasi layaḥ mārga mātram iti smṛtyā tat prāpti mātra param na tatra laya param viriṃcasya sākṣāt paramātma nilaya yogya tvāt prāṇasya iva tatra layaḥ iti jñeyam

original: "cakṣurādivattu tatsahaśiṣyayādibhyaḥ' ityatra prāṇasyeśavaśatvoktāvapi iha svātante śrutibāhulyaviśeṣāśaṃketi na gatārthatā | phalaṃ tu pūrvapakṣe viriṃcasya layābhāve mokṣābhāvena tadanupraviṣyānāmaśeṣajñānināmapi mokṣābhāvena pūrvoktanayadvayākṣepadvārā aniyama ityuktākṣepātsiddhānte tatsamādhiriti || 3 ||
analyzed: cakṣuḥ ādi vat tu tat saha śiṣyayā ādibhyaḥ iti atra prāṇasya īśa vaśa tva uktau api iha svātante śruti bāhulya viśeṣa āśaṃkā iti na gatārtha tā phalam tu pūrvapakṣe viriṃcasya laya abhāve mokṣa abhāvena tad anupraviṣyānām aśeṣa jñāninām api mokṣa abhāvena pūrva ukta naya dvaya ākṣepa dvārā aniyamaḥ iti ukta ākṣepāt siddhānte tad samādhiḥ iti

original: || oṃ bhūteṣu tacchateḥ oṃ || 5 ||
analyzed: om bhūteṣu tad śateḥ om

original: pūrvoktākṣepeṇātra śaṃkanātsaṃgatiḥ | "vāṅmanasi' ityādiśrutau viśiṣyoktebhyo'nye devāḥ bhagavatprāptirūpamokṣāya kimekasminbhūtamāniti līyante'tha bhūtāntaramāniṣvapīti cintā | tadarthaṃ "agnau sarve devā vilīyante' iti śrutiḥ pratītārthanirṇāyakā bhavati na veti |
analyzed: pūrva ukta ākṣepeṇa atra śaṃkanāt saṃgatiḥ vāc manasi ityādi śrutau viśiṣya uktebhyaḥ nye devāḥ bhagavat prāpti rūpa mokṣāya kim ekasmin bhūtam āniti līyante tha bhūta antara māniṣu api iti cintā tad artham agnau sarve devāḥ vilīyante iti śrutiḥ pratīta artha nirṇāyakā bhavati na vā iti

original: tadarthaṃ bhūtāntaramāniṣu laye pramāṇaṃ nāsti prāguktanyāyaśca anirṇāyaka utāsti pramāṇaṃ prāguktanyāyaśca nirṇāyaka iti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: tad artham bhūta antara māniṣu laye pramāṇam na asti prāc ukta nyāyaḥ ca anirṇāyakaḥ uta asti pramāṇam prāc ukta nyāyaḥ ca nirṇāyakaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: "agnau sarve devāḥ' iti śruteḥ agnideve eva sarve devā vilīyante'nyatrāpi līyanta ityatra pramāṇābhāvācca yo yanniyamaḥ sa tatra līyata iti prāguktanyāyasya niyāmakānāṃ bahutvenānirṇāyakatvāt‌ prāguktasvasvaniyāmake laya ityetadayuktamiti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: agnau sarve devāḥ iti śruteḥ agni deve eva sarve devāḥ vilīyante nyatra api līyante iti atra pramāṇa abhāvāt ca yaḥ yad niyamaḥ sa tatra līyate iti prāgukta nyāyasya niyāmakānām bahutvena anirṇāyaka tvāt prāgukta sva sva niyāmake laye iti etat ayuktam iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "bhūteṣu devā vilīyante' iti bhāṣyoktaśrutyā paṃcasvapi bhūtamāniṣu yathā svasvaniyāmake devā vilīyante niyāmakānāṃ bahutve'pi "agnau sarve devā vilīyante'gnirindre indra umāyāṃ umā rudre' ityādiśrutyuktadiśā nirṇayasambhavena prāguktanyāyasyānirṇāyakatvābhāvāditi | phalaṃ tu prāguktākṣepasamādhī || 4 ||
analyzed: bhūteṣu devāḥ vilīyante iti bhāṣya ukta śrutyā paṃcasu api bhūta māniṣu yathā sva sva niyāmake devāḥ vilīyante niyāmakānām bahutve pi agnau sarve devāḥ vilīyante agniḥ indre indraḥ umāyām umā rudre ityādi śruti ukta diśā nirṇaya sambhavena prāgukta nyāyasya anirṇāyaka tva abhāvāt iti phalam tu prāgukta ākṣepa samādhī 40

original: || oṃ naikasmindarśayato hi oṃ || 5 ||
analyzed: om na ekasmin darśayataḥ hi om

original: atrāpi pūrvākṣepeṇa śaṃkanātsaṃgatiḥ | pūrvaprakṛtadevāḥ bhagavatprāptilakṣaṇamokṣasya kiṃ agnāveva līyante'tha paṃcasvapīti cintā | "bhūteṣu devā vilīyante' iti prāguktaśrutiḥ sāvakāśātha niravakāśeti | tadarthaṃ "agnau sarve devāḥ' iti śrutyanyathānupapattiḥ niravakāśota sāvakāśā |
analyzed: atra api pūrva ākṣepeṇa śaṃkanāt saṃgatiḥ pūrva prakṛta devāḥ bhagavat prāpti lakṣaṇa mokṣasya kim agnau eva paṃcasu api iti cintā bhūteṣu devāḥ vilīyante iti prāgukta śrutiḥ sa avakāśā atha niravakāśā iti tad artham agnau sarve devāḥ iti śruti anyathā anupapattiḥ niravakāśā uta sa avakāśā

original: tadarthaṃ paṃcasvapītyatra viśeṣapramāṇābhāvena agnāvitiśrutyanyatānupapatteḥ gatyantarakalpakābhāvāt‌ niravakāśatayā bhūteṣviti bahuvacanāntaśruteḥ agnau devānāṃ laye'pi agniḥ svajanakavāyau, vāyośca svajanakākāśe, layena paraṃparālayābhiprāyeṇa sāvakāśatvakalpanādagnāveva sarvadevānāṃ laya iti paṃcasvapi laya iti prāguktamayuktamiti |
analyzed: tad artham paṃcasu api iti atra viśeṣa pramāṇa abhāvena agnau iti śruti anya tā anupapatteḥ gati antara kalpaka abhāvāt niravakāśa tayā bhūteṣu iti bahuvacana anta śruteḥ agnau devānām laye api agniḥ sva janaka vāyau vāyoḥ ca sva janaka ākāśe layena paraṃparā laya abhiprāyeṇa sāvakāśa tva kalpanāt agnau eva sarva devānām laye iti paṃcasu api layaḥ iti prāguktam ayuktam iti

original: siddhāntastu | "pṛthivyāṃ ṛbhavo vilīyante' iti, "ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivyām‌' iti ca, bhāṣyoktaviśeṣapramāṇābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ paṃcasvapi bhūtamāniṣu ṛbhuprabhṛtidevānāṃ layaśravaṇādagnau sarve devā iti śruteḥ "agnāvagnayo vāyāvindraḥ' ityādi śrutau nirdiṣyāgniputrāṃ prāyeṇādhamānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhūtāntarāpraveśināṃ layaviṣayatvena sāvakāśatayā bhūteṣvitiśruteḥ
analyzed: siddhāntaḥ tu pṛthivyām ṛbhavaḥ vilīyante iti ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivyām iti ca bhāṣya ukta viśeṣa pramāṇābhyām pratyekam paṃcasu api bhūta māniṣu ṛbhu prabhṛti devānām laya śravaṇāt agnau sarve devāḥ iti śruteḥ agnau agnayaḥ vāyau indraḥ ityādi śrutau nirdiṣya agni putrām prāyeṇa adhamānām sarveṣām bhūta antara apraveśinām laya viṣaya tvena sāvakāśa tayā bhūteṣu iti śruteḥ

original: paraṃparayā layābhiprāyarūpāmukhyārthatākalpakatvāyogāt‌ niravakāśabhūteṣu iti prāguktaśrutyā paṃcasvapi bhūtamāniṣu devānāṃ prāguktapaṃcasvapi laya ityetadyuktamiti | phalaṃ vyaktam‌ || 5 ||
analyzed: paraṃparayā laya abhiprāya rūpa amukhya arthatā kalpaka tva ayogāt niravakāśa bhūteṣu iti prāgukta śrutyā paṃcasu api bhūta māniṣu devānām prāk ukta paṃcasu api layaḥ iti etat yuktam iti phalam vyaktam 5

original: || oṃ samanā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtatvaṃ cānupoṣya oṃ || 6 ||
analyzed: om samanā ca asṛti upakramāt amṛta tvam ca an upoṣya om

original: || oṃ tadapīteḥ saṃsāravyapadeśāt‌ oṃ || oṃ sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tayopalabdheḥ oṃ || oṃ nopamardenātaḥ oṃ || oṃ asyaiva copapatterūṣmā oṃ || oṃ pratiṣedhāditi cenna śārīrāt‌ oṃ || oṃ spaṣyo hyekeṣām‌ oṃ || oṃ smaryate ca oṃ ||

original: "yaṃ yaṃ vāpi' iti smṛtiḥ liṃgadarśanaṃ ca lokānusārādanyathā neyamuta "agniḥ' ityādismṛtiḥ vidyādyadhīnatvaparā yaṃ yaṃ iti vacanamanyathā neyamiti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: yam yam vā api iti smṛtiḥ liṃga darśanam ca loka anusārāt anyathā na iyam uta agniḥ ityādi smṛtiḥ vidyā ādi adhīna tva parā yam yam iti vacanam anyathā na iyam iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: "agnirjyotirahaḥśuklaḥ' iti smṛtau "dhūmo rātriḥ' iti smṛtau ca brahmaprāpticandraprāptigatyoḥ kramādaharādirātyādikālamṛtyadhīnatāvagamālloke phalānusmṛtiṃ vināpi phalaprāptidarśanācca na gatiprāptyarthaṃ gatismṛtiḥ vidyā cāpekṣitā kiṃtvaharādikālasmṛtireva |
analyzed: agniḥ jyotiḥ ahar śuklaḥ iti smṛtau dhūmaḥ rātriḥ iti smṛtau ca brahma prāpti candra prāpti gatyoḥ kramāt ahar ādi rāti ādi kāla mṛti adhīna tā avagamāt loke phala anusmṛtim vinā api phala prāpti darśanāt ca na gati prāpti artham gati smṛtiḥ vidyā ca apekṣitā kiṃtu ahar ādi kāla smṛtiḥ eva

original: naca "yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaran‌' iti smṛtau smṛtiviṣayasyaiva prāpyatvoktestadvirodhitayā "ācāryastu te gatiṃ vaktā' iti śrutyarthagatyuktirūpaliṃgavirodhaścaivaṃ sati prā notīti śaṃkyam‌ | dehatyāgakṣaṇe duḥkhena smaraṇācchāstrādinā pūrvaṃ jānanniti jñānamātrāthartvena smarannityasya neyatvāt‌ |
analyzed: na ca yam yam vā api smaran iti smṛtau smṛti viṣayasya eva prāpya tva ukteḥ tad virodhi tayā ācāryaḥ tu te gatim vaktā iti śruti artha gati ukti rūpa liṃga virodhaḥ ca evam sati noti iti śaṃkyam dehatyāga kṣaṇe duḥkhena smaraṇāt śāstra ādinā pūrvam jānan iti jñāna mātra athartvena smaran ityasya neya tvāt

original: etena liṃgadarśanamapi pratyuktaṃ jñānārthatayā tadupadeśopapatteḥ | anyathā lokānusāravirodhāditi | siddhāntastu | ādyasmṛtau "brahmavidaḥ' iti "dhūmaḥ' iti smṛtau yogīti ca viśeṣaṇācca tābhyāṃ jñānakarmarūpopāyasādhyatvapratītyā kālamṛtyadhīnatvāpratīteḥ vidyādikamavaśyamapekṣitameva | anyathā smṛtyostadviśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāpātāt‌ |
analyzed: etena liṃga darśanam api pratyuktam jñāna arthatayā tad upadeśa upapatteḥ anyathā loka anusāra virodhāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu ādya smṛtau brahma vidaḥ iti dhūmaḥ iti smṛtau yogī iti ca viśeṣaṇāt ca tābhyām jñāna karma rūpa upāya sādhyatva pratītyā kāla mṛti adhīnatva apratīteḥ vidyā ādikam avaśyam apekṣitam eva anyathā smṛtyoḥ tad viśeṣaṇa vaiyarthya āpātāt

original: aharāderabhimāninayanyāyena devatātvāt‌ kālatvābhāvācca "yaṃ yaṃ vāpi' iti smṛtau tyāgakṣaṇe smṛtyayogaḥ | mahātmanāṃ dehe sadā heyatvabuddhibhāvena tadā duḥkhābhāvāt‌ | pāmarāṇāmapi kāla eva duḥkhabhāvena tatkṣaṇe duḥkhābhāvācca | naca lokānanusāritvadoṣaḥ | loke phalaprāptau karṣaṇādikriyānuvṛtterdarśanenehāpi smṛtirūpakriyāvṛttyaṃgīkārāt‌ |
analyzed: ahar ādeḥ abhimāni naya nyāyena devatā tvāt kāla tva abhāvāt ca yam yam vā api iti smṛtau tyāga kṣaṇe smṛti ayogaḥ mahātmanām dehe sadā heya tva buddhi bhāvena tadā duḥkha abhāvāt pāmarāṇām api kāle eva duḥkha bhāvena tad kṣaṇe duḥkha abhāvāt ca na ca loka ananusāri tva doṣaḥ loke phala prāptau karṣaṇa ādi kriyā anuvṛtteḥ darśanena iha api smṛti rūpa kriyā vṛtti aṃgīkārāt

original: loke kriyā karṣaṇādirūpā | atra tu mānasīti avāntaravailakṣaṇyamātram‌ | na tāvatā tadananusāritā śaṃkanīyā atiprasaṃgāt‌ | etena liṃgadarśanamapi nānyathā neyamiti | phalaṃ tu jñānasya caturvidhamokṣahetutvākṣepasamādhī || 10 ||
analyzed: loke kriyā karṣaṇa ādi rūpā atra tu mānasī iti avāntara vailakṣaṇya mātram na tāvatā tad ananusāri tā śaṃkanīyā atiprasaṃgāt etena liṃga darśanam api nā anyathā neyam iti phalam tu jñānasya caturvidha mokṣa hetutva ākṣepa samādhī

original: || iti śrīrāghavendrayatikṛtāyāṃ nyāyamuktāvalyāṃ caturthādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ||

original: pūrvatra brahmanāḍyotkrāntānāṃ brahmaprāptau yadgatismaraṇaṃ vidyāṃtayoktaṃ sā gatistadgamyaṃ ca atrocyata iti pūrvapādānaṃtaryasya dhyeyam‌ | naca gatigamyayoḥ dvayorapyuktau pādabhedaprasaṃgaḥ śaṃkyaḥ | caramagamyena sahitasyaiva mārgatvena mārgarūpaikārthatve'pi mārgaikadeśacaramagamyasya pṛthagvivakṣayā gamyaṃ cocyata ityukteḥ |
analyzed: pūrvatra brahmanāḍyā utkrāntānām brahma prāptau yat gati smaraṇam vidyāṃtayā uktam sā gatiḥ tat gamyam ca atra ucyate iti pūrva pāda ānaṃtaryasya dhyeyam na ca gati gamyayoḥ dvayoḥ api uktau pāda bheda prasaṃgaḥ śaṃkyaḥ carama gamyena sahitasya eva mārga tvena mārga rūpa eka artha tve pi mārga eka deśa carama gamyasya pṛthak vivakṣayā gamyam ca ucyate iti ukteḥ

original: || oṃ arcirādinā tatprathiteḥ oṃ || 1 ||
analyzed: om arciḥ ādinā tad prathiteḥ om

original: pūrvatra yadgatismaraṇamāvaśyakamityuktaṃ sā gatiḥ kiṃ arcirvāyūbhayaprāthamikā acirḥprāthamikā veti cintā | tadarthaṃ śrutidvayaṃ niravakāśamuta sāvakāśamiti | tadarthamubhayaprāthamyaṃ gateraviruddhamuta viruddhamiti | tadarthaṃ sā kiṃ dvirūpā utaikarūpeti gateradhikāribhedenākṣiptayordvayorapi prāthamyavirodhena niravakāśota sāvakāśeti |
analyzed: pūrvatra yat gati smaraṇam āvaśyakam iti uktam sā gatiḥ kim arciḥ vāyu ubhaya prāthamikā acirḥ prāthamikā vā iti cintā tad artham śruti dvayam niravakāśam uta sa avakāśam iti tad artham ubhaya prāthamyam gateḥ aviruddham uta viruddham iti tad artham sā kim dvirūpā uta eka rūpā iti gateḥ adhikāri bhedena ākṣiptayoḥ dvayoḥ api prāthamya virodhena niravakāśā uta sa avakāśā iti

original: "te arciṣāmabhisaṃbhavanti' "sa vāyumāgacchati' iti śrutidvayena arcirvāyūbhayaprāthamikā gatiriti prāpte siddhāntaḥ | "dvāveva mārgau prathitāvarcirādivipaścitām‌ | dhūmādiḥ karmiṇām‌' iti smṛtāveka eva māgarḥ |
analyzed: te arciṣām abhisaṃbhavanti sa vāyum āgacchati iti śruti dvayena arciḥ vāyu ubhaya prāthamikā gatiḥ iti prāpte siddhāntaḥ dvau eva mārgau prathitau arciḥ ādi vipaścitām dhūma ādiḥ karmiṇām iti smṛtau ekaḥ eva māgaraḥ

original: sa cārcirādika eva na tu vāyvādika iti prathitapadena prasiddhatvoktyā "te'rciṣamiti śruteḥ prābalyāttadanurodhena arcirnāmikadevatāprāthamikā ekaiva brahmagatirnānekā | sa vāyu mā gacchatītiśrutistu prabalaśrutyanurodhena arciranantaraprāptyarthatayopapannā | śiṣyaṃ ṭīkāyām‌ |
analyzed: sa ca arciḥ ādikaḥ eva na tu vāyu ādikaḥ iti prathita padena prasiddha tva uktyā śruteḥ prābalyāt tad anurodhena arciḥ nāmika devatā prāthamikā ekā eva brahma gatiḥ na anekā sa vāyu mā gacchati iti śrutiḥ tu prabala śruti anurodhena arciḥ anantara prāpti arthatayā upapannā śiṣyam ṭīkāyām

original: phalaṃ tu adhikāribhedena mārgadvayasya vyavasthitatve'pi ahamatrādhikārītyanirṇayādgatismṛtyanupapattistatsamādhiśceti || 1 ||
analyzed: phalam tu adhikāri bhedena mārga dvayasya vyavasthita tve pi aham atra adhikārī iti anirṇayāt gati smṛti anupapattiḥ tad samādhiḥ ca iti

original: || oṃ vāyuśabdādaviṣaviśeṣābhyām‌ oṃ || 2 ||
analyzed: om vāyu śabdāt aviṣa viśeṣābhyām om

original: pūrvatra brahmaprāptimārge prathamaprāpyadevatādinirṇayaḥ kṛtaḥ | atra dvitīyaprāpyadevatāniṇaryaḥ kriyata iti saṃgatiḥ | pūrvavaiṣamyeṇa śaṃkanādvā saṃgatiḥ | pūrvaprakṛtārcirādimārge vāyudevatāhardevatetyubhayaṃ dvitīyaprāpyamuta vāyudaivatameveti cintā |
analyzed: pūrvatra brahma prāpti mārge prathama prāpya devatā ādi nirṇayaḥ kṛtaḥ atra dvitīya prāpya devatā niṇaryaḥ kriyate iti saṃgatiḥ pūrva vaiṣamyeṇa śaṃkanāt vā saṃgatiḥ pūrva prakṛta arciḥ ādi mārge vāyu devatā ahar devatā iti ubhayam dvitīya prāpyam uta vāyu daivatam eva iti cintā

original: tadarthaṃ "sa vāyum‌' iti "arciṣo'hariḥ' iti śrutidvayaṃ dvayordvitīyaprāpyatvaprāpakaṃ bhavatyuta neti | tadarthaṃ kiṃ dvau mārgāvutaika eveti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: tad artham sa vāyum iti arciṣaḥ hariḥ iti śruti dvayam dvayoḥ dvitīya prāpyatva prāpakam bhavati uta na iti tad artham kim dvau mārgau uta ekaḥ eva iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: pūrvatra dvāveva mārgāvitiviśeṣavacanena arciṣa eva prāthamyāvagame'pi iha vāyoreva dvitīyaprāpyatve viśeṣavacanābhāvāt‌ "arciṣo'haḥ' iti "sa vāyum‌' iti śrutidvayasyāpi prāmāṇyāt‌ mārgabhedena dvayorapi dvitīyaprāpyatve virodhābhāvācchatidvayabalāt‌ aharvāyū dvāvapi dvitīyaprāpyāviti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: pūrvatra dvau eva mārgau iti viśeṣa vacanena arciṣaḥ eva prāthamya avagame pi iha vāyoḥ eva dvitīya prāpya tve viśeṣa vacana abhāvāt arciṣā ūhaḥ iti sa vāyum iti śruti dvayasya api prāmāṇyāt mārga bhedena dvayoḥ api dvitīya prāpya tve virodha abhāvāt śati dvaya balāt ahar vāyū dvau api dvitīya prāpyau iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "sa vāyumāgacchati' iti sāmānyavacanena vāyośca prāptaprāthamyasya "dvāveva mārgau prathitau' ityuktaprasiddhivirodhena tyāge'pi dvitīyaprāpyatvasya nyāyaprāpyatvāt‌ "sa ito gato dvitīyāṃ gatiṃ vāyumāgacchati' iti viśeṣaśruteśca vāyureva dvitīyaprāpyaḥ ahaḥ tadanantaraprāpyamiti |
analyzed: sa vāyum āgacchati iti sāmānya vacanena vāyoḥ ca prāpta prāthamyasya dvau eva mārgau prathitau iti ukta prasiddhi virodhena tyāge api dvitīya prāpya tvasya nyāya prāpya tvāt saḥ itas gataḥ dvitīyām gatim vāyum āgacchati iti viśeṣa śruteḥ ca vāyuḥ eva dvitīya prāpyaḥ ahar tad anantara prāpyam iti

original: mārgadvayena dvayordvitīyaprāpyatvaṃ tu dvāvevetivacanoktaprasiddhivirodhādeva bādhitamiti | phalaṃ tu pūrvatreveti || 2 ||
analyzed: mārga dvayena dvayoḥ dvitīya prāpya tvam tu dvau eva iti vacana ukta prasiddhi virodhāt eva bādhitam iti phalam tu pūrvatra eva iti

original: || oṃ taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ sambandhāt‌ oṃ || 3 ||
analyzed: om varuṇaḥ sambandhāt om

original: "te'rciṣamabhisambhavanti arciṣo'rahna āpūryamāṇapakṣamāpūryamāṇapakṣādyān‌ ṣaḍudaṅ‌ eti māsāṃstān‌ | māsebhyaḥ saṃvatsaram‌' ityādi chandogaśrutyādyukta brahmaprāptimāge yatra vivādaḥ tadādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca prāpyaṃ nirṇītam‌ | anyatra saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ kramaprāpyeṣu vivādābhāvānnirṇaya eva |
analyzed: te ṛciṣam abhisambhavanti arciṣoḥ ahnaḥ āpūryamāṇapakṣam āpūryamāṇapakṣāt yān ṣaṭ udaṅ eti māsān tān māsebhyaḥ saṃvatsaram ityādi brahma prāpti māge yatra vivādaḥ tad ādyam dvitīyam ca prāpyam nirṇītam anyatra saṃvatsara paryantam krama prāpyeṣu vivāda abhāvāt nirṇayaḥ eva

original: saṃvatsarādanantaraṃ prajāpatilokaṃ gantuṃ kiṃ taṭidvaruṇau dvāvapi mārgabhedena prāpyāvuta mārgaikyena taṭillokaṃ prāpya veti cintā | tadarthaṃ "saṃvatsarādvaruṇalokam‌' iti "saṃvatsarāttaṭitam‌' iti ca śrutidvayaṃ tadubhayaprāptiprāpakaṃ na veti | netyatra pramāṇaṃ nāstyutāstīti |
analyzed: saṃvatsarāt anantaram prajāpati lokam gantum kim taṭit varuṇau dvau api mārga bhedena prāpyau uta mārga aikyena taṭit lokam prāpya vā iti cintā tad artham saṃvatsarāt varuṇa lokam iti saṃvatsarāt taṭitam iti ca śruti dvayam tad ubhaya prāpti prāpakam na vā iti na iti atra pramāṇam na asti uta asti iti

original: pūrvatra dvitīyāṃ gatiṃ vāyumiti viśeṣavacanena vāyordvitīyaprāpyatvanirṇayepīha tādṛśapramāṇābhāvāt‌ śrutidvayaprāmāṇyādadhikāribhedādhīnamārgabhedena dvayorapi prāpyvopapatteḥ dvāvapi lokau saṃvatsaramānilokānantaraṃ prāpyāviti saṃgatipūrvapakṣau | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: pūrvatra dvitīyām gatim vāyum iti viśeṣa vacanena vāyoḥ dvitīya prāpyatva nirṇaye api iha tādṛśa pramāṇa abhāvāt śruti dvaya prāmāṇyāt adhikāri bheda adhīna mārga bhedena dvayoḥ api dvau api prāpyau iti saṃgati pūrvapakṣau siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "taṭito varuṇaṃ gacchati taṭitā hyūhyate varuṇalokaḥ' iti viśeṣaśrutyā taṭidanantarameva sayuktikaṃ varuṇalokasya prāpyatvokteḥ mārgadvayasya ca dvāvevotyatroktabrahmaprāptimārgaikyaprasiddhivirodhayuktatayā dvayorekasminmārgai yugapatprāpyatvavirodhena śrutidvayasya dvayoḥ paurvāparyeṇaiva prāptiprāpakatvārthakatvasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt‌ pūrvaṃ
analyzed: taṭitaḥ varuṇam gacchati taṭitā hi ūhyate varuṇa lokaḥ iti viśeṣa śrutyā taṭit anantaram eva sa yuktikam varuṇa lokasya prāpya tva ukteḥ mārga dvayasya ca dvau evā iti atra ukta brahma prāpti mārga aikya prasiddhi virodha yuktatayā dvayoḥ ekasmin mārgaiḥ yugapad prāpya tva virodhena śruti dvayasya dvayoḥ paurvāparyeṇa eva prāpti prāpaka tva arthaka tvasya avaśyaṃbhāvāt pūrvam prāpti prāpaka tva arthaka tvasya avaśyaṃbhāvāt pūrvam prāpti prāpaka tv

original: taṭillokaṃ prāpya paścādvaruṇalokaṃ prā notīti | phalaṃ tu mārgānirṇayāttadanusmṛtyanupapattitatsamādhī || 3 ||
analyzed: taṭillokam prāpya paścāt varuṇa lokam noti iti phalam tu mārga anirṇayāt tad anusmṛti anupapatti tad samādhī

original: pūrvatra bhinnavākyagatabhinnapadārthayostaṭidvaruṇayoḥ paurvāparyoktau atraikavāyuśabdārthayerātivāhikamukhyayoḥ paurvāparyamucyata iti saṃgatiḥ | dvitīyāṃ gatiṃ vāyumāgacchatītiśrutau vāyuḥ kimātivāhiko'tha mukhyavāyuriti cintā | tadarthaṃ tasya ātivāhikatve mukhyasya prāpyatvaṃ na prā notyuta prā notīti |
analyzed: pūrvatra bhinna vākya gata bhinna padārthayoḥ taṭit varuṇayoḥ paurvāparya uktau atra eka vāyu śabda artha yeḥ ātivāhika mukhyayoḥ paurvāparyam ucyate iti saṃgatiḥ dvitīyām gatim vāyum āgacchati iti śrutau vāyuḥ kim ātivāhikaḥ utha mukhya vāyuḥ iti cintā tad artham tasya ātivāhika tve mukhyasya prāpya tvam na prāḥ noti uta prāḥ noti iti

original: tadarthaṃ "dyau rvāva vidyuttatpatiṃ vāyumupagamya tenaiva brahma gacchati' itiśrutavāyuśabde mukhyo vā''tivāhiko veti sandehena prāktane'pi sandehādinirṇayaḥ atha mukhya iti nirṇaya iti |

original: pūrvatra taṭito varuṇaṃ gacchatīti sayuktikavacanabalena paurvāparyanirṇaye'pi iha pūrvaḥ ātivāhikaḥ caramo mukhyaḥ iti vā pūrvo mukhyaścarama ātivāhika iti vā sandehe nirṇayābhāvāt‌ pūrvasyātivāhikatvajñāpakābhāvāt‌ somāgnīndradhruvānāmapi mārge kramātprāpyatvoktyā tāratamyakramasyātrāvivakṣitatvena mukhyasyāpi dvitīyaprāpyatvasambhavāt‌
analyzed: pūrvatra taṭitaḥ varuṇam gacchati iti sayuktika vacana balena paurvāparya nirṇaye api iha pūrvaḥ ātivāhikaḥ caramaḥ mukhyaḥ iti vā pūrvaḥ mukhyaḥ caramaḥ ātivāhikaḥ iti vā sandehe nirṇaya abhāvāt pūrvasya ātivāhika tva jñāpaka abhāvāt soma agni indra dhruvānām api mārge kramāt prāpya tva uktyā tāratamya kramasya atra avivakṣita tvena mukhyasya api dvitīya prāpya tva sambhavāt

original: brahmaprāptimārge caramaprāptinirūpaṇādvā | "sa enān‌ brahma' iti pūrvatrodāhṛtaśrutigatabrahmapadārthanirūpaṇādvā pūrvasaṃgatiḥ | atra sa enān‌ brahmeti śrutaṃ brahma kiṃ caturmukha evātha brahmaiva utobhayamapīti cintā | tadarthamubhayamiti pakṣe ekaikapakṣoktasādhakabādhake samīkartuṃ na śakyete kiṃ vā śakyete iti |

original: tathobhayaprāptipakṣe yugapadubhayaprāpterayogāttatra krame pramāṇaṃ nāstyutāstīti | pūrvapakṣastu | caturmukha evedaṃ śrutyuktaṃ brahma | yadiha vāva paramabhipaśyati prā noti prā noti brahmāṇaṃ caturmukham‌' iti śrutyā "brahmaṇā saha te sarve samprāpte pratisaṃcare |

original: parasyānte parātmānaḥ praviśanti paraṃ padam‌ ||' iti smṛtyā "tathā'pi prakṛterbandho brahmaṇā saha bhidyate' ityādinā caturmukhamuktipayarntaṃ bandhasya santatatvena tatorvāk‌ caturmukhasyaiva śravaṇādisādhanairaparokṣīkṛtatvāttasyaiva prāpteryuktatvādityupapattyā ca caturmukhaprāpterevāvagamena bādhakena mukhyārthasyāpi parabrahmaṇastyāgena
analyzed: parasya ante parātmānaḥ praviśanti param padam iti smṛtyā tathā api prakṛteḥ bandhaḥ brahmaṇā saha bhidyate ityādinā bandhasya santata tvena bandhasya santata tvena caturmukhasya eva śravaṇa ādi sādhanaiḥ aparokṣīkṛta tvāt tasya eva prāpteḥ yukta tvāt iti upapattyā ca caturmukha prāpteḥ eva avagamena bādhakena mukhya arthasya api para brahmaṇaḥ tyāgena

original: amukhyārthaviriṃcagrahaṇopapatteḥ | naca "brahmavidā noti param‌' iti parabrahmaprāptiśrutivirodhaḥ | tasya
analyzed: a mukhya artha viriṃca grahaṇa upapatteḥ na ca brahma vidā param iti para brahma prāpti śruti virodhaḥ tasya

original: sāmānyavākyasya prāguktaviśeṣaśrutyādinā caturmukhaprāptyanantaraṃ acireṇa pralayakāle tena saha paramā notīti sāmīpyārthatayā sāvakāśatvasambhavādityādyaḥ | sa enān‌ brahmetyatra brahmapadārthaḥ parabrahmaiva brahmaśabdasya tatra mukhyatvāt‌ |

original: tasyaiva śravaṇādisādhanairevāparokṣīkṛtatvāccaturmukhe ca śravaṇādisādhanārjitapratipatteḥ caturmukhaṃ prā nuvānītīcchāyāścābhāvāditi dvitīyaḥ | ubhayasvīkārapakṣasya coktahetūnāṃ samīkaraṇāyogāt‌ yugapatprāptyayogaśceti | kramaprāptipakṣasya ca mānābhāvenāyogāditi |
analyzed: tasya eva śravaṇa ādi sādhanaiḥ eva aparokṣīkṛta tvāt caturmukhe ca śravaṇa ādi sādhana arjita pratipatteḥ caturmukham pra nuvāni iti icchāyāḥ ca abhāvāt iti dvitīyaḥ ubhaya svīkāra pakṣasya ca ukta hetūnām samīkaraṇa ayogāt yugapad prāpti ayogaḥ ca iti krama prāpti pakṣasya ca māna abhāvena ayogāt iti

original: siddhāntastu caturmukha eva parabrahmaivetyanyavyāvṛttyā tattanmātrārthakatve viśeṣahetvabhāvenoktahetūnāṃ tattadarthagrahaṇamātrasyaivopapādakatvāt‌ ubhayamapi brahmaśabdārthatvena atra prāptiśrutau vivakṣitam‌ |
analyzed: siddhāntaḥ tu caturmukhaḥ eva para brahma eva iti anya vyāvṛttyā tad tanmātra arthakatve viśeṣa hetu abhāvena ukta hetūnām tad tad artha grahaṇa mātrasya eva upapādaka tvāt ubhayam api brahma śabda artha tvena atra prāpti śrutau vivakṣitam

original: yattu caturmukhagrahaṇe pratipattyabhisandhyabhāvarūpaṃ bādhakamuktaṃ yacca parabrahmagrahaṇena "gatyupapatteḥ' ityatra bandhasya santatatvarūpabādhakamuktaṃ tatrādyaṃ pratīkālambanānāṃ paraprāptyanaṃgīkāreṇa teṣāṃ pratipattyāderabhāvānna bādhakam‌ |
analyzed: yat tu caturmukha grahaṇe pratipatti abhisandhi abhāva rūpam bādhakam uktam yat ca para brahma grahaṇena gati upapatteḥ iti atra bandhasya santata tva rūpa bādhakam uktam tatra ādyam pratīka ālambanānām para prāpti anaṃgīkāreṇa teṣām pratipatti ādeḥ abhāvāt na bādhakam

original: dvitīyaṃ "apratīkāśrayā ye hi te yānti parameva tu' iti pramāṇabalena amuktasthānagataparabrahmaprāptyaṃgīkāreṇa copapannam‌ | caturmukhapraptimatāṃ ca pratīkālambanānāṃ astyeva kārye pratipattyādīti teṣāmapi tanna bādhakamityadhikāribhedena pakṣadvayoktahetūnāṃ ubhayārthatvāṃgīkāre samīkartuṃ śakyatvāt‌ |
analyzed: dvitīyam apratīka āśrayāḥ ye hi te yānti param eva tu iti pramāṇa balena amukta sthāna gata para brahma prāpti aṃgīkāreṇa ca upapannam caturmukha praptimatām ca pratīka ālambanānām asti eva kārye pratipatti ādi iti teṣām api tat na bādhakam iti adhikāri bhedena pakṣa dvaya ukta hetūnām ubhaya arthatva aṃgīkāre samīkartum śakya tvāt

original: "apratīkāśrayā ye hi te yānti parameva tu | svadehe brahmadṛṣyayaiva gacchedbrahma salokatām‌ ||' ityukteḥ yāgyatākrameṇaiva pralaye pūrvaṃ ca tayoḥ prāptiriti | phalaṃ tu gamyānirṇayanirṇayābhyāṃ gatyanusmṛtitatsamādhī || 6 ||

original: "etaṃ setum‌' iti śruteranyārthaparatve kalpakābhāvāt‌ setupadoktabrahma tīrtvātikramyeti brahmātikramānantarameva svarūpāvirbhāvarūpamuktyuktyā brahmaprāptasyāmuktatvāvagamāt‌ muktasyaiva bhogabhoktṛtvāt‌ brahmātikramya muktaḥ san‌ bhogān‌ bhu ‌kte iti | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: etam setum iti śruteḥ anya artha paratve kalpaka abhāvāt setu pada ukta brahma tīrtvā atikramya iti brahma atikrama anantaram eva svarūpa āvirbhāva rūpa mukti uktyā brahma prāptasya amukta tva avagamāt muktasya eva bhoga bhoktṛ tvāt brahma atikramya muktaḥ san bhogān iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: "paraṃjyotirupasampadya' iti śrutau brahmapāptasyaiva svarūpāvirbhāvarūpamuktatvasyokteḥ "imāṃ ghoramaśivāṃ nadīṃ tīrtvaitaṃ setumāpya' iti spaṣyaśrutyanurodhena etaṃ setuṃ gantuṃ anyattīrtvā ityeva tasyāḥ śruterarthasya vācyatvāt‌ "ātmānamabhisampadyaitenātmanā yathākāmaṃ sarvān‌ kāmānanubhavati' iti śruteśca jñānī brahma prāpya tadavihāyaiva
analyzed: paraṃjyotiḥ upasampadya iti śrutau brahma pāptasya eva svarūpa āvirbhāva rūpa mukta tvasya ukteḥ imām ghoram aśivām nadīm tīrtvā etam setum āpya iti spaṣya śruti anurodhena etam setum gantum anyat tīrtvā iti eva tasyāḥ śruteḥ arthasya vācya tvāt ātmānam abhisampadya etena ātmanā yathākāmam sarvān kāmān anubhavati iti śruteḥ ca jñānī brahma prāpya tat a vihāya eva

original: || oṃ muktaḥ pratijñānāt‌ oṃ || 2 ||

original: pūrvākṣepeṇātra śaṃkanātsaṃgatiḥ | "paraṃjyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate' "sa tatra paryeti' iti pūrvasūtropātte śrutiśeṣe sa ityukteḥ kimamukta uta mukta iti cintā | tadarthaṃ sa iti tacchabdaḥ kimavyavahitapūrvaparāmarśako'tha prākaraṇikaparāmarśaka iti | tadarthamavyavahitaparāmarśe paryetītyādinoktakriyāvattvaṃ bādhakamuta neti |
analyzed: pūrva ākṣepeṇa atra śaṃkanāt saṃgatiḥ paraṃjyotiḥ upasampadya svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate sa tatra paryeti iti pūrva sūtra upātte śruti śeṣe saḥ iti ukteḥ kim amuktaḥ uta muktaḥ iti cintā tad artham saḥ iti tad śabdaḥ kim avyavahita pūrva parāmarśakā utha prākaraṇika parāmarśakaḥ iti tad artham avyavahita parāmarśe paryeti ityādinā ukta kriyāvat tvam bādhakam uta na iti

original: pūrvapakṣastu | pūrvatra paraṃjyotisampannasyāvirbhūtasvarūpasya muktasyaiva "sa tatra paryeti' iti vākyasyeśānatikrameṇa bhoge mānatvamabhipretya sūtre svenetiśrutyuktirayuktā | svenetipūrvavākye nirguṇopāsakasya svarūpāvirbhāvokteḥ | sa tatretyatra punaḥ daharavidyopāsakasyāmuktasyaiveha kalpakatvāt‌ |

original: pūrvapakṣastu | muktānāṃ dehasya bhāve duḥkhādiprasaṃgena nirduḥkhabhogo'nupapādanaḥ | abhāve ca bhogāsambhavaḥ | naca brāhmeṇetyatroktadiśā brāhmadehena bhogo yukta iti vācyam‌ | sāyujyabhājāṃ tatsaṃbhave'pi anyeṣāṃ tadabhāvāt‌ | naca ciccharīreṇa teṣāṃ bhogopapattiḥ | suptyādau sato'pi tasya bhogāyatanatvādarśanāt‌ |
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ tu muktānām dehasya bhāve duḥkha ādi prasaṃgena nirduḥkha bhogaḥ anupapādanaḥ abhāve ca bhoga asambhavaḥ na ca brāhmeṇa iti atra ukta diśā brāhma dehena bhogaḥ yuktaḥ iti vācyam sāyujya bhājām tad saṃbhave pi anyeṣām tad abhāvāt na ca cit śarīreṇa teṣām bhoga upapattiḥ supti ādau sataḥ api tasya bhoga āyatana tva adarśanāt

original: ato dehabhāvenābhāvena vā bhogasya durupapādanatvānna yujyate bhogaḥ | virodhādayuktau ca dehabhāvābhāvapakṣāviti | siddhāntastu | yujyate muktānāṃ bhogaḥ | pakṣadvaye'pi bhogasya sūpapādanatvāt‌ | bāhyadehabhāve tasya jaḍatve'pi śuddhasattvātmakatejorūpatayā duḥkhādyanāpādakatvena tatra sukhānubhavamātrasyopapatteḥ |
analyzed: atas deha bhāvena abhāvena vā bhogasya durupapādana tvāt na yujyate bhogaḥ virodhāt ayuktau ca deha bhāva abhāva pakṣau iti siddhāntaḥ tu yujyate muktānām bhogaḥ pakṣa dvaye api bhogasya sūpapādana tvāt bāhya deha bhāve tasya jaḍa tve api śuddha sattva ātmaka tejaḥ rūpatayā duḥkha ādi anāpādaka tvena tatra sukha anubhava mātrasya upapatteḥ

original: pradīpo yathā tailādyeva bhuṃkte na tu tadgatakārṣṇyādi tadvat‌ | "tīrṇo hi tadā sarvān‌ śokān‌' iti śruteḥ | dehābhāvapakṣe'pi yathā sva nāvasthāyāṃ bāhyadehābhimānābhāve'pi bhogaḥ tathā muktau bāhyadehābhāve'pi ciccharīreṇa bhogopapatteḥ anabhimānasyābhāvasāmyāt‌ | suptau manasa uparatatvādabhogaḥ dehabhāvapakṣau ca "cintā vācitā' veti
analyzed: pradīpaḥ yathā taila ādi eva bhuṃkte na tu tad gata kārṣṇya ādi tadvat tīrṇaḥ hi tadā sarvān śokān iti śruteḥ deha abhāva pakṣe pi yathā bhogaḥ tathā muktau bāhya deha abhāve pi cit śarīreṇa bhoga upapatteḥ anabhimānasya abhāva sāmyāt suptau manasaḥ uparata tvāt abhogaḥ deha bhāva pakṣau ca cintā vācitā vā iti

original: "aśarīro vāva tadā bhavati' iti ca śrutisiddhatvāt‌ | dvādaśāhasya yajamānecchayā ekānekakartṛkatvābhyāṃ ahīnatvasatratvavat‌ muktānāṃ svecchayā tejorūpabāhyadehabhāvābhāvayoravirodhācca yuktāviti | tathāca smṛtiḥ "svecchayā vā śarīrāṇi tejorūpāṇi kānicit‌ | svīkṛtya jāgaritavadbhuktvā tyāgaḥ kadācaneti |
analyzed: aśarīraḥ vāva tadā bhavati iti ca śruti siddha tvāt dvādaśa ahasya yajamāna icchayā eka aneka kartṛka tvābhyām ahīna tva satra tva vat muktānām sva icchayā tejaḥ rūpa bāhya deha bhāva abhāvayoḥ avirodhāt ca yuktau iti tathā ca smṛtiḥ sva icchayā vā śarīrāṇi tejaḥ rūpāṇi kānicid svīkṛtya jāgarita vat bhuktvā tyāgaḥ kadācana iti

original: phalaṃ tu nirduḥkhabhogābhāvānmukteḥ pumarthatvākṣepastatsamādhiśceti || 9 ||
analyzed: phalam tu nirduḥkha bhoga abhāvāt mukteḥ pumartha tva ākṣepaḥ tad samādhiḥ ca iti

original: || oṃ jagadvayāpāravarjam‌ oṃ || 9 ||
analyzed: om jagat vayāpāra varjam om

original: || oṃ prakaraṇādasannihitatvācca oṃ || oṃ pratyakṣopadeśāditi cennādhikārikamaṇḍalasthokteḥ oṃ || oṃ vikāravarti ca tathā hi darśayati oṃ ||
analyzed: om prakaraṇāt asannihita tvāt ca om om pratyakṣa upadeśāt iti ced na ādhikārika maṇḍala stha ukteḥ om om vikāra varti ca tathā hi darśayati om

original: evamanupapattinirāsena muktānāṃ bhoge siddhe'tra maryādocyate iti saṃgatiḥ | muktāḥ kiṃ jagadvayāpārān‌ kurvanti na veti cintā | tadarthaṃ "sarvān‌ kāmānāptveti śrutau sarvaśabdo'saṃkucitavṛttiruta saṃkucitavṛttiriti | tadatharṃ tatsaṃsocakaṃ nāstyutāstīti | tadarthaṃ "sarve'smai devā viriṃcaviṣayā veti |
analyzed: evam anupapatti nirāsena muktānām bhoge siddhā itra maryādā ucyate iti saṃgatiḥ muktāḥ kim jagat vayāpārān kurvanti na vā iti cintā tad artham sarvān kāmān āptvā iti śrutau tad saṃsocakam na asti uta asti iti tad artham sarve smai devāḥ viriṃca viṣayāḥ vā iti

original: sarvesmai devā iti śruterjīvamātraviṣayatvāt‌ sarvān‌ kāmānitiśruteḥ "śarīrabhedādūrdhvaḥ utkramya' ityādijīvaprakaraṇagatatve'pi jīvānāṃ tādṛśaśaktikalpanena vā śaktyabhāve'pi satyakāmatvādeva sarvaiśvayarsambhavena sarvavākyasaṃkocakābhāvāt‌ kurvantyeva muktāḥ jagatsṛṣyayādivyāpāramiti prāpte siddhāntaḥ |
analyzed: sarve smai devāḥ iti śruteḥ jīva mātra viṣayatvāt sarvān kāmān iti śruteḥ śarīrabhedāt ūrdhvaḥ utkramyaḥ ityādi jīva prakaraṇa gata tve pi jīvānām tādṛśa śakti kalpanena vā śakti abhāve api satyakāma tvāt eva sarva aiśvayaḥ sambhavena sarva vākya saṃkocaka abhāvāt kurvanti eva muktāḥ jagat sṛṣyayā ādi vyāpāram iti prāpte siddhāntaḥ

original: "māhācamasya' ityupakrameṇa "sarve'smai' iti śruteḥ viriṃcaviṣayatayā sarvamuktaviṣayatvābhāvena jīvānāṃ sṛṣyayādau śaktikalpanābhāvena tatra sāmarthyābhāvāt‌ satyakāmatvasya "svādhikānandasamprāptau sṛṣyayādivyāpṛtiṣvapi | muktānāṃ naiva kāmaḥ syāt‌' iti smṛtyā sṛṣyayādyanyakāmānavattvenopapatteḥ |
analyzed: iti upakrameṇa sarvesmai iti śruteḥ viriṃca viṣaya tayā sarva mukta viṣayatva abhāvena jīvānām sṛṣyayā ādau śakti kalpanā bhāvena tatra sāmarthya abhāvāt satyakāmatvasya sva adhika ānanda samprāptau sṛṣyayā ādi vyāpṛtiṣu api muktānām na eva kāmaḥ syāt iti smṛtyā sṛṣyayā ādi anya kāmānavattvena upapatteḥ

original: jagadvayāpāravarjamanyān‌ kāmān‌ bhuṃkte mukta iti | atra muktaviriṃcasyāśeṣamuktaniyamanavyāpāro'nyadevānāṃ svāvaramuktaniyamanavyāpāraścāstīti dhyeyam‌ | phalaṃ tu lakṣaṇasūtrākṣepasamādhī || 9 ||
analyzed: jagat vayāpāra varjam anyān kāmān bhuṃkte muktaḥ iti atra mukta viriṃcasya aśeṣa mukta niyamana vyāpāraḥ nya devānām sva avara mukta niyamana vyāpāraḥ ca asti iti dhyeyam phalam tu lakṣaṇa sūtra ākṣepa samādhī

original: || oṃ sthitimāha darśayataścaivaṃ pratyakṣānumāne oṃ || 10 ||
analyzed: om sthitim āha darśayataḥ ca evam pratyakṣa anumāne om

original: || oṃ bhogamātrasāmyaliṃgācca oṃ ||
analyzed: om bhoga mātra sāmya liṅgāt ca om

original: pūrvatra kāmapadoktaviṣayabhogeyattoktā atra tu tadabhivyaṃgyasvarūpasukhasya yathāsthitirūpeyattocyata iti saṃgatiḥ | muktaḥ kimānandavṛddhihrāsavān‌ uta yathāsthitimāniti cintā | tadarthaṃ teṣāmupāsanādikaṃ kiṃ vṛddhayādiheturbhavatyuta neti | pūrvapakṣastu |
analyzed: pūrvatra kāma pada ukta viṣaya bhoga iyattā uktā atra tu tad abhivyaṃgya svarūpa sukhasya yathā sthiti rūpa iyattā ucyate iti saṃgatiḥ muktaḥ kim ānanda vṛddhi hrāsavān uta yathā sthitimān iti cintā tad artham teṣām upāsana ādikam kim vṛddhayā ādi hetuḥ bhavati uta na iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu

original: "etatsāma gāyannāste' ityādau muktānāmupāsanāśravaṇāt‌ tasya ca vaiyarthyānyathānupapattyā phalatvāvaśyaṃbhāvāt‌ muktānāṃ vaśitvarūpaiśvaryabalena kāmitāśeṣabhogaviśeṣasattvācca vṛddhimān‌ ānandastaduparame ca hrāsavāniti | siddhāntastu | ekaprakāreṇaiva sthitimān‌ muktānandaḥ |
analyzed: etat sāma gāyan āste ityādau muktānām upāsanā śravaṇāt tasya ca vaiyarthya anyathā anupapattyā phalatva avaśyaṃbhāvāt muktānām vaśitva rūpa aiśvarya balena kāmita aśeṣa bhoga viśeṣa sattvāt ca vṛddhimān ānandaḥ tad uparame ca hrāsavān iti siddhāntaḥ tu eka prakāreṇa eva sthitimān mukta ānandaḥ

original: "sa eṣaḥ' iti bhāṣyokta śrutau vṛddhayādyabhāvamuktvā "darśannevātmānam‌' ityupāsanāvaco'pi āpattivipattiśabditavṛddhihrāsaniṣedhāt‌ mahatāṃ pratyakṣeṇa mukto na vṛddhayādimān‌ kāraṇaśūnyatvādityanumānena ca vṛddhayādyabhāvasya siddhatvāt‌ |
analyzed: saḥ eṣaḥ iti bhāṣya ukta śrutau vṛddhayā ādi abhāvam uktvā darśan eva ātmānam iti upāsanā vacaḥ api āpatti vipatti śabdita vṛddhi hrāsa niṣedhāt mahatām pratyakṣeṇa muktaḥ na vṛddhayā ādimān kāraṇa śūnyatvāt iti anumānena ca vṛddhayā ādi abhāvasya siddha tvāt

original: upāsanayāśca "harerupāsanā cātra sadaiva sukharūpiṇi' iti smṛtyā svayaṃ phalarūpatvena phalāntarasādhanatvābhāvāt‌ | vaśitvena kāmitāśeṣabhogaprāptāvapi ayogye kāmanāvirahāt‌ yogyasya ca prāptatvāt‌ bhogaviśeṣe'pi taduparamādapi na sukhavṛddhihrāsahetutayāpi sa bhogaviśeṣaḥ "avṛddhihrāsarūpatvaṃ muktānāṃ prāyikaṃ bhavet‌ |
analyzed: upāsanayāḥ ca hareḥ upāsanā ca atra sadā eva sukha rūpiṇi iti smṛtyā svayam phala rūpatvena phala antara sādhanatva abhāvāt vaśitvena kāmita aśeṣa bhoga prāptau api ayogye kāmanā virahāt yogyasya ca prāptatvāt bhoga viśeṣe pi tad uparamāt api na sukha vṛddhi hrāsa hetutayā api sa bhoga viśeṣaḥ avṛddhi hrāsa rūpa tvam muktānām prāyikam bhavet

original: kādācitkaviśeṣasya naiva teṣāṃ niṣiddhayate' iti uktadiśā svarūpasukhasya vaicityahetutayā vopapanna iti | phalaṃ tu saṃsārasamānadharmatāpattyā mukterapumarthatvākṣepasamādhī || 10 ||
analyzed: kādācitka viśeṣasya nā eva teṣām iti ukta diśā svarūpa sukhasya vaicitya hetutayā vā upapannaḥ iti phalam tu saṃsāra samāna dharmatā āpattyāḥ mukteḥ apumartha tva ākṣepa samādhī

original: || oṃ anāvṛttiśśabdādanāvṛttiśśabdāt‌ oṃ || 11 ||
analyzed: om anāvṛttiḥ śabdāt anāvṛttiḥ śabdāt om

original: pūrvatra muktānandasya vṛddhayādi netyuktam‌ | atra tu tadanubhavasyānto nāstītyucyata iti saṃgatiḥ | prakṛto muktaḥ kiṃ
analyzed: pūrvatra mukta ānandasya vṛddhayā ādi na iti uktam atra tu tad anubhavasya antaḥ na asti iti ucyate iti saṃgatiḥ prakṛtaḥ muktaḥ kim

original: janmamṛtyādiprāptirūpapunarāvṛttimānuta neti cintā | tadarthaṃ muktasya samastakālavāsitvaṃ punarāvṛttāvabādhakamiti | tadarthaṃ samastasyāpi kālasya samāptirastyuta neti | pūrvapakṣastu | svargādisthasyeva muktasyāpyasti punarāvṛttiḥ | muktasya samastakālavāsitve'pi samastasyāpi kālasya kadācitsamāptisambhavāt‌ |
analyzed: janma mṛtyā ādi prāpti rūpa punarāvṛttimān uta na iti cintā tad artham muktasya samasta kāla vāsi tvam punarāvṛtti avabādhakam iti tad artham samastasya api kālasya samāptiḥ asti uta na iti pūrvapakṣaḥ tu svarga ādi sthasya iva muktasya api asti punarāvṛttiḥ muktasya samasta kāla vāsi tve pi samastasya api kālasya kadācid samāpti sambhavāt

original: naca kālasyānantyāt‌ samāpterasambhavaḥ | bhāratayuddhe "caturdaśīṃ paṃcadarśīṃ bhūtapūrvāṃ tu ṣoḍaśīm‌ | imāṃ tu nābhijānāmi amāvāsyāṃ trayodaśī' iti trayodaśyāḥ asambhāvitapañcadaśītvadarśanāditi | siddhāntastu |
analyzed: na ca kālasya ānantyāt samāpteḥ asambhavaḥ bhārata yuddhe caturdaśīm paṃcadarśīm bhūta pūrvām tu ṣoḍaśīm imām tu na abhijānāmi amāvāsyām trayodaśī iti trayodaśyāḥ asambhāvita pañcadaśī tva darśanāt iti siddhāntaḥ tu

original: kālasya samastasyāpi samāpteḥ vyāhatatvena anantakālāvasāyitvāt‌ svagirṇo manvantarādyavasāyitayā punarāvṛttāvapi na muktasya punarāvṛttiḥ "naca punarāvartate' iti śruteśca | "sarvān‌ kāmānā noti' iti śrutau sarvakāmāpteḥ śravaṇena śrutāvapunarāvṛtteḥ kāmitatvācca na punarāvṛttiriti nityanirduḥkhānandānubhavavanta eva muktā iti |
analyzed: kālasya samastasya api samāpteḥ vyāhata tvena ananta kāla avasāyi tvāt manvantara ādi avasāyi tayā punarāvṛttau api na muktasya punarāvṛttiḥ na ca punar āvartate iti śruteḥ ca sarvān kāmān ā noti iti śrutau sarva kāma āpteḥ śravaṇena śrutau apunarāvṛtteḥ kāmita tvāt ca na punarāvṛttiḥ iti nitya nirduḥkha ānanda anubhavavantaḥ eva muktāḥ iti

original: phalaṃ tu mukteḥ pumarthatvākṣepasamādhī || 11 ||
analyzed: phalam tu mukteḥ pumartha tva ākṣepa samādhī

original: kalyāṇaguṇapūrṇāya doṣadūrāya viṣṇave |
analyzed: kalyāṇa guṇa pūrṇāya doṣa dūrāya viṣṇave

original: namaḥ śrīprāṇanāthāya bhaktābhīṣyapradāyine ||
analyzed: namaḥ śrī prāṇanāthāya bhakta abhīṣya pradāyine

original: || iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācārya śrīmatsudhīndragurupādaśiṣyarāghavendrayatikṛtāyāṃ nyāyamuktāvalyāṃ caturthādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat paramahaṃsa parivrājaka ācārya śrīmat sudhīndra guru pāda śiṣya rāghavendrayati kṛtāyām nyāyamuktāvalyām caturtha adhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ
